decks.name: Cold open
decks.why: Two people who just met, standing in a queue or a lift.

decks.name: Coffee chat
decks.why: Half an hour with someone you were introduced to.

decks.name: Language exchange
decks.why: Practice partners - short questions, high-frequency patterns.

decks.name: Dinner party
decks.why: A table of people who mostly know each other.

decks.name: Long drive
decks.why: Hours to fill with someone you already like.

decks.name: Tell me a story
decks.why: Open-ended invitations rather than yes/no questions.

decks.name: Getting closer
decks.why: A friendship you want to take past small talk.

decks.name: Deep dive
decks.why: Someone you trust, late at night.

decks.name: Debate night

questions.en: What were your favorite foods?

questions.zh: 天气很热时，你睡觉会盖毯子、床单，还是完全不盖？

questions.zh: 现在的年轻人有哪些你当年没有的优势？

questions.zh: 你最近有什么直觉或预感？你有没有据此做过什么？

questions.zh: 如果现在有人告诉你一个消息，什么消息会让你高兴得跳起来？

questions.zh: 你能准确预测这周每天上班会穿什么吗？

questions.zh: 你吃过最难吃的食物是什么？

questions.zh: 你小时候最喜欢哪些睡前故事或摇篮曲？

questions.zh: 你更喜欢精酿啤酒，还是大型啤酒厂的啤酒？

questions.zh: 你觉得应该由谁来负责食品安全监管？

questions.zh: 如果有需要，你会申请食品救济券吗？

questions.zh: 你每天吃饭的时间都差不多吗？

questions.zh: 你喜欢和来自其他国家的人相处吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得美国食品药品监督管理局在食品安全监管方面做得好吗？

questions.zh: 你因工作去过的地方里，最有意思的目的地是哪里？

questions.en: Do you like constant company or to be alone at times?
questions.zh: 你喜欢一直有人陪着，还是偶尔更想一个人待着？

questions.en: Do you like to talk about your problems or escape them?
questions.zh: 遇到问题时，你喜欢和别人谈一谈，还是暂时逃开？

questions.zh: 你会控制饮食，还是想吃什么就吃什么？

questions.zh: 你有没有看电影或戏剧看到一半就离场？为什么？

questions.zh: 你家里有有线电视，还是主要通过互联网看节目？

questions.en: Do you like to sunbathe, or do you stay out of the sun?
questions.zh: 你喜欢晒太阳，还是会尽量避开阳光？

questions.en: Do you enjoy writing? What type of writing? Do you show it to others or keep it private?
questions.zh: 你喜欢写作吗？喜欢写什么？你会给别人看，还是只留给自己？

questions.en: Do you prefer traditional team sports or extreme sports like BMX, motocross, hang gliding and snowboarding?
questions.zh: 传统团体运动和极限运动（小轮车、越野摩托、悬挂滑翔、单板滑雪）相比，你更喜欢哪一类？

questions.en: Can you sing well?
questions.zh: 你唱歌唱得好吗？

questions.en: Do you love animals?
questions.zh: 你喜欢动物吗？

questions.en: Who's your favorite actor?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪位演员？

questions.en: Can you ballroom dance confidently?
questions.zh: 你会比较自信地跳交谊舞吗？

questions.en: Do you enjoy big, noisy parties?
questions.zh: 你喜欢大型、吵闹的派对吗？

questions.en: Do you enjoy rough physical activity?
questions.zh: 你喜欢比较激烈的体力活动吗？

questions.en: What do you tend to doodle?
questions.zh: 你随手涂鸦时通常会画些什么？

questions.en: What's your favorite Elvis Presley song?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪首猫王的歌？

questions.en: Where do you get your recipes?
questions.zh: 你的食谱通常从哪里找？

questions.en: Do you enjoy making or building things?
questions.zh: 你喜欢亲手制作或搭建东西吗？

questions.en: Do you enjoy the attention of crowds?
questions.zh: 你享受成为人群关注的焦点吗？

questions.en: Would you rather read fiction or nonfiction?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢读小说，还是非虚构作品？

questions.en: Can you tell when someone is singing off-key?
questions.zh: 你能听出别人唱跑调了吗？

questions.en: How do you feel about television these days?
questions.zh: 你现在怎么看电视这种媒介？

questions.zh: 你觉得为什么现在这么多婚姻会破裂？

questions.en: Would you rather go hiking or watch TV?
questions.zh: 你宁愿去徒步，还是看电视？

questions.en: Would you sing karaoke in front of strangers?
questions.zh: 你愿意在陌生人面前唱卡拉OK吗？

questions.en: What new dance styles would you like to learn?
questions.zh: 你想学哪些新的舞蹈风格？

questions.en: Would you rather watch TV or read a book?
questions.zh: 你宁愿看电视，还是读一本书？

questions.zh: 你愿意在很多人面前唱歌吗？

questions.en: Do you read the comments sections on websites and blogs?
questions.zh: 你会看网站和博客下面的评论区吗？

questions.zh: 买食品时，你会看保质期或新鲜日期吗？

questions.zh: 哪一本现有的书或哪一部电影的标题最能形容你的人生？

questions.zh: 你愿意辞掉工作去追求歌唱事业吗？

questions.zh: 你希望自己的私人收藏里有哪些视频或电影？

questions.zh: 你宁愿去爬一座山，还是读一本好小说？

questions.zh: 如果工作时一直播放激励性质的背景音乐，你会有什么感觉？

questions.zh: 你喜欢读什么？是什么吸引你去读这些内容？

questions.zh: 你最想拥有哪件电影道具或纪念品？

questions.en: What music do you prefer to listen to when you are alone?
questions.zh: 你一个人时最喜欢听什么音乐？

questions.zh: 如果拍一部电影，你最想拍什么题材或故事？

questions.zh: 最近哪一部戏剧或电影让你和别人聊得特别尽兴？

questions.en: Do you watch TV for specific shows, background company, or simply to unwind?
questions.zh: 你看电视主要是为了追特定节目、当背景陪伴，还是单纯放松？

questions.en: Who were some of your biggest crushes - celebrities or people you knew?
questions.zh: 你人生中有哪些特别大的“迷恋对象”——名人或现实中认识的人？

questions.en: Do you enjoy games for the fun of playing, or mostly when you win?
questions.zh: 你玩游戏主要是享受过程，还是赢了才更开心？

questions.en: Do you write or highlight in the books you read? Why or why not?
questions.zh: 你看书时会做笔记或划重点吗？为什么？

questions.en: How do you usually watch movies and shows - streaming, renting, or another way?
questions.zh: 你平时怎么看电影和节目——流媒体、租片，还是其他方式？

questions.en: What piece of music makes you nostalgic, and what does it remind you of?
questions.zh: 哪段音乐最容易让你怀旧？它会让你想起什么？

questions.en: What's a song or album in your collection that you might call a guilty pleasure?
questions.zh: 你的歌单或收藏里，有哪首歌或哪张专辑算是“有点不好意思承认但很喜欢”？

questions.en: Which athlete or public figure do you think is a good role model for children today?
questions.zh: 你觉得现在有哪些运动员或公众人物是孩子的好榜样？

questions.en: What are you most focused on in life right now, and would you like that to change?
questions.zh: 你现在生活中最关注的是什么？你希望这种重心发生变化吗？

questions.en: What is your favourite brand of biscuit? Is there one that was discontinued that you wish would come back?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪个牌子的饼干？有没有已经停产、但你希望它重新上市的？

questions.en: What do you do when asked to work overtime?
questions.zh: 别人要求你加班时，你通常会怎么做？

questions.zh: 你最常吃、也最省心的一顿早餐是什么？

questions.en: What's your go-to dinner?
questions.zh: 你最常吃、也最省心的一顿晚饭是什么？

questions.en: What's your go-to lunch?

questions.en: What's your favorite water sport?

questions.en: What's your favorite sport to play?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢参加哪项运动？

questions.en: What's your favorite sport to watch?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢看哪项运动？

questions.en: Do you have a favorite sports tradition?
questions.zh: 你有没有特别喜欢的体育传统或仪式？

questions.en: What's the kitchen tool you use most?
questions.zh: 你最常用的厨房工具是什么？

questions.en: What's your favorite ice-cream flavor and brand?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢什么口味、什么品牌的冰淇淋？

questions.en: Will time travel ever exist for humans?
questions.zh: 你觉得人类未来真的会实现时间旅行吗？

questions.en: How do you like to eat ice cream?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢怎么吃冰淇淋？

questions.en: What was the worst travel experience you had?
questions.zh: 你经历过最糟糕的一次旅行是什么？

questions.en: What's your favorite place for a business lunch?
questions.zh: 商务午餐你最喜欢去哪里？

questions.en: Which foods do you always keep at home?
questions.zh: 你家里总会常备哪些食物？

questions.en: Do you approve or disapprove of betting on professional sports?
questions.zh: 你赞成还是反对职业体育博彩？

questions.en: Would you rather be a cartoonist or a sports columnist?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当漫画家，还是体育专栏作家？

questions.en: Do you like mixing with people who are unpredictable or nonconformist?
questions.zh: 你喜欢和性格难以预测或不太随大流的人交往吗？

questions.en: Do you spend more time on a computer or watching TV?
questions.zh: 你花在电脑上的时间更多，还是看电视的时间更多？

questions.en: How much do you trust TV news compared with online news?
questions.zh: 和网络新闻相比，你有多信任电视新闻？

questions.en: Which do you like best about yourself: appearance, personality, or intellect?
questions.zh: 外貌、性格和智力这三方面，你最喜欢自己哪一方面？

questions.en: Would you rather eat a candy bar or piece of fruit?
questions.zh: 你宁愿吃一块巧克力棒，还是一份水果？

questions.en: Do you ever fill out a prediction bracket for a big sports tournament?
questions.zh: 遇到大型体育赛事，你会填写预测对阵表吗？

questions.en: Do you feel that organic food is better for you than regular food?
questions.zh: 你觉得有机食品比普通食品更健康吗？

questions.zh: 为了救活宠物，你愿意在兽医治疗上花多少钱？

questions.en: How do you feel when people use electronic devices in movie theaters, at concerts, or in stores?
questions.zh: 在电影院、音乐会或商店里看到别人一直用电子设备时，你有什么感觉？

questions.en: If you could only help one first in an emergency, would you choose your pet or a person?
questions.zh: 如果紧急情况下只能先救一个，你会先救自己的宠物，还是一个人？

questions.en: What do you like least about your life?
questions.zh: 你最不喜欢自己生活中的什么？

questions.en: Where's your favorite place to sit at home?
questions.zh: 在家里你最喜欢坐在哪里？

questions.en: What do you like best about kids, yours or others?
questions.zh: 对于孩子——自己的或别人的——你最喜欢他们什么？

questions.en: What do you like to do to lift your spirits?
questions.zh: 心情低落时，你会做什么让自己振作起来？

questions.en: Are you eating right?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己现在吃得健康吗？

questions.en: Did you go to university?
questions.zh: 你上过大学吗？

questions.en: What's your favorite cat breed?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢什么品种的猫？

questions.en: What's your favorite dog breed?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢什么品种的狗？

questions.en: How do you keep learning these days?
questions.zh: 你现在通过什么方式持续学习？

questions.en: How do you want your obituary to read?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的讣告怎样描述你？

questions.en: Have you ever made your own film or video?
questions.zh: 你自己拍过电影或视频吗？

questions.en: Would you rather take care of animals or people?
questions.zh: 你宁愿照顾动物，还是照顾人？

questions.en: Have you ever purchased an "As Seen on TV" item?
questions.zh: 你买过“电视购物同款”之类的商品吗？

questions.en: What was the worst experience you had in a restaurant?
questions.zh: 你在餐厅经历过最糟糕的事情是什么？

questions.zh: 你有没有打电话到电台点歌或送祝福？

questions.en: What's your greatest hunger besides food? Is it healthy or unhealthy?
questions.zh: 除了食物之外，你内心最强烈的“渴望”是什么？你觉得它健康吗？

questions.en: Have you ever played in a band or sung with a group?
questions.zh: 你参加过乐队，或和组合一起唱过歌吗？

questions.en: How would you rate your karaoke singing ability from 1 to 10?
questions.zh: 如果满分10分，你会给自己的卡拉OK水平打几分？

questions.en: When and where was the last time you really got to dance?
questions.zh: 你上一次真正尽兴跳舞是在什么时候、什么地方？

questions.en: Would you rather have X-ray vision or the ability to read minds?
questions.zh: 你宁愿拥有X光透视能力，还是读心术？

questions.en: If you had to kill your own food, would you become a vegetarian?
questions.zh: 如果你必须亲手杀死自己要吃的动物，你会因此改吃素吗？

questions.en: Would you rather travel with a circus or with a touring sports team?
questions.zh: 你宁愿跟着马戏团到处跑，还是跟着一支四处比赛的球队？

questions.zh: 如果你可以拥有世界上规模最大的某种收藏，你会收藏什么？

questions.zh: 你觉得如今当父母最困难的是什么？

questions.en: What do you think is the most difficult thing about being a teenager today?
questions.zh: 你觉得如今当青少年最困难的是什么？

questions.en: What's your favorite love song, and which line from it do you like most?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪首情歌？其中你最喜欢哪一句？

questions.en: If space and money weren't an issue, what would you add for your leisure time?
questions.zh: 如果空间和钱都不是问题，你最想为自己的休闲生活添置什么？

questions.zh: 你宁愿登上新闻杂志封面，还是娱乐名人杂志封面？

questions.en: Do you usually watch television shows when they are on or at a later time online or on tape?
questions.zh: 你通常会在节目播出时看，还是之后在网上或录播里看？

questions.en: Would you rather have a high-paying job and travel 50 percent of the time or an average-paying job with no travel?
questions.zh: 你宁愿拿高薪但一半时间都在出差，还是拿普通薪水但完全不用出差？

questions.en: What made your favorite boss memorable?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢的一位老板为什么让你印象深刻？

questions.en: What do you like most about your work?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢自己工作中的哪些部分？

questions.en: Do you prefer clear direction from someone else, or being your own boss?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢别人给你明确指示，还是自己当老板？

questions.en: What are you currently reading?
questions.zh: 你最近在读什么？

questions.en: What magazines do you read?
questions.zh: 你会读哪些杂志？

questions.en: What's your favorite holiday decoration?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪一种节日装饰？

questions.en: How do you organize your books?
questions.zh: 你通常怎么整理自己的书？

questions.en: What song makes you instantly happy?
questions.zh: 哪首歌能让你立刻开心起来？

questions.en: Has a self-help book ever helped you?
questions.zh: 有没有哪本自助类书籍真的帮助过你？

questions.en: Is there any value to watching TV?
questions.zh: 你觉得看电视有什么价值吗？

questions.en: What actor most deserves an Academy Award?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪位演员最应该获得奥斯卡奖？

questions.en: What book would you like to memorize?
questions.zh: 如果可以背熟一本书，你会选哪一本？

questions.en: What songs do you know by heart?
questions.zh: 有哪些歌你不用看歌词就会唱？

questions.en: What songs do you remember dancing to?
questions.zh: 你记得自己曾伴着哪些歌跳舞吗？

questions.en: What would you name your rock band?
questions.zh: 如果你组一支摇滚乐队，会给它取什么名字？

questions.en: Who is the most overrated actor working today?
questions.zh: 你觉得当今哪位演员最被高估？

questions.zh: 你学过速读或速记吗？

questions.en: How much do you read to your children?
questions.zh: 你会经常读书给孩子听吗？

questions.en: How often do you go to the movies?
questions.zh: 你通常多久去一次电影院？

questions.en: In what ways does TV affect your relationships?
questions.zh: 电视会以哪些方式影响你的人际关系？

questions.en: What book had the biggest influence on you?
questions.zh: 哪本书对你的影响最大？

questions.en: What book would you strongly recommend to someone?
questions.zh: 你会特别推荐别人读哪本书？

questions.en: What comics did you read when growing up?
questions.zh: 你小时候看过哪些漫画？

questions.en: What how-to book would you like to write?
questions.zh: 如果要写一本实用指南，你最想教别人什么？

questions.en: What was the worst book you ever read?
questions.zh: 你读过最糟糕的一本书是什么？

questions.en: What was the worst television series ever made?
questions.zh: 你觉得史上最糟糕的电视剧是哪一部？

questions.en: What were the last three books you bought?
questions.zh: 你最近买的三本书是什么？

questions.en: Which celebrities get on your nerves the most?
questions.zh: 哪些明星最让你觉得烦？

questions.en: Whose mind would you most like to read?
questions.zh: 如果可以读懂一个人的想法，你最想读谁的心思？

questions.en: Do you eat protein bars? Why or why not?
questions.zh: 你会吃蛋白棒吗？为什么？

questions.en: Do you prefer surfing the internet over watching TV?
questions.zh: 相比看电视，你更喜欢上网吗？

questions.en: How can you get kids to watch less TV?
questions.zh: 怎样才能让孩子少看一点电视？

questions.en: How many channels do you need on your television?
questions.zh: 你觉得电视有多少个频道才够用？

questions.en: How much time do you spend reading each day?
questions.zh: 你每天大概花多少时间阅读？

questions.zh: 你通常按什么顺序看报纸的各个版面？

questions.zh: 你最喜欢阅读哪些名人的故事？

questions.zh: 如果电视突然坏了，你会做什么？

questions.zh: 哪位作家对你的影响最大？

questions.en: Has a song ever gotten completely stuck in your head?
questions.zh: 有没有一首歌曾经在你脑子里循环到停不下来？

questions.en: How many hours of TV do you watch per day?
questions.zh: 你平均每天看几个小时电视？

questions.en: How often do you read newspapers in a typical week?
questions.zh: 一般一周里你会有多少天看报纸？

questions.zh: 你最想参加哪一个电视游戏节目？

questions.en: What books have you wanted to read more than once?
questions.zh: 有哪些书你愿意读不止一遍？

questions.en: What singer would you like to sing a duet with?
questions.zh: 你最想和哪位歌手合唱？

questions.en: What stage name would you choose for your film debut?
questions.zh: 如果第一次拍电影要用艺名，你会取什么名字？

questions.en: What TV show would you most like to be on?
questions.zh: 你最想参加哪一个电视节目？

questions.en: What were the last three songs or albums you bought?
questions.zh: 你最近买的三首歌或三张专辑是什么？

questions.en: What would you like to sell in a TV commercial?
questions.zh: 如果让你拍电视广告，你最想卖什么？

questions.en: What would you rather see instead of traditional TV commercials?
questions.zh: 如果不用传统电视广告，你更希望看到什么？

questions.en: Which male and female celebrities do you find most attractive?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪些男女明星最有魅力？

questions.en: Who are the authors whose every book you have read?
questions.zh: 有哪些作家的作品你几乎一本不落地读过？

questions.en: Would you like to appear on a reality TV show?
questions.zh: 你想参加真人秀节目吗？

questions.en: Do you prefer reading a book or listening to an audiobook?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢读纸质书，还是听有声书？

questions.en: How long do you think you could go without watching TV?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己最多能多久不看电视？

questions.en: How many remote controls do you have for your main TV?
questions.zh: 你家主电视有多少个遥控器？

questions.en: If you opened a restaurant, what would the house specialty be?
questions.zh: 如果你开一家餐厅，招牌菜会是什么？

questions.en: What kinds of things make you uncomfortable to watch on TV?
questions.zh: 电视上哪些内容会让你看得不舒服？

questions.en: What section of the newspaper do you most like to read?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢看报纸的哪个版面？

questions.en: Do you keep anything to read in the bathroom? If so, what?
questions.zh: 你会在浴室里放点东西读吗？如果会，通常是什么？

questions.en: Do you prefer to watch movies at home or at a theater?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢在家看电影，还是去电影院？

questions.en: What song would you feel comfortable singing in front of a group?
questions.zh: 如果要在一群人面前唱歌，你会比较有把握唱哪一首？

questions.en: Would you rather encourage your child in the arts or in sports?
questions.zh: 如果是你的孩子，你更愿意鼓励他发展艺术还是体育？

questions.en: Do you enjoy vampire and wizard stories, or are they not your thing?
questions.zh: 你喜欢吸血鬼、魔法师这类故事，还是完全不感兴趣？

questions.en: Do you think today's youth have it easier or tougher than you did?
questions.zh: 你觉得现在的年轻人比你当年过得更容易，还是更难？

questions.en: Have you ever made a lasting friend while traveling? What was the story?
questions.zh: 你有没有在旅行途中认识后来一直保持联系的朋友？当时是怎么认识的？

questions.en: If you could spend a vacation with one person, who would it be?
questions.zh: 如果可以和一个人一起去度假，你会选谁？

questions.en: What do you do with recyclables?
questions.zh: 你通常怎么处理可回收物？

questions.en: What do you do to stop hiccups?
questions.zh: 你打嗝时通常怎么止住？

questions.en: Do you enjoy physical work or mental work?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢体力劳动，还是脑力劳动？

questions.en: Do you enjoy what you do at work?
questions.zh: 你喜欢现在的工作内容吗？

questions.en: What do you do at your home desk?
questions.zh: 你在家里的书桌前通常会做些什么？

questions.en: What do you do during a power outage?
questions.zh: 停电时你一般会做什么？

questions.en: What do you do to protect your privacy?
questions.zh: 你平时怎样保护自己的隐私？

questions.en: What do you do only when you are alone?
questions.zh: 有哪些事情你只会在独处时做？

questions.en: What do you do when you catch a cold?
questions.zh: 感冒时你通常会怎么照顾自己？

questions.en: Do you do anything in particular to reduce your taxes?
questions.zh: 你会特意做些什么来合法减少税负吗？

questions.en: What do you usually do with advertising inserts in magazines?
questions.zh: 杂志里的广告插页你通常会怎么处理？

questions.en: What kind of people do you like to spend time with?
questions.zh: 你喜欢和什么样的人相处？

questions.en: When an issue really bothers you, what do you usually do about it?
questions.zh: 当某个问题真的让你很困扰时，你通常会怎么处理？

questions.en: What were your favorite classes?
questions.zh: 你以前最喜欢哪些课程？

questions.en: Describe an article you read recently.
questions.zh: 说说你最近读到的一篇文章。

questions.en: How would you describe your eating habits?
questions.zh: 你会怎样形容自己的饮食习惯？

questions.en: What sport do you wish was coed?
questions.zh: 你希望哪一种运动能有男女混合比赛？

questions.en: What team sport do you excel at?
questions.zh: 你最擅长哪一种团队运动？

questions.en: Are you a regular at any restaurant or café?
questions.zh: 你有没有经常光顾的餐厅或咖啡馆？

questions.en: Are you good at keeping everyday disappointments in perspective?
questions.zh: 你擅长把日常的小失望看得开一些吗？

questions.en: Have you ever read someone's diary without their permission?
questions.zh: 你有没有未经允许看过别人的日记？

questions.en: Do you watch reality television? If yes, how many shows?
questions.zh: 你会看真人秀吗？如果会，大概会追几个节目？

questions.en: How do you organize your music, books, or other collections?
questions.zh: 你通常怎么整理音乐、书籍或其他收藏？

questions.en: Is your home usually filled with music, conversation, or quiet?
questions.zh: 你的家里通常更多是音乐声、聊天声，还是安静？

questions.en: How do you learn best: by listening, watching, reading, or doing?
questions.zh: 你通过哪种方式学得最好：听、看、读，还是亲手做？

questions.en: How many times do you go out for dinner per week?
questions.zh: 你平均一周外出吃几次晚餐？

questions.en: If you wrote a book, who would you dedicate it to?
questions.zh: 如果你写一本书，会把它献给谁？

questions.en: What do you think was the greatest upset in sports history?
questions.zh: 你觉得体育史上最惊人的爆冷是哪一次？

questions.en: What foods do you eat that you know you should not?
questions.zh: 有哪些食物你明知道不该多吃，却还是会吃？

questions.en: What was one of the most unusual meals you ever ate?
questions.zh: 你吃过最特别的一顿饭是什么？

questions.en: Have you ever voted for a contestant on a TV talent show?
questions.zh: 你有没有在电视选秀节目里给选手投过票？

questions.en: Do you think downloading music or movies without paying is right or wrong?
questions.zh: 你觉得不付费下载音乐或电影是对还是错？

questions.en: How difficult would it be for you to lose your sense of taste?
questions.zh: 如果失去味觉，对你来说会有多难接受？

questions.en: How do you usually keep track of your place while reading a print book?
questions.zh: 读纸质书时，你通常用什么方法记住自己读到哪一页？

questions.en: How do you feel when a TV program is interrupted by a special news bulletin?
questions.zh: 电视节目突然被突发新闻打断时，你通常有什么感觉？

questions.en: Would you rather put together a 30,000-piece jigsaw puzzle or read a dictionary cover to cover?
questions.zh: 你宁愿拼一幅三万块的拼图，还是从头到尾读完整本词典？

questions.en: What music do you listen to when you're happy, and what do you choose when you're feeling down?
questions.zh: 开心时你会听什么音乐？心情低落时又会选什么？

questions.en: Who has been your friend longest and what do you like best about that friend?
questions.zh: 你认识时间最久的朋友是谁？你最欣赏他/她什么？

questions.en: Do you believe animals have souls?
questions.zh: 你相信动物也有灵魂吗？

questions.en: Have you ever visited a casino?
questions.zh: 你去过赌场吗？

questions.en: Where did you live when attending university?
questions.zh: 上大学时你住在哪里？

questions.en: How do you feel about populist political movements?
questions.zh: 你怎么看民粹主义的政治运动？

questions.en: Should music be part of a well-rounded education?
questions.zh: 你觉得音乐应该成为全面教育的一部分吗？

questions.en: How does TV affect kids' attitudes, values, and behavior?
questions.zh: 你觉得电视会怎样影响孩子的态度、价值观和行为？

questions.en: What animal would you like to be reincarnated as?
questions.zh: 如果可以转世成一种动物，你想变成什么？

questions.en: What kind of grades did you get throughout school?
questions.zh: 你上学时的成绩大致怎么样？

questions.en: Have you ever gone back to visit your old school?
questions.zh: 你有没有回母校看过？

questions.en: What song best captures an experience or feeling you had?
questions.zh: 哪首歌最能代表你经历过的一段体验或一种感受？

questions.en: What, in your opinion, is the most misunderstood song lyric?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪一句歌词最常被人误解？

questions.en: What fairy tale or children's book character do you relate to?
questions.zh: 你最能共鸣的是哪个童话或儿童读物角色？

questions.en: What performers did you see in concert when you were young?
questions.zh: 你年轻时现场看过哪些歌手或乐队的演出？

questions.en: What singer or band do you currently listen to the most?
questions.zh: 你最近最常听哪位歌手或哪个乐队？

questions.en: What were your school's colours, emblem, chants and song?
questions.zh: 你中学时的校色、校徽、助威口号和校歌分别是什么？

questions.en: Which actress and actor deserve Oscars who have never won one?
questions.zh: 你觉得有哪些从未得过奥斯卡的男女演员其实最应该获奖？

questions.en: Did you ever perform in a local theater or civic organization show?
questions.zh: 你有没有参加过当地剧团或社区组织的演出？

questions.en: In a film about your life, who would play the main characters?
questions.zh: 如果把你的人生拍成电影，你会选谁来演主要角色？

questions.en: On what subject(s) would you like to write a book or article?
questions.zh: 如果写一本书或一篇文章，你最想写什么主题？

questions.en: What specific book(s) would you like to read within the next year?
questions.zh: 未来一年里，你最想读哪些具体的书？

questions.en: Which actor or actress deserves to play you in an A&E Biography?
questions.zh: 如果有人为你拍一部人物传记，你希望由哪位演员来演你？

questions.en: What event in your life would you like to write a song about?
questions.zh: 你人生中的哪件事最值得写成一首歌？

questions.en: Why were you given your name and does it have a special meaning?
questions.zh: 你的名字是怎么取的？它有什么特别的含义吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in not allowing kids to see certain movies and TV shows?
questions.zh: 你赞成限制孩子观看某些电影和电视节目吗？

questions.en: What front-row seats would you like to have for a singer or musical group?
questions.zh: 如果能拿到前排座位，你最想看哪位歌手或哪个乐队？

questions.en: Does it usually take you a long time or short time to read a book?
questions.zh: 你读完一本书通常很快，还是会花比较长时间？

questions.en: If you could watch only one hour of TV a week, what would you watch?
questions.zh: 如果一周只能看一个小时电视，你会看什么？

questions.en: How do you regard such things as pierced noses etc. - offensive or just bad taste?
questions.zh: 你怎么看穿鼻环之类的装扮——觉得冒犯，还是只是审美不合？

questions.en: Is there usually a TV on in your house no matter what time of day it is?
questions.zh: 你家里是不是不管一天什么时间都常常开着电视？

questions.en: If you were paid to write a new book on any subject you wished, what would it be about?
questions.zh: 如果有人付钱让你随意选一个主题写书，你会写什么？

questions.en: Do you pay to check in luggage/baggage on a flight or do you make sure you always use a carryon?
questions.zh: 坐飞机时你会付费托运行李，还是尽量只带随身行李？

questions.en: Do you have an ultimate career goal?
questions.zh: 你有最终想实现的职业目标吗？

questions.en: Do you have any advice on choosing a career?
questions.zh: 对于选择职业，你有什么建议？

questions.en: What room(s) do you like to gather in with friends?
questions.zh: 朋友来家里时，你最喜欢在哪个房间一起待着？

questions.en: What do you do when people don't admit that they are wrong?
questions.zh: 别人明明错了却不肯承认时，你通常会怎么办？

questions.en: What do you do most frequently when you think no one is looking?
questions.zh: 当你以为没人注意时，你最常做什么？

questions.en: What's your favorite website?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪个网站？

questions.en: Would you like to visit Antarctica?
questions.zh: 你想去南极洲旅行吗？

questions.en: What was the worst holiday of your life?
questions.zh: 你经历过最糟糕的一次节日是什么？

questions.en: What should the next Olympic sport be and why?
questions.zh: 你觉得下一个进入奥运会的项目应该是什么？为什么？

questions.en: Would you go to a nudist beach or camp?
questions.zh: 你会去裸体海滩或裸体营地吗？

questions.en: How much would you pay to be a space tourist?
questions.zh: 如果能当太空游客，你最多愿意花多少钱？

questions.en: What things do you display when friends come to visit?
questions.zh: 朋友来访时，你会特别摆出或展示哪些东西？

questions.en: What's one of the sports you really enjoy watching or playing?
questions.zh: 说一种你特别喜欢观看或参与的运动。

questions.en: What recreational game or sport would you like to play with others?
questions.zh: 你最想和别人一起玩哪种休闲游戏或运动？

questions.en: What thought or sentiment would you like to put in fortune cookies?
questions.zh: 如果能在幸运饼干里放一句话，你会写什么？

questions.en: What magazine would you like to see on every coffee table in the country?
questions.zh: 你希望全国每张咖啡桌上都能看到哪本杂志？

questions.en: What sport do you think is the most dangerous and would you try it?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪项运动最危险？你自己会尝试吗？

questions.en: What was your favorite place to do homework and what were your homework rituals?
questions.zh: 你以前最喜欢在哪里写作业？当时有什么固定习惯？

questions.en: How old should an athlete be before clubs or universities can recruit them?
questions.zh: 你觉得运动员到几岁，俱乐部或大学才适合开始招募他们？

questions.en: If you wrote a children's book, what would be your choice of setting and main character?
questions.zh: 如果你写一本儿童书，会把故事设定在哪里？主角会是谁？

questions.en: Your child has talent but wants to quit music lessons because of the hard work; do you relent?
questions.zh: 如果孩子很有天赋，却因为练习太辛苦想放弃音乐课，你会同意吗？

questions.en: Do you use a print dictionary or online dictionary or other online source to look up words? Do you use any print reference books?
questions.zh: 查单词时，你更常用纸质词典、在线词典，还是其他网络工具？你还会用纸质参考书吗？

questions.en: Do you love your work?
questions.zh: 你热爱自己的工作吗？

questions.en: Do you socialize with coworkers?
questions.zh: 你会和同事在工作之外来往吗？

questions.en: Do you confuse yourself with your job?
questions.zh: 你会不会把“自己是谁”和“自己的工作”混为一谈？

questions.en: Do you play video games at work?
questions.zh: 你会在工作时玩电子游戏吗？

questions.en: Do you use your talents at work?
questions.zh: 你能在工作中充分发挥自己的才能吗？

questions.en: Do you look forward to or dread retirement?
questions.zh: 你期待退休，还是有点害怕退休？

questions.en: Do you stay later at work than intended?
questions.zh: 你会不会经常在公司待得比原计划更晚？

questions.en: Do you get excited when talking about your work?
questions.zh: 谈起自己的工作时，你会感到兴奋吗？

questions.en: Do you live and work in the same town?
questions.zh: 你住的地方和工作的地方在同一个城镇吗？

questions.en: Do you define yourself by your job or other things?
questions.zh: 你更倾向于用职业定义自己，还是用生活中的其他部分定义自己？

questions.en: Do you take shortcuts to get your work done fast?
questions.zh: 为了更快完成工作，你会走捷径吗？

questions.en: Do you use your computer more for work or play?
questions.zh: 你的电脑主要用来工作，还是娱乐？

questions.en: What do you have in and on your office desk?
questions.zh: 你的办公桌上和抽屉里通常放些什么？

questions.en: What type of work would you like to be doing five years from now?
questions.zh: 五年后你希望自己在做什么样的工作？

questions.en: What do you do while you are on the phone?
questions.zh: 打电话时你通常还会同时做什么？

questions.en: If animals could talk, would you be able to understand them?
questions.zh: 如果动物会说话，你觉得自己能听懂它们吗？

questions.en: What was the last book you read and why did you choose it?
questions.zh: 你最近读完的一本书是什么？为什么会选它？

questions.en: Are there foods, smells, flavors, sounds, songs, etc. that bring back memories of your childhood?
questions.zh: 有没有某些食物、气味、味道、声音或歌曲，会一下子勾起你的童年回忆？

questions.en: What do you think of fast-food chains and theme parks expanding all over the world?
questions.zh: 你怎么看快餐连锁店和主题公园在世界各地不断扩张？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward those who download music or movies without paying?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对不付费下载音乐或电影的人应该更宽容，还是更严厉？

questions.en: Have you ever rated a product, restaurant, service, etc. online? Are your reviews or ratings mainly positive or negative?
questions.zh: 你有没有在网上评价过产品、餐厅或服务？你的评价通常偏正面还是负面？

questions.en: Have you ever consulted: horoscopes, a palm reader, tarot cards, runes, Chinese astrology, a psychic, tea leaves, or I Ching?
questions.zh: 你有没有咨询过星座、手相、塔罗牌、卢恩符文、中国命理、灵媒、茶叶占卜或《易经》之类的东西？

questions.en: If you could have any television program back, not in reruns but in new episodes, which program would it be?
questions.zh: 如果可以让一档已经停播的电视节目重新拍新集数，你会选哪一档？

questions.en: Are you superstitious about a black cat crossing your path, walking under a ladder, the number 13 or 666, breaking a mirror, or knocking on wood?
questions.zh: 你会忌讳黑猫横穿眼前、从梯子下面走过、数字13或666、打碎镜子，或者会敲木头求好运吗？

questions.en: Could you see yourself retiring to a university town?
questions.zh: 你会考虑退休后住在大学城吗？

questions.en: Did you have to work during university?
questions.zh: 你上大学时需要一边读书一边工作吗？

questions.en: Where did you get started in your career?
questions.zh: 你的职业生涯最开始是从哪里起步的？

questions.en: Where does honesty work well in your life?
questions.zh: 在你生活的哪些方面，诚实最能带来好结果？

questions.en: What kind of praise do you like to receive?
questions.zh: 你喜欢别人怎样赞美你？

questions.en: Where do you want to retire and with what people?
questions.zh: 你退休后想住在哪里？希望和哪些人在一起？

questions.en: How often do you use mouthwash and which kind do you like?
questions.zh: 你多久用一次漱口水？最喜欢哪一种？

questions.en: Do you have the personality and patience to work with children with disabilities?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己有足够的性格和耐心与残障儿童一起工作吗？

questions.en: What jewelry do you like to wear and what do you not like to wear?
questions.zh: 你喜欢佩戴什么首饰？哪些首饰你不喜欢戴？

questions.en: Do you prefer company or solitude?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢有人陪伴，还是独处？

questions.en: Do you prefer cremation or burial?
questions.zh: 你更倾向于火葬还是土葬？

questions.en: Do you prefer day or night?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢白天还是夜晚？

questions.en: Do you prefer summer or winter?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢夏天还是冬天？

questions.en: Do you prefer sunrise or sunset?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢日出还是日落？

questions.en: Which entertainer has the best voice?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪位艺人的嗓音最好？

questions.en: Which gender has the easiest lifestyle?
questions.zh: 你觉得男性和女性中，哪一方的生活方式更轻松？

questions.en: Did you prefer English or science class?
questions.zh: 你上学时更喜欢英语课还是科学课？

questions.en: Do you prefer clean or dirty jokes?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢健康干净的笑话，还是带点粗俗的笑话？

questions.en: Do you prefer quiet or vivid paintings?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢安静素雅的画，还是色彩鲜明的画？

questions.en: How would you prefer not to die?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你最不希望以什么方式离世？

questions.en: What was your highest score in bowling?
questions.zh: 你打保龄球的最高分是多少？

questions.en: Which gender do you prefer as bosses?
questions.zh: 如果选上司，你更喜欢男性还是女性？

questions.en: Which gender do you prefer as subordinates?
questions.zh: 如果是下属，你更喜欢男性还是女性？

questions.en: Which shoe do you put on first?
questions.zh: 穿鞋时你通常先穿哪只脚？

questions.en: Do you prefer being alone or with someone?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢独处，还是有人陪伴？

questions.en: Do you prefer positions of leadership and authority?
questions.zh: 你喜欢担任领导或拥有决策权的位置吗？

questions.en: Do you prefer small groups or big parties?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢小范围聚会，还是大型派对？

questions.en: Do you prefer wood floors, carpeting, or tile?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢木地板、地毯还是瓷砖？

questions.en: Do you remember your secondary school locker combination?
questions.zh: 你还记得高中储物柜的密码吗？

questions.en: Do you think kids watch too much television?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子看电视的时间是不是太多了？

questions.en: Which would you like more: fame or success?
questions.zh: 名气和成功相比，你更想要哪一个？

questions.en: Do you remember an incident in a school lunchroom?
questions.zh: 你还记得学校食堂里发生过什么特别的事吗？

questions.en: Which of life's mysteries are you most curious about?
questions.zh: 人生的哪些未解之谜最让你好奇？

questions.en: During the holiday season, when does your festive mood peak?
questions.zh: 在节日季里，你什么时候最有过节的气氛？

questions.en: What do you think about kids taking up extreme sports?
questions.zh: 你怎么看孩子参加极限运动？

questions.en: Why are you not a vegetarian or not a meat-eater?
questions.zh: 你为什么没有选择吃素，或者为什么没有选择吃肉？

questions.en: How long before your flight do you arrive at the airport?
questions.zh: 坐飞机时，你通常会提前多久到机场？

questions.en: Do you ever reread books? What makes one worth going back to?
questions.zh: 你有没有重读过一本书？什么情况下会让你想再读一遍？

questions.en: What do you wish you had started to learn as a kid?
questions.zh: 有什么东西是你希望小时候就开始学的？

questions.en: What is the best finish to a match you have ever seen?
questions.zh: 你看过结局最精彩的一场比赛是什么？

questions.en: What would you hope to find if you traveled into outer space?
questions.zh: 如果能去外太空旅行，你最希望在那里发现什么？

questions.en: What's the farthest distance you traveled to be with someone you desired?
questions.zh: 为了见一个自己很想见的人，你最远走过多远？

questions.en: Who is or was the most courageous athlete you can think of?
questions.zh: 你能想到最有勇气的运动员是谁？

questions.en: If a man asks a woman to dinner, do you think he should pay?
questions.zh: 如果男性邀请女性吃晚餐，你觉得应该由男方买单吗？

questions.en: What job would you most or least like to have during the holiday season?
questions.zh: 节日期间，你最想做和最不想做的工作分别是什么？

questions.en: Do you think there is a significant nutritional difference between organic food and processed food?
questions.zh: 你觉得有机食品和加工食品在营养上有明显差别吗？

questions.en: If pills fulfilled nutrition and nourishment, would you take them and give up eating and cooking?
questions.zh: 如果一颗药丸就能提供全部营养，你愿意靠它生活、放弃吃饭和做饭吗？

questions.en: If you record a television show, do you fast forward through the commercials or watch them?
questions.zh: 录下电视节目后，你会快进跳过广告，还是照样看？

questions.en: When playing sports, do you prefer competing against someone who is worse or better than you?
questions.zh: 参加体育比赛时，你更喜欢和比自己弱的人竞争，还是和比自己强的人竞争？

questions.en: If a wind farm can be seen from the beach or shore, should it still be built?
questions.zh: 如果海上风力发电场会从海滩或海岸看到，你觉得还应该建设吗？

questions.en: How many teams should a national championship play-off include to settle who is best?
questions.zh: 你觉得全国冠军赛的季后赛应该有多少支球队，才能合理决出第一名？

questions.en: If you had fifteen minutes of prime-time TV, how would you use it and what message would you share?
questions.zh: 如果给你十五分钟黄金时段的电视时间，你会怎么用？最想传达什么信息？

questions.en: In an airport or on a train are you one of the people who is always staring at a device?
questions.zh: 在机场或火车上，你会不会一直盯着手机或其他电子设备？

questions.en: Which professional sports team would you like to coach and what would you do the first week on the job?
questions.zh: 如果让你执教一支职业球队，你会选哪支？上任第一周会做什么？

questions.en: If you got conflicting news reports, which source would you be most inclined to believe: radio, TV, magazines, newspapers, or the internet?
questions.zh: 如果不同媒体的新闻报道互相矛盾，你更愿意相信广播、电视、杂志、报纸还是互联网？

questions.en: If you stopped watching TV for a year, what would you do with the extra time and what would you miss most on TV?
questions.zh: 如果一年完全不看电视，你会用多出来的时间做什么？又会最想念电视里的什么？

questions.en: If you saw a celebrity or sports star in public, would you take their picture and post it online? Would you ask for an autograph?
questions.zh: 如果在公共场合遇到名人或体育明星，你会拍照发到网上吗？会向对方要签名吗？

questions.en: Are you a person who enjoys the pauses in life that occur while traveling or waiting in line so you can meditate, think, or reflect on life?
questions.zh: 旅行或排队等待时，你会享受这些空档，用来思考、沉淀或反省吗？

questions.en: What's your dream retirement?
questions.zh: 你理想中的退休生活是什么样？

questions.en: Do you have a favorite quotation?
questions.zh: 你有最喜欢的一句名言吗？

questions.en: Do you have an organized wallet?
questions.zh: 你的钱包整理得井井有条吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in organized labor?
questions.zh: 你对工会制度有信心吗？

questions.en: How stressful is your job these days?
questions.zh: 你最近工作压力大吗？

questions.en: What's your favorite day of the workweek?
questions.zh: 一周工作日里，你最喜欢哪一天？

questions.en: Which work-style quality matters most to you?
questions.zh: 在工作方式上，你最看重哪一种品质？

questions.en: What's your favorite thing to do after work?
questions.zh: 下班后你最喜欢做什么？

questions.en: Do you have a landline telephone in your house?
questions.zh: 你家里还有固定电话吗？

questions.en: What do you like to change into after work?
questions.zh: 下班回家后，你最喜欢换成什么样的衣服？

questions.en: What's your best excuse for not going to work?
questions.zh: 如果不想去上班，你最拿手的借口是什么？

questions.en: Would you rather be a student or an employee?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当学生，还是当上班族？

questions.en: Do you ever use the internet at work for non-work reasons?
questions.zh: 你会不会在工作时间用互联网处理与工作无关的事情？

questions.en: Do you have a hard time waking up in the morning?
questions.zh: 你早上很难起床吗？

questions.en: Do you consider your work an escape from the pressures of home?
questions.zh: 你会把工作当成逃离家庭压力的一种方式吗？

questions.en: Would you rather work for a national security agency or a space agency?
questions.zh: 如果二选一，你更愿意去国家安全机构工作，还是去航天机构？

questions.en: Where did you go to school?
questions.zh: 你以前在哪里上学？

questions.en: Do you like being on the phone?
questions.zh: 你喜欢打电话聊天吗？

questions.en: What big university events do you recall?
questions.zh: 你还记得大学期间哪些重要活动？

questions.en: What love relationships did you have in university?
questions.zh: 你上大学时有过怎样的恋爱经历？

questions.en: Where did your secondary school crowd hang out?
questions.zh: 你高中时那群朋友通常在哪里聚会？

questions.en: Who are some famous graduates of your university?
questions.zh: 你的大学有哪些知名校友？

questions.en: How and where did you hang out in university?
questions.zh: 你上大学时通常在哪里、怎么和朋友聚会？

questions.en: Have you ever attended a secondary school or university reunion?
questions.zh: 你参加过高中或大学同学会吗？

questions.en: How do you prefer that affection is expressed toward you?
questions.zh: 你希望别人用什么方式向你表达亲近和关爱？

questions.en: Do you have a special memory of Sunday school or confirmation?
questions.zh: 你对主日学或坚信礼课程有没有特别的回忆？

questions.en: What was your major in university and how did you pick it?
questions.zh: 你大学读什么专业？当初为什么选它？

questions.en: With books: do you read the last page first? Do you skip ahead?
questions.zh: 读书时你会先看最后一页吗？会跳着往后看吗？

questions.en: What do you think the federal funding of public TV and radio should be?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府应该如何资助公共电视和公共广播？

questions.en: What TV shows do your kids watch? What are their favorites now and in the past?
questions.zh: 你的孩子现在看哪些电视节目？他们现在和以前分别最喜欢什么？

questions.en: Which current celebrities do you think will be remembered in fifty years as legends and why?
questions.zh: 你觉得现在有哪些名人五十年后仍会被当作传奇人物？为什么？

questions.en: If you could be either a popular singer or a successful writer, which would you choose and why?
questions.zh: 如果只能二选一，你愿意成为受欢迎的歌手，还是成功的作家？为什么？

questions.en: Do you snore?
questions.zh: 你会打鼾吗？

questions.en: Do you crave excitement?
questions.zh: 你喜欢追求刺激吗？

questions.en: Do you establish routines?
questions.zh: 你喜欢建立固定的生活规律吗？

questions.en: Do you expect miracles?
questions.zh: 你会期待奇迹发生吗？

questions.en: Do you hate anyone?
questions.zh: 你有没有特别讨厌的人？

questions.en: Do you hoard magazines?
questions.zh: 你会囤积杂志吗？

questions.en: Do you photograph well?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己上镜吗？

questions.en: Do you play cards?
questions.zh: 你会玩纸牌吗？

questions.en: Do you recycle batteries?
questions.zh: 你会回收废旧电池吗？

questions.en: Do you use coupons?
questions.zh: 你会使用优惠券吗？

questions.en: Are you working too hard?
questions.zh: 你是不是工作得太拼了？

questions.en: Do you avoid eye contact?
questions.zh: 你会刻意避免眼神接触吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in fate?
questions.zh: 你相信命运吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in miracles?
questions.zh: 你相信奇迹吗？

questions.en: Do you bite your fingernails?
questions.zh: 你会咬指甲吗？

questions.en: Do you buy brand-name clothes?
questions.zh: 你买衣服会偏爱知名品牌吗？

questions.en: Do you buy energy-efficient lightbulbs?
questions.zh: 你会购买节能灯泡吗？

questions.en: Do you call yourself ambitious?
questions.zh: 你会把自己形容成一个有野心的人吗？

questions.en: Do you color your hair?
questions.zh: 你会染头发吗？

questions.en: Do you do crossword puzzles?
questions.zh: 你会做填字游戏吗？

questions.en: Do you miss record albums?
questions.zh: 你会怀念黑胶唱片的时代吗？

questions.en: Do you pick your nose?
questions.zh: 你会挖鼻孔吗？

questions.en: Do you play the lottery?
questions.zh: 你会买彩票吗？

questions.en: Do you remember your chores?
questions.zh: 你还记得小时候负责过哪些家务吗？

questions.en: Do you tan or burn?
questions.zh: 晒太阳时你容易晒黑还是晒伤？

questions.en: Do you usually feel self-confident?
questions.zh: 你通常对自己有信心吗？

questions.en: Do you watch soap operas?
questions.zh: 你会看肥皂剧吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in self-fulfilling prophecies?
questions.zh: 你相信“自我实现的预言”吗？

questions.en: Do you buy anything in bulk?
questions.zh: 你会一次性大量购买某些东西吗？

questions.en: Do you buy only "cruelty-free" products?
questions.zh: 你会只买标明“无动物伤害”的产品吗？

questions.en: Do you ever have cruel fantasies?
questions.zh: 你有没有过很残酷或黑暗的幻想？

questions.en: Do you express your opinions strongly?
questions.zh: 你表达自己的观点时会很强势吗？

questions.en: Do you make the bed daily?
questions.zh: 你每天都会整理床铺吗？

questions.en: Do you meet or miss deadlines?
questions.zh: 你通常能按时完成任务，还是容易错过截止日期？

questions.en: Do you own any domain names?
questions.zh: 你拥有自己的域名吗？

questions.en: Do you pick up after yourself?
questions.zh: 你会随手收拾自己用过的东西吗？

questions.en: Do you prepare thoroughly for tests?
questions.zh: 考试前你会认真充分准备吗？

questions.en: Do you put your interests first?
questions.zh: 做决定时，你会把自己的利益放在第一位吗？

questions.en: Do you tend to lose things?
questions.zh: 你是不是经常丢东西？

questions.en: Do you text using your thumbs?
questions.zh: 你发短信时主要用两个拇指打字吗？

questions.en: Do you think televangelists are trustworthy?
questions.zh: 你觉得电视布道者值得信任吗？

questions.en: Do you use an alarm clock?
questions.zh: 你会用闹钟吗？

questions.en: Do you write down your ideas?
questions.zh: 你会把自己的想法记下来吗？

questions.en: Do you write letters or postcards?
questions.zh: 你还会写信或寄明信片吗？

questions.en: Do you ask for or accept help?
questions.zh: 你会主动寻求帮助，也愿意接受别人帮助吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in the Ten Commandments?
questions.zh: 你认同《十诫》吗？

questions.en: Do you button shirts top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top?
questions.zh: 扣衬衫扣子时，你从上往下还是从下往上？

questions.en: Do you concentrate on one great cause?
questions.zh: 你会把主要精力投入到某一个特别重要的事业或议题上吗？

questions.en: Do you ever try to shock people?
questions.zh: 你会故意做些事情让别人吃惊吗？

questions.en: Do you get an annual flu shot?
questions.zh: 你每年会打流感疫苗吗？

questions.en: Do you give money to homeless people?
questions.zh: 你会给无家可归的人钱吗？

questions.en: Do you keep a sketchbook or diary?
questions.zh: 你会记素描本或日记吗？

questions.en: Do you prefer odd or even numbers?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢奇数还是偶数？

questions.en: Do you prefer to watch or participate?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢当观众，还是亲自参与？

questions.en: Do you put down the toilet seat?
questions.zh: 你用完马桶后会把坐垫放下吗？

questions.en: Do you question "conventional wisdom" and authority?
questions.zh: 你会质疑所谓的“常识”和权威吗？

questions.en: Do you refuse to cross picket lines?
questions.zh: 遇到罢工纠察线时，你会拒绝越过吗？

questions.en: Do you shave your legs and underarms?
questions.zh: 你会刮腿毛和腋毛吗？

questions.en: Do you stand or walk on escalators?
questions.zh: 坐扶梯时你通常站着，还是继续往前走？

questions.en: Do you talk particularly fast or slow?
questions.zh: 你说话速度通常特别快、特别慢，还是正常？

questions.en: Do you use deodorant, antiperspirant, or both?
questions.zh: 你会用除臭剂、止汗剂，还是两种都会用？

questions.en: Do you watch professional All-Star sporting events?
questions.zh: 你会看职业体育的全明星赛吗？

questions.en: Do you write letters to the editor?
questions.zh: 你会给报纸或杂志编辑写信表达意见吗？

questions.en: Are you a retirement village type of person?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己适合住退休社区吗？

questions.en: Do you believe a house can be haunted?
questions.zh: 你相信房子可能闹鬼吗？

questions.en: Do you give up your seat to others?
questions.zh: 在公共交通上你会给别人让座吗？

questions.en: Do you hold stronger opinions than most people?
questions.zh: 你的观点通常比大多数人更强烈吗？

questions.en: Do you own a flag and display it?
questions.zh: 你有国旗吗？会把它挂出来吗？

questions.en: Do you own, rent, or borrow camping equipment?
questions.zh: 露营装备你更愿意买、租还是向别人借？

questions.en: Do you paddle with or against the current?
questions.zh: 面对潮流或主流意见时，你更倾向于顺势而行还是逆流而上？

questions.en: Do you prefer a bath or a shower?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢泡澡还是淋浴？

questions.en: Do you prefer typing or writing by hand?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢打字，还是手写？

questions.en: Do you raise your hand and ask questions?
questions.zh: 在课堂或会议上，你会举手提问吗？

questions.en: Do you replace the toilet paper roll immediately?
questions.zh: 厕纸用完后你会马上换上新的一卷吗？

questions.en: Do you seek out new experiences every day?
questions.zh: 你每天都会主动寻找新的体验吗？

questions.en: Do you stay in touch with your exes?
questions.zh: 你还会和前任保持联系吗？

questions.en: Do you take others' behavior at face value?
questions.zh: 你会直接按表面意思理解别人的行为，还是会怀疑背后还有原因？

questions.en: Do you use a night-light or no light?
questions.zh: 睡觉时你会开小夜灯，还是完全关灯？

questions.en: Do you use an umbrella when it rains?
questions.zh: 下雨时你会打伞吗？

questions.en: Do you use swear words frequently or infrequently?
questions.zh: 你平时说脏话的频率高吗？

questions.en: Do you usually pay your bills on time?
questions.zh: 你通常会按时付账单吗？

questions.en: Do you value your time or waste it?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己是在珍惜时间，还是经常浪费时间？

questions.en: Are you too amenable or too good-natured at work?
questions.zh: 你在工作中会不会太随和、太好说话？

questions.en: Do you always want to have the last word?
questions.zh: 你是不是总想在争论中说最后一句？

questions.en: Do you analyze so much that you become immobilized?
questions.zh: 你会不会因为分析得太多，反而什么都做不了？

questions.en: Do you confide in someone on a daily basis?
questions.zh: 你每天都会找一个人倾诉心事吗？

questions.en: Do you floss regularly, sporadically, or not at all?
questions.zh: 你会规律使用牙线、偶尔使用，还是完全不用？

questions.en: Do you follow how the stock market is doing?
questions.zh: 你会关注股市走势吗？

questions.en: Do you go on roller coasters at amusement parks?
questions.zh: 去游乐园时你会坐过山车吗？

questions.en: Do you lose things or know where everything is?
questions.zh: 你经常丢东西，还是总能知道每样东西在哪里？

questions.en: Do you often have several projects going at once?
questions.zh: 你会不会同时进行好几个项目？

questions.en: Do you rinse out toothpaste remains in the sink?
questions.zh: 刷完牙后，你会把洗手池里残留的牙膏冲干净吗？

questions.en: Do you set your watch exactly, ahead, or behind?
questions.zh: 你的手表会调成完全准确、快几分钟，还是慢几分钟？

questions.en: Do you try innovations or stick to tested methods?
questions.zh: 遇到新方法时你会尝试创新，还是坚持经过验证的做法？

questions.en: Do you try to live by The Golden Rule?
questions.zh: 你会努力按照“己所不欲，勿施于人”的原则生活吗？

questions.en: Do you use a brush, a comb, or both?
questions.zh: 整理头发时你用梳子、发刷，还是两者都用？

questions.en: Do you write with expensive or cheap disposable pens?
questions.zh: 你写字会用比较贵的笔，还是便宜的一次性笔？

questions.en: Do you agree with the saying, 'Life begins at forty'?
questions.zh: 你赞同“人生四十才开始”这句话吗？

questions.en: Do you do your share or more than your share?
questions.zh: 做集体事情时，你通常只做自己那一份，还是会多做一点？

questions.en: Do you put your right or left sock on first?
questions.zh: 穿袜子时你通常先穿右脚还是左脚？

questions.en: Do you try to change someone when your opinions differ?
questions.zh: 当你和别人意见不同时，你会试图改变对方吗？

questions.en: Do you use a hair dryer or air-dry your hair?
questions.zh: 你会用吹风机吹头发，还是自然晾干？

questions.en: Do you value others' time as much as your own?
questions.zh: 你会像重视自己的时间一样重视别人的时间吗？

questions.en: Do you want others to act the way you do?
questions.zh: 你会希望别人都按你的方式做事吗？

questions.en: Do you wear makeup all the time or only sometimes?
questions.zh: 你会一直化妆，还是只在某些时候化妆？

questions.en: Do you believe in the idea of 'every person for themselves'?
questions.zh: 你认同“人不为己，天诛地灭”这种想法吗？

questions.en: Do you change your mind often or stick to your guns?
questions.zh: 你会经常改变主意，还是一旦决定就坚持到底？

questions.en: Do you do what you say you are going to do?
questions.zh: 你答应要做的事情通常都会做到吗？

questions.en: Do you drink water from a tap or use bottled water?
questions.zh: 你平时喝自来水还是瓶装水？

questions.en: Do you go on the roller coaster at the amusement park?
questions.zh: 去游乐园时你会坐过山车吗？

questions.en: Do you leave dishes in the sink, clothes on the floor?
questions.zh: 你会把碗留在水槽里、衣服扔在地上吗？

questions.en: Do you take initiative or just do what you are told?
questions.zh: 你会主动承担事情，还是别人让你做什么你才做什么？

questions.en: Do you turn off the lights when you leave a room?
questions.zh: 离开房间时你会关灯吗？

questions.en: Do you usually RSVP, or do you sometimes forget to respond?
questions.zh: 收到邀请后你通常会及时回复，还是有时会忘记？

questions.en: Do you wash the dishes by hand or in a dishwasher?
questions.zh: 你洗碗更常用手洗，还是洗碗机？

questions.en: Do you look at your email right before you go to bed?
questions.zh: 睡前你会再检查一次电子邮件吗？

questions.en: Do you tie and untie shoes or slip them on and off?
questions.zh: 穿鞋时你会每次解开再系鞋带，还是直接套上脱下？

questions.en: Do you want an open seat next to you on an airplane?
questions.zh: 坐飞机时，你希望旁边的座位空着吗？

questions.en: Do you find it easy to do more than one thing at once?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己能轻松同时处理多件事情吗？

questions.en: Do you think nature or nurture has more influence on who we become?
questions.zh: 你觉得先天和后天环境，哪一个对人成为什么样的人影响更大？

questions.en: When do you prefer to study?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢在什么时间学习？

questions.en: Should libraries get free books from publishers?
questions.zh: 你觉得出版社应该免费向图书馆提供书籍吗？

questions.en: What's your most vivid memory of primary school?
questions.zh: 你对小学最清晰的一段记忆是什么？

questions.en: Do you post things online? What type of content?
questions.zh: 你会在网上发布内容吗？通常发什么？

questions.en: What should the consequences be for athletes using steroids?
questions.zh: 你觉得使用类固醇的运动员应该承担什么后果？

questions.en: Do you prefer the Winter Olympics or the Summer Olympics?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢冬季奥运会还是夏季奥运会？

questions.en: Do you think reality television people should be considered stars?
questions.zh: 你觉得真人秀参加者应该被视为明星吗？

questions.en: Do you think reality television will last for a long time?
questions.zh: 你觉得真人秀电视节目还会流行很久吗？

questions.en: What was your best golf score and what was the course like?
questions.zh: 你打高尔夫的最好成绩是多少？那座球场怎么样？

questions.en: Do you prefer the people in your life to be simple or complex?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢生活中的人简单直接，还是性格复杂有层次？

questions.en: What do you remember of the lessons you were taught in primary school?
questions.zh: 小学时学过的课程内容，你现在还记得些什么？

questions.en: How much do you spend on coffee per day? How much should you spend on coffee per day?
questions.zh: 你每天大概花多少钱买咖啡？你觉得合理的金额应该是多少？

questions.en: In 2050, how do you think people will cross oceans and how long will a transatlantic trip take?
questions.zh: 你觉得到了2050年，人们会用什么方式跨越大洋？一次跨大西洋旅行会需要多久？

questions.en: Do you usually make restaurant reservations or take your chances with getting in? How do you make restaurant reservations, by calling or reserving online?
questions.zh: 去餐厅时你通常提前订位，还是直接去碰运气？你更常打电话订还是网上订？

questions.en: Have you ever run for any office?
questions.zh: 你有没有竞选过任何公职或组织职位？

questions.en: Have you ever taken supplies from work?
questions.zh: 你有没有从工作场所拿过办公用品回家？

questions.en: Have you ever wanted your boss's job?
questions.zh: 你有没有想过取代自己的老板？

questions.en: Have you ever been discriminated against at work?
questions.zh: 你有没有在工作中遭受过歧视？

questions.en: Have you ever lied to get a job?
questions.zh: 你有没有为了得到一份工作而撒过谎？

questions.en: Have you ever lied to keep your job?
questions.zh: 你有没有为了保住工作而撒过谎？

questions.en: Have you ever dated anybody you met at work?
questions.zh: 你有没有和在工作中认识的人约会过？

questions.en: Have you ever made personal phone calls from work?
questions.zh: 你有没有在上班时打过私人电话？

questions.en: Have you ever been a victim of harassment on the job?
questions.zh: 你有没有在工作中遭遇过骚扰？

questions.en: Would you rather work for a pleasant boss or for yourself?
questions.zh: 你宁愿为一个好相处的老板工作，还是自己当老板？

questions.en: Would you rather receive daily encouragement from your boss or a 5 percent raise?
questions.zh: 你宁愿每天得到老板的鼓励，还是直接加薪5%？

questions.en: Would you rather work outdoors with your hands or indoors at a desk job?
questions.zh: 你宁愿在户外做动手的工作，还是在室内坐办公室？

questions.en: Would you rather drive a tank during a war or work on an aircraft carrier?
questions.zh: 如果在战争中二选一，你宁愿开坦克还是在航空母舰上工作？

questions.en: Would you rather work at a job that was challenging or one that was easy?
questions.zh: 你宁愿做有挑战性的工作，还是相对轻松的工作？

questions.en: Would you rather work hard to gain what you want or have it given to you?
questions.zh: 你更愿意努力争取得到想要的东西，还是直接得到它？

questions.en: Do you like working with a tablet computer? Do you like it better than a laptop or desktop computer?
questions.zh: 你喜欢用平板电脑工作吗？相比笔记本或台式机，你更喜欢平板吗？

questions.en: Have you ever cried at work?
questions.zh: 你有没有在工作时哭过？

questions.en: Should student athletes be paid?
questions.zh: 你觉得学生运动员应该获得报酬吗？

questions.en: Should sports stars be role models?
questions.zh: 你觉得体育明星应该成为公众榜样吗？

questions.en: Did you get along with your first-year roommate at university?
questions.zh: 你和大学一年级的室友相处得好吗？

questions.en: Do you think genetically engineered foods are safe or dangerous?
questions.zh: 你觉得转基因食品安全还是危险？

questions.en: Do you think women should directly compete with men in sports?
questions.zh: 你觉得女性应该在体育比赛中直接和男性同场竞争吗？

questions.en: Were there any university professors who really influenced you and how?
questions.zh: 大学里有没有哪位教授真正影响了你？是怎样影响的？

questions.en: What did you do on your university winter and summer breaks?
questions.zh: 大学寒假和暑假时你通常做什么？

questions.en: Who were your first friends and relationships after university or the military?
questions.zh: 大学毕业或退伍后，你最早结识的朋友和建立的关系有哪些？

questions.en: What could you not have made it through secondary school or university without?
questions.zh: 高中或大学期间，有什么人或事是你觉得没有它就撑不过来的？

questions.en: If you went to a beach and it turned out to be a nude beach, would you stay and go swimming?
questions.zh: 如果你到了海滩才发现那里是裸体海滩，你会留下来游泳吗？

questions.en: Can nurses do doctors' work?
questions.zh: 你觉得护士能承担医生的一部分工作吗？

questions.en: How stressful is your job?
questions.zh: 你的工作压力有多大？

questions.en: Who's your favorite world leader?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢的世界领导人是谁？

questions.en: Do employees without kids work harder?
questions.zh: 你觉得没有孩子的员工工作会更努力吗？

questions.en: What charity work have you done?
questions.zh: 你做过哪些慈善或公益工作？

questions.en: What does retirement mean to you?
questions.zh: “退休”对你来说意味着什么？

questions.en: What inventions make your job easier?
questions.zh: 哪些发明或工具让你的工作更轻松？

questions.en: What makes you nervous at work?
questions.zh: 工作中什么事情最容易让你紧张？

questions.en: What was your first "real" job?
questions.zh: 你的第一份真正意义上的工作是什么？

questions.en: What was your first self-supporting job?
questions.zh: 你第一份能够养活自己的工作是什么？

questions.en: What's something satisfying about your work?
questions.zh: 你的工作中有什么事情会让你特别有成就感？

questions.en: Where's your favorite place to people-watch?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢在哪里观察来来往往的人？

questions.en: Would you move for a job?
questions.zh: 为了工作，你愿意搬到另一个地方生活吗？

questions.en: How hard do you think you work?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己工作有多努力？

questions.en: How often do you lie at work?
questions.zh: 你在工作中多常撒谎？

questions.en: What intangible benefit makes your work worthwhile?
questions.zh: 有哪些看不见的回报，让你觉得这份工作值得做？

questions.en: What problem are you working on now?
questions.zh: 你现在正在解决什么问题？

questions.en: What work assignment(s) have you particularly enjoyed?
questions.zh: 有哪些工作任务是你特别喜欢的？

questions.en: What work assignment(s) have you particularly hated?
questions.zh: 有哪些工作任务是你特别讨厌的？

questions.en: What work-life issues plague teenagers with jobs?
questions.zh: 有工作的青少年通常会遇到哪些工作与生活平衡问题？

questions.en: What would have been your dream career?
questions.zh: 你过去梦想过的职业是什么？

questions.en: What would your dream office be like?
questions.zh: 你梦想中的办公室是什么样？

questions.en: What's needed to make "work" more fun?
questions.zh: 怎样才能让“工作”变得更有趣？

questions.en: What's the current state of your career?
questions.zh: 你目前的职业发展处于什么状态？

questions.en: What's the harshest job advice you received?
questions.zh: 你听过最严厉的一条职业建议是什么？

questions.en: What's your favorite room in your home?
questions.zh: 你家里最喜欢哪个房间？

questions.en: Who's your favorite person to gossip with?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢和谁聊八卦？

questions.en: Would you rather go swimming or shopping?
questions.zh: 你宁愿去游泳还是去购物？

questions.en: At what age do you want to retire?
questions.zh: 你希望自己多少岁退休？

questions.en: Did you ever go to the principal's office?
questions.zh: 你以前有没有因为犯错被叫到校长办公室？

questions.en: Do Ouija boards or crystal balls really work?
questions.zh: 你相信通灵板或水晶球真的有效吗？

questions.en: Do you prefer a career or a job?
questions.zh: 你更想拥有一份长期职业，还是只把工作当作一份工作？

questions.en: Have any major setbacks occurred in your career(s)?
questions.zh: 你的职业生涯中发生过哪些重大挫折？

questions.en: How many hours do you work each week?
questions.zh: 你每周大概工作多少小时？

questions.en: What about you led to your career choices?
questions.zh: 你的哪些特点影响了你的职业选择？

questions.en: What does your typical daily routine look like?
questions.zh: 你一般一天的日常安排是什么样？

questions.en: What interests do you share with your coworkers?
questions.zh: 你和同事有哪些共同兴趣？

questions.en: What volunteer work would you like to do?
questions.zh: 你最想做哪一种志愿服务？

questions.en: What was the dirtiest job you ever did?
questions.zh: 你做过最脏最累的一份工作是什么？

questions.en: What would your ideal job or career be?
questions.zh: 你理想中的工作或职业是什么？

questions.en: What's an occupation you think would be fascinating?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪种职业很吸引人、很值得体验？

questions.en: What's most important to you concerning a job?
questions.zh: 对一份工作而言，你最看重什么？

questions.en: What's the most important work skill to have?
questions.zh: 你觉得工作中最重要的技能是什么？

questions.en: When was a time you lost a job?
questions.zh: 你有没有经历过失业？当时是什么情况？

questions.en: Would you go peaceably to a retirement home?
questions.zh: 如果将来需要入住养老院，你能平静接受吗？

questions.en: Would you rather wear a hairpiece or dentures?
questions.zh: 如果必须二选一，你宁愿戴假发还是戴假牙？

questions.en: Would you rather wear tight or loose pants?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢穿紧身裤还是宽松裤？

questions.en: At work, do you make most of the decisions?
questions.zh: 在工作中，大多数决定是由你来做吗？

questions.en: Do you worry that you will lose a job?
questions.zh: 你会担心失去工作吗？

questions.en: How did your level of education influence your career?
questions.zh: 你的受教育程度对职业发展产生了怎样的影响？

questions.en: How important is putting in "face time" at work?
questions.zh: 你觉得在办公室“露脸”、让别人看到自己在工作有多重要？

questions.en: How might technology affect your job in fifty years?
questions.zh: 你觉得五十年后科技会怎样影响你的职业？

questions.en: What do people at your job grumble about most?
questions.zh: 你工作中的人最常抱怨什么？

questions.en: What have been the high points of your career(s)?
questions.zh: 你的职业生涯中有哪些高光时刻？

questions.en: What honor would you like to attain at work?
questions.zh: 你希望在工作中获得什么荣誉或认可？

questions.en: What was the most unusual job you ever had?
questions.zh: 你做过最特别或最不寻常的一份工作是什么？

questions.en: What's one job you would like to have back?
questions.zh: 有没有一份以前做过的工作，你其实还想再做一次？

questions.en: What's the first work of art you remember creating?
questions.zh: 你还记得自己创作的第一件艺术作品吗？

questions.en: What's the worst work of art you ever saw?
questions.zh: 你见过最差的一件艺术作品是什么？

questions.en: Who's your best reference when applying for a job?
questions.zh: 求职时，谁最适合给你做推荐人？

questions.en: Would you put off having kids for a career?
questions.zh: 你会为了事业而推迟生孩子吗？

questions.en: Do you prefer to work alone or with a group?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢独立工作，还是和团队一起工作？

questions.en: How effective do you think efforts against organized crime are?
questions.zh: 你觉得打击有组织犯罪的努力有多有效？

questions.en: In what ways do you make your boss look good?
questions.zh: 你会通过哪些方式帮助老板显得更出色？

questions.en: What are some definite goals you are still working on?
questions.zh: 你还有哪些明确目标正在努力实现？

questions.en: What are the most popular lies people tell at work?
questions.zh: 你觉得人们在工作中最常说的谎是什么？

questions.en: What career path would you like your children to enter?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的孩子未来走什么职业道路？

questions.en: What job would you like to have for one month?
questions.zh: 如果只能体验一个月，你最想做哪一种工作？

questions.en: What motivates you most to go to work each day?
questions.zh: 每天让你去上班的最大动力是什么？

questions.en: What new position would you like to attain at work?
questions.zh: 你希望在工作中升到什么新职位？

questions.en: What would it take for you to leave your job?
questions.zh: 什么条件会让你决定离开现在的工作？

questions.en: What's the simple secret of success in the work world?
questions.zh: 你觉得职场成功最简单的秘诀是什么？

questions.en: Do you escape via soap operas, mystery novels, or anything trashy?
questions.zh: 你会通过肥皂剧、悬疑小说或其他轻松消遣来逃避现实吗？

questions.en: Do you excel at making quick decisions or do you procrastinate?
questions.zh: 你擅长快速做决定，还是容易拖延？

questions.en: Do you introduce yourself or wait for others to introduce themselves?
questions.zh: 认识陌生人时，你会主动自我介绍，还是等别人先介绍？

questions.en: Do you people can hear from or communicate with the dead?
questions.zh: 你相信人可以听见亡者的声音，或与亡者沟通吗？

questions.en: Do you try for the perfect union coupled with perfect autonomy?
questions.zh: 亲密关系中，你会同时追求高度亲密和高度独立吗？

questions.en: What job could your company not pay you enough to do?
questions.zh: 你现在的公司就算给再多钱，你也绝不会做哪种工作？

questions.en: What was the most unpleasant job you ever had to do?
questions.zh: 你做过最不愉快的一份工作是什么？

questions.en: Who was the most difficult boss you had to deal with?
questions.zh: 你遇到过最难相处的老板是谁？

questions.en: Do you check to see if something is printed on recycled paper?
questions.zh: 买东西时你会注意包装或纸张是不是使用了再生材料吗？

questions.en: Do you choose plastic or paper bags when you are grocery shopping?
questions.zh: 买菜结账时，你会选塑料袋还是纸袋？

questions.en: Do you encourage friends to drop by your house without calling first?
questions.zh: 你欢迎朋友不事先打电话就直接来家里吗？

questions.en: Do you keep your motives to yourself or do you share them?
questions.zh: 你通常把自己的动机藏在心里，还是会告诉别人？

questions.en: Do you listen to voice mail or just call the person back?
questions.zh: 收到语音留言后，你会先听完，还是直接回电话？

questions.en: Do you squeeze or roll the toothpaste tube from the middle, bottom?
questions.zh: 你挤牙膏时从中间挤、从底部卷，还是有其他方式？

questions.en: Do you steal sheets or covers or have them stolen from you?
questions.zh: 睡觉时你会抢被子，还是经常被别人抢走？

questions.en: Do you tend to blow hot and cold or even in temperament?
questions.zh: 你的情绪容易忽冷忽热，还是通常比较稳定？

questions.en: Do you find it hard or easy to say "no" to a salesperson?
questions.zh: 你觉得拒绝推销员容易还是困难？

questions.en: Do you prefer talking to people by phone, in person, or by email?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢通过电话、面对面还是电子邮件和人沟通？

questions.en: Do you sit outside much in the summer or stay in air conditioning?
questions.zh: 夏天你常坐在户外，还是更喜欢待在空调房里？

questions.en: Do you take a shower or bath every day, less, or more often?
questions.zh: 你每天都会洗澡吗？还是频率更高或更低？

questions.en: Do you win people over by telling them what they want to hear?
questions.zh: 为了让别人站在你这边，你会说他们想听的话吗？

questions.en: Do you fight for your rights or give up without much of a struggle?
questions.zh: 遇到自己的权益受损时，你会据理力争，还是很快放弃？

questions.en: Do you always give the real reason when asking somebody to do something for you?
questions.zh: 请别人帮忙时，你总会说出真正的原因吗？

questions.en: Do you fold your undergarments or just throw them in a drawer after washing them?
questions.zh: 内衣洗好后你会整齐叠起来，还是直接扔进抽屉？

questions.en: Do you interact on a personal level with people outside your racial or ethnic group?
questions.zh: 你会在私人层面和不同种族或族裔背景的人来往吗？

questions.en: Do you lock the front door, leave the lights on, or use other security measures?
questions.zh: 你会锁好大门、留灯或采用其他居家安全措施吗？

questions.en: Do you ever turn a crisis into a story you tell, with you as the star?
questions.zh: 遇到危机后，你会不会把它讲成一个以自己为主角的精彩故事？

questions.en: Do you stay in the background at parties or put a lamp shade on your head?
questions.zh: 参加派对时你通常低调待在一旁，还是会成为全场焦点？

questions.en: When you watch a big championship game, are you there for the game or the commercials?
questions.zh: 看重大赛事直播时，你主要是看比赛，还是看广告？

questions.en: Do you mind paying for apps or do you just use free ones for your mobile devices?
questions.zh: 手机应用需要付费时你介意吗，还是只用免费的？

questions.en: Do you prepare your own taxes with a software program or do you go to an accountant?
questions.zh: 你会自己用软件报税，还是找会计师处理？

questions.en: Are you jealous of people who have experienced more career success than you?
questions.zh: 看到别人事业比自己更成功时，你会嫉妒吗？

questions.en: In what ways have you seen racism or sexism at work?
questions.zh: 你在工作场所见过哪些种族歧视或性别歧视？

questions.en: Do you have your own personal website?
questions.zh: 你有自己的个人网站吗？

questions.en: How do you learn how to use the latest technology?
questions.zh: 你通常怎样学习使用最新科技？

questions.en: Which do you find more acceptable: older men with young women or young men with older women?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪种年龄差关系更容易接受：年长男性和年轻女性，还是年轻男性和年长女性？

questions.en: Do you prefer to hang out with people who are like you or who are totally different from you?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢和与自己很相似的人相处，还是和完全不同的人相处？

questions.en: If you could trade work skills the way children swap collectable cards, who would you trade with and for what?
questions.zh: 如果工作技能能像小孩交换卡片一样交换，你最想和谁换、换什么技能？

questions.en: Are you well-organized?
questions.zh: 你做事有条理吗？

questions.en: Are you usually found wearing jeans?
questions.zh: 你平时最常穿牛仔裤吗？

questions.en: Are you generally on-time, early, or late-arriving?
questions.zh: 你通常会提前到、准时到，还是迟到？

questions.en: Are you pursuing your big goals every day?
questions.zh: 你每天都在为自己的大目标采取行动吗？

questions.en: What kind of leader are you most apt to follow?
questions.zh: 你最愿意追随什么样的领导者？

questions.en: If you had a choice, would you work at home or commute?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你更愿意在家工作还是每天通勤？

questions.en: What do you like about your sibling(s)?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢兄弟姐妹的哪些地方？

questions.en: Should hunting animals be legal?
questions.zh: 你觉得狩猎动物应该合法吗？

questions.en: Have you ever skipped school?
questions.zh: 你以前有没有逃过课？

questions.en: Can you learn to use intuition?
questions.zh: 直觉是可以训练和学习的吗？

questions.en: How did you get to school?
questions.zh: 你以前怎么去学校？

questions.en: At what age did you start school?
questions.zh: 你几岁开始上学？

questions.en: Did you enjoy physical education in school?
questions.zh: 你上学时喜欢体育课吗？

questions.en: Did you learn to remember through association?
questions.zh: 你学过用联想法帮助记忆吗？

questions.en: Do you use ad-blocking on your computer?
questions.zh: 你会在电脑上使用广告拦截工具吗？

questions.en: Do you use social media? Which apps?
questions.zh: 你会用社交媒体吗？主要用哪些？

questions.en: Have you ever tried to learn Esperanto?
questions.zh: 你学过世界语吗？

questions.en: Should Columbus Day be a national holiday?
questions.zh: 你觉得哥伦布日应该是全国性假日吗？

questions.en: What did you do in study hall?
questions.zh: 自习课时你通常做什么？

questions.en: What have you learned from your enemies?
questions.zh: 你从敌人或对手身上学到过什么？

questions.en: What have you learned from your past?
questions.zh: 你从过去的经历中学到了什么？

questions.en: What made your best teacher the best?
questions.zh: 你最好的老师为什么那么好？

questions.en: Would you consider getting a distance-learning degree?
questions.zh: 你会考虑通过远程学习取得学位吗？

questions.en: Can you describe your first day at school?
questions.zh: 你能描述一下自己第一天上学的情景吗？

questions.en: Do you malls, catalog shopping, or the internet?
questions.zh: 购物时你更喜欢商场、邮购目录还是互联网？

questions.en: Do you use hands-free technology in your car?
questions.zh: 你开车时会使用免提设备吗？

questions.en: Have you ever won an award at school?
questions.zh: 你在学校得过奖吗？

questions.en: Have you learned more from successes or failures?
questions.zh: 你从成功还是失败中学到得更多？

questions.en: What are the biggest gaps in your education?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己的教育中最大的缺口是什么？

questions.en: What school would you like to have attended?
questions.zh: 有没有一所学校是你希望自己当年能去读的？

questions.en: What was the name of your secondary school?
questions.zh: 你的高中叫什么名字？

questions.en: What's one course you would like to retake?
questions.zh: 如果可以重修一门课，你会选哪一门？

questions.en: What's the way you like best to learn?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢用什么方式学习？

questions.en: Do you purchase condoms in stores or by mail/internet?
questions.zh: 你通常在实体店购买安全套，还是通过邮购或网络购买？

questions.en: What did you discover about yourself in secondary school?
questions.zh: 高中时期你对自己有过什么新的认识？

questions.en: What grade in primary school did you enjoy most?
questions.zh: 小学哪个年级是你最喜欢的？

questions.en: What lessons have you learned between youth and now?
questions.zh: 从年轻到现在，你学到过哪些重要的人生功课？

questions.en: What students did you admire most in secondary school?
questions.zh: 高中时你最佩服哪些同学？

questions.en: What subject do you know better than any other?
questions.zh: 你最擅长、最了解的学科是什么？

questions.en: What subjects in school were completely useless to you?
questions.zh: 你觉得学校里哪些科目对你完全没用？

questions.en: What's the most important skill to have in school?
questions.zh: 你觉得在学校里最重要的能力是什么？

questions.en: Why did you go or not go to university?
questions.zh: 你为什么选择上大学，或者为什么没有上大学？

questions.en: Did you make the most of your secondary school years?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己充分利用了高中那几年吗？

questions.en: How has your secondary school changed since you went there?
questions.zh: 你的高中从你毕业到现在发生了哪些变化？

questions.en: What did you do when you came home from school?
questions.zh: 放学回家后你通常会做什么？

questions.en: What lesson of love took you the longest to learn?
questions.zh: 关于爱，你花了最长时间才学会的道理是什么？

questions.en: What truth have you learned that you want to share?
questions.zh: 你学到过哪条真理，是特别想和别人分享的？

questions.en: What year in school would you like to do over?
questions.zh: 如果可以重来一次，你最想重读哪一个年级？

questions.en: What's one of the hardest things to learn in life?
questions.zh: 你觉得人生中最难学会的事情之一是什么？

questions.en: What's one subject you wish you had studied in school?
questions.zh: 有什么学科是你希望当年在学校里学过的？

questions.en: Did you study more than party or party more than study?
questions.zh: 上学时你是学习多、玩得少，还是玩得多、学习少？

questions.en: Do you look at caller ID before you answer the phone?
questions.zh: 接电话前你会先看一下来电显示吗？

questions.en: If you could learn anything at all, what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果什么都可以学，你最想学什么？

questions.en: Talk about a time when you got into trouble at school.
questions.zh: 说说你在学校惹过一次麻烦的经历。

questions.en: Were you a serious student or did you play too much?
questions.zh: 你以前是认真读书的学生，还是玩得比较多？

questions.en: What was the most foolish thing you did in secondary school?
questions.zh: 你高中时做过最傻的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Should foods or ingredients be labeled as such if they are genetically modified?
questions.zh: 如果食品或成分经过基因改造，你觉得标签上应该明确标注吗？

questions.en: If you got a concussion playing a sport, would you continue to play that sport? What if your child suffered a concussion?
questions.zh: 如果运动时发生脑震荡，你还会继续参加这项运动吗？如果是你的孩子脑震荡呢？

questions.en: Do you meditate? How often?
questions.zh: 你会冥想吗？多久一次？

questions.en: What additional career education would you like to attain?
questions.zh: 你还想接受哪些与职业有关的进一步教育或培训？

questions.en: What coworkers have you particularly liked or were memorable?
questions.zh: 你有哪些特别喜欢或特别难忘的同事？

questions.en: What were the most challenging working conditions you experienced?
questions.zh: 你经历过最艰苦的工作条件是什么？

questions.en: Are state and local officials working toward better public education?
questions.zh: 你觉得州和地方政府官员是否在努力改善公共教育？

questions.en: Do you expect a great deal of others? Of yourself?
questions.zh: 你对别人要求很高吗？对自己呢？

questions.en: Do you feel confused if you are interrupted while working?
questions.zh: 工作时被人打断，你会很容易失去思路吗？

questions.en: Do you feel matched or mismatched with your work colleagues?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己和同事们很合拍，还是不太合拍？

questions.en: Do you use GPS to get directions? All the time?
questions.zh: 你会用GPS导航吗？几乎每次都用吗？

questions.en: How did where you earned your degree influence your career?
questions.zh: 你在哪里取得学位这件事，对你的职业发展有什么影响？

questions.en: How has the internet affected your profession or your job?
questions.zh: 互联网怎样改变了你的职业或工作？

questions.en: How much did your first job influence your later career?
questions.zh: 第一份工作对你后来职业发展的影响有多大？

questions.en: Of what accomplishments in your career are you the proudest?
questions.zh: 职业生涯中，你最为哪些成就感到骄傲？

questions.en: What are the most- and least-rewarding parts of your job?
questions.zh: 你的工作中最有回报和最没有回报的部分分别是什么？

questions.en: What would your occupation have been in the Old/Wild West?
questions.zh: 如果你生活在美国西部拓荒时代，你觉得自己会做什么职业？

questions.en: What's a habit you picked up during your working years?
questions.zh: 工作这些年里，你养成了什么习惯？

questions.en: What's the best word to describe your current work situation?
questions.zh: 用一个词形容你目前的工作状态，你会选什么？

questions.en: Who was your favorite guest host on Saturday Night Live?
questions.zh: 《周六夜现场》历来的客座主持人中，你最喜欢谁？

questions.en: Would you feel comfortable having a boss younger than you?
questions.zh: 如果老板比你年轻，你会觉得自在吗？

questions.en: Do you buy products specifically for "green"/environmentally friendly advertising or packaging?
questions.zh: 你会因为“环保”宣传或包装而特意购买某些产品吗？

questions.en: How many times have you changed careers or line of work?
questions.zh: 你一共换过多少次职业或工作领域？

questions.en: How should public health insurance work, and what could be improved?
questions.zh: 你觉得公共医疗保险应该怎样运作？有哪些可以改进的地方？

questions.en: What could you do to become the best at your profession?
questions.zh: 你可以做些什么，让自己成为本专业里最优秀的人？

questions.en: What invention would make your job much easier and more productive?
questions.zh: 什么样的发明能让你的工作轻松很多、效率更高？

questions.en: What occupation do you think will be popular in fifty years?
questions.zh: 你觉得五十年后哪一种职业会很热门？

questions.en: What unnecessary work interruptions and trivial matters could you do without?
questions.zh: 工作中有哪些不必要的打断和琐事是你最希望减少的？

questions.en: What's the best way anyone could compliment you about your work?
questions.zh: 别人怎样称赞你的工作最能让你开心？

questions.en: Which interests and economic factors led you to certain career choices?
questions.zh: 哪些兴趣和经济因素影响了你的职业选择？

questions.en: Would you ever work for your significant other as a subordinate?
questions.zh: 你愿意在伴侣手下工作、成为对方的下属吗？

questions.en: Would you feel more loyalty to a union or your employer?
questions.zh: 如果工会和雇主利益冲突，你会更忠于哪一方？

questions.en: Would you leave your job if your significant other got relocated?
questions.zh: 如果伴侣因为工作需要搬家，你会因此离职跟着走吗？

questions.en: Do you favor or oppose teaching about gay/lesbian orientation/lifestyles in public schools?
questions.zh: 你赞成还是反对公立学校教授同性恋相关的性取向和生活方式内容？

questions.en: How far would you go to get a job you desperately needed?
questions.zh: 如果你非常需要一份工作，你愿意为得到它做到什么程度？

questions.en: How much is your work disrupted with email and other electronic interruptions?
questions.zh: 电子邮件和其他电子通知会多大程度打断你的工作？

questions.en: How would you deal with the emotional turmoil of losing a job?
questions.zh: 如果失去工作，你会怎样应对那段情绪上的动荡？

questions.en: If you were the boss, what changes would you make at work?
questions.zh: 如果你是老板，你会对工作环境或制度做哪些改变？

questions.en: What about work most reminds you of what you disliked about school?
questions.zh: 工作中哪些事情最让你想起自己当年不喜欢学校的地方？

questions.en: What are some false or outdated assumptions people operate under at work?
questions.zh: 职场中有哪些人们仍在遵循、但其实已经过时或错误的假设？

questions.en: What chores would you assign to children to teach work and responsibility?
questions.zh: 为了教孩子劳动和责任感，你会分配哪些家务给他们？

questions.en: What has been your motivation to achieve or succeed in your career?
questions.zh: 是什么动力促使你在事业上追求成就和成功？

questions.en: What things would you rather be doing when you are at work?
questions.zh: 上班时，你有哪些事情其实更想去做？

questions.en: What's something you would like to shout at your boss or coworkers?
questions.zh: 有没有一句话是你很想对老板或同事大喊出来的？

questions.en: What's the next challenging assignment you would like to have at work?
questions.zh: 你下一步最想挑战什么样的工作任务？

questions.en: Would you accept a less enjoyable job for twice what you make?
questions.zh: 如果薪水翻倍，你会接受一份没那么喜欢的工作吗？

questions.en: Would you be working in a different profession if it paid more?
questions.zh: 如果另一个职业薪水更高，你会考虑转行吗？

questions.en: How long does it take a couple to work things out between them?
questions.zh: 一对伴侣通常需要多久才能把彼此的问题谈开、解决？

questions.en: If you could work fewer hours in exchange for less pay, would you?
questions.zh: 如果可以少工作一些时间、同时少拿一点工资，你愿意吗？

questions.en: If you were alive 150 years ago, what job would you have had?
questions.zh: 如果生活在150年前，你觉得自己会做什么工作？

questions.en: Which do you prefer to work for: a small company or a giant?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢为小公司工作，还是为大型企业工作？

questions.en: What would you do if a lie detector test was required for a job?
questions.zh: 如果一份工作要求测谎，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Would you transfer to a different state than you live in now for a job?
questions.zh: 为了工作，你愿意搬到另一个州生活吗？

questions.en: Do you watch regular season games of sporting events or just watch the play-offs and championship games?
questions.zh: 体育赛事常规赛你也会看，还是主要只看季后赛和总决赛？

questions.en: What are the most important things you can do in your job within the next twelve months?
questions.zh: 未来十二个月里，你在工作中最重要的几件事是什么？

questions.en: Would you prefer to work at a desk that you primarily sat down at or stood up at?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢坐着使用的办公桌，还是站立式办公桌？

questions.en: What do you tend to do with old clothes that either don't fit or that you don't want anymore?
questions.zh: 不合身或不再想穿的旧衣服，你通常会怎么处理？

questions.en: What do you do when someone you don't know on a social or business network site tries to become a "friend" or otherwise connected to you?
questions.zh: 如果一个你不认识的人在社交或商务网络上想加你为好友或建立联系，你通常怎么处理？

questions.en: Should taxpayers support professional sports teams with new stadiums and tax breaks?
questions.zh: 你觉得纳税人应该通过新体育场或税收优惠来补贴职业球队吗？

questions.en: In a team sport you know well, which position would you most want to play?
questions.zh: 在你熟悉的一项团体运动里，你最想打什么位置？

questions.en: Why is football far more popular in some countries than in others?
questions.zh: 为什么足球在有些国家远比在另一些国家受欢迎？

questions.en: Would you rather have school paid for but not get a choice of where to go or go anywhere but have to pay for your education?
questions.zh: 你宁愿学费全免但不能选择学校，还是自由选择学校但自己承担学费？

questions.en: What are your annoying habits?
questions.zh: 你有哪些习惯会让别人觉得烦？

questions.en: What are your waking-up habits?
questions.zh: 你早上醒来后通常有哪些固定习惯？

questions.en: What's in your home library?
questions.zh: 你的家庭藏书里都有些什么？

questions.en: How often do you use rewards?
questions.zh: 你多久会用奖励来激励自己或别人？

questions.en: How was your birthday usually celebrated?
questions.zh: 你小时候的生日通常是怎么庆祝的？

questions.en: What are your most compulsive habits?
questions.zh: 你有哪些最难控制、近乎强迫性的习惯？

questions.en: What are your Sunday morning rituals?
questions.zh: 你星期天早上通常有哪些固定安排？

questions.en: What habits are you proud of?
questions.zh: 你有哪些习惯是自己很自豪的？

questions.en: What habits have you successfully kicked?
questions.zh: 你已经成功戒掉过哪些习惯？

questions.en: Did you ever run away from home?
questions.zh: 你小时候有没有离家出走过？

questions.en: Do you have more friends or enemies?
questions.zh: 你的朋友多，还是敌人多？

questions.en: How often do you brush your teeth?
questions.zh: 你多久刷一次牙？

questions.en: How often have you fallen in love?
questions.zh: 你一共爱上过别人多少次？

questions.en: What clothes do you think are sexy?
questions.zh: 你觉得什么样的衣服最性感？

questions.en: What habit would you like to start?
questions.zh: 你想开始培养什么新习惯？

questions.en: What home entertainment gadgets do you use?
questions.zh: 你家里会使用哪些家庭娱乐设备？

questions.en: Do you have a friend who passed away?
questions.zh: 你有没有已经去世的朋友？

questions.en: How often do you look at old yearbooks?
questions.zh: 你多久会翻看一次旧年鉴？

questions.en: Is your house very neat or somewhat messy?
questions.zh: 你家里通常非常整洁，还是有点乱？

questions.en: What in this morning's paper made you happy?
questions.zh: 今天早上的新闻里，有什么事情让你觉得开心？

questions.en: What mirrors do you look in every day?
questions.zh: 你每天会照哪些镜子？

questions.en: What rule is most important in your home?
questions.zh: 你家里最重要的一条规矩是什么？

questions.en: What's a routine you remember from your childhood?
questions.zh: 你记得童年时有什么固定的生活规律吗？

questions.en: Who do you usually spend the holidays with?
questions.zh: 节假日你通常和谁一起过？

questions.en: At what temperature do you best like the house?
questions.zh: 你觉得家里保持多少度最舒服？

questions.en: Could you accept being sent to a nursing home?
questions.zh: 如果有一天需要被送进养老院，你能接受吗？

questions.en: How often do you look at mementos and keepsakes?
questions.zh: 你多久会翻看一次纪念品或珍藏的小物件？

questions.en: In what order do you put on your clothes?
questions.zh: 穿衣服时，你通常按什么顺序穿？

questions.en: What habits have you not been able to break?
questions.zh: 有哪些习惯你一直没能戒掉？

questions.en: When you're in love, what do you need most?
questions.zh: 当你爱上一个人时，你最需要什么？

questions.en: Would you spend a week in an empty room?
questions.zh: 你愿意在一个空荡荡的房间里待一周吗？

questions.en: Would you sponsor a foreign visitor in your home?
