questions.zh: 你愿意接待一位来自国外的访客住在自己家里吗？

questions.en: Can you describe your first time left alone at home?
questions.zh: 你还记得第一次独自在家时是什么感觉吗？

questions.en: How do you like to go crazy and have fun?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢用什么方式彻底放松、疯玩一下？

questions.en: What did you wear when younger that mortifies you now?
questions.zh: 你年轻时穿过什么衣服，现在回想起来会觉得特别尴尬？

questions.en: What was the worst home you have ever lived in?
questions.zh: 你住过最糟糕的一所房子是什么样？

questions.en: How long do you keep bad habits from a new partner?
questions.zh: 开始一段新关系后，你会把坏习惯隐藏多久？

questions.en: On what days of the week do you do certain chores?
questions.zh: 一周中你通常会把不同家务安排在哪些天做？

questions.en: What was the remedy for the common cold in your home?
questions.zh: 你小时候家里通常用什么方法治普通感冒？

questions.en: Growing up, what did your household never seem to have enough of?
questions.zh: 你小时候，家里总觉得最缺什么东西？

questions.en: If you had massive energy, how would you put that energy to work?
questions.zh: 如果你拥有用不完的精力，你会把它投入到什么事情上？

questions.en: If you had the option to never work again, would you take it?
questions.zh: 如果可以从此再也不用工作，你会接受吗？

questions.en: Do you agree with your employer's policies and procedures? Have you gone against any of them?
questions.zh: 你认同雇主的政策和流程吗？有没有曾经违反过其中一些规定？

questions.en: If you had to do it all over again, would you work harder in school to learn more?
questions.zh: 如果人生重来一次，你会在学校里更努力学习吗？

questions.en: What's your favorite video or computer game?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪款电子游戏或电脑游戏？

questions.en: Do you get your news from social media?
questions.zh: 你会从社交媒体上获取新闻吗？

questions.en: What ringtone do you use on your phone?
questions.zh: 你的手机现在用什么铃声？

questions.en: What foreign language should students be required to learn?
questions.zh: 你觉得学生应该被要求学习哪一种外语？

questions.en: What should the antidrug methodology be: law enforcement or education?
questions.zh: 你觉得反毒品工作应该更侧重执法，还是教育？

questions.en: What's a subject you think should be offered in school?
questions.zh: 你觉得学校应该新增哪一门课程？

questions.en: Do you primarily use a camera or phone to take photographs?
questions.zh: 拍照时你主要用相机还是手机？

questions.en: Do you use your computer or tablet device for educational purposes?
questions.zh: 你会用电脑或平板进行学习吗？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you have worked harder in school?
questions.zh: 如果可以重来一次，你会在学校里更努力吗？

questions.en: What friends from secondary school do you stay in touch with?
questions.zh: 你现在还和哪些高中朋友保持联系？

questions.en: What significant historic events took place during your primary school days?
questions.zh: 你上小学时发生过哪些重大历史事件？

questions.en: What activities did you take part in outside lessons at secondary school?
questions.zh: 中学期间你参加过哪些课外活动？

questions.en: Who was one of your most memorable teachers in primary school?
questions.zh: 小学时哪位老师最让你难忘？

questions.en: Who, if anyone, was at home when you returned from school?
questions.zh: 你放学回家时，家里通常有人吗？是谁？

questions.en: Do you back up files on your computer and other electronic devices?
questions.zh: 你会备份电脑和其他电子设备里的文件吗？

questions.en: Have you ever learned a text, or part of one, by heart?
questions.zh: 你以前有没有把一段文字完整背下来过？

questions.en: If cost was not a factor, would you go to private school?
questions.zh: 如果不用考虑费用，你会选择私立学校吗？

questions.en: If you were a teacher, what subject would you like to teach?
questions.zh: 如果你当老师，你最想教什么科目？

questions.en: In what field of endeavor would you like a two-hour crash course?
questions.zh: 如果可以参加两小时速成课，你最想快速了解哪个领域？

questions.en: What subject do you most appreciate in art (e.g., flowers, people, etc.)?
questions.zh: 艺术作品中，你最喜欢以什么为题材，比如花、人物或其他东西？

questions.en: What was the number of students in your secondary school graduating class?
questions.zh: 你高中毕业班大概有多少学生？

questions.en: Did you learn to take yourself less seriously through your friendship with someone?
questions.zh: 有没有一段友谊让你学会别把自己看得太严肃？

questions.en: What are your strongest memories of primary school, lower secondary school, and secondary school?
questions.zh: 你对小学、初中和高中分别最深刻的记忆是什么？

questions.en: What childhood or secondary school dreams are you now glad never came true?
questions.zh: 有哪些童年或高中时期的梦想，现在回头看反而庆幸没有实现？

questions.en: What have you learned from friends who have a different background from you?
questions.zh: 你从背景和自己不同的朋友身上学到了什么？

questions.en: What musical instruments would you like to learn or improve your performance on?
questions.zh: 你最想学习哪种乐器，或提高哪种乐器的演奏水平？

questions.en: What new course would you like to add to the nation's school curriculum?
questions.zh: 如果可以给全国学校课程增加一门新课，你会加什么？

questions.en: What school or type of school do you want your children to attend?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的孩子就读什么学校或哪一类学校？

questions.en: What's one of the most important things about life you learned in school?
questions.zh: 你在学校学到的、关于人生最重要的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What subject would you study if you had a year to devote to it?
questions.zh: 如果可以花一年时间专门研究一个学科，你会选什么？

questions.en: What was the toughest course you took and how did you get through it?
questions.zh: 你上过最难的一门课是什么？你是怎么撑过去的？

questions.en: What's something you wish you could have learned with the snap of your fingers?
questions.zh: 有什么事情是你希望自己能瞬间学会的？

questions.en: When you are studying using a printed textbook, do you highlight the important parts?
questions.zh: 用纸质教材学习时，你会用荧光笔标出重点吗？

questions.en: Who are the friends that went with you from primary school through secondary school?
questions.zh: 有哪些朋友从小学一路陪你到高中？

questions.en: Why did you pick the university you did and what was it known for?
questions.zh: 你当初为什么选择那所大学？它最出名的是什么？

questions.en: What's one thing you never did in secondary school that you wish you would have done?
questions.zh: 高中时有什么事情你没做过，现在希望当年做过？

questions.en: Would you ever steal an exam in order to pass it or get a good grade?
questions.zh: 为了通过考试或拿到好成绩，你会偷考试题吗？

questions.en: What horrendous blunder did you make in the past year and what did you learn from it?
questions.zh: 过去一年里你犯过最严重的一个错误是什么？从中学到了什么？

questions.en: Do you seek advice from friends?
questions.zh: 你会向朋友征求意见吗？

questions.en: Do you take advice from friends?
questions.zh: 朋友给你的建议，你通常会采纳吗？

questions.en: Do you hesitate to answer strangers' questions?
questions.zh: 陌生人问你问题时，你会犹豫要不要回答吗？

questions.en: What do you and your friends do together?
questions.zh: 你和朋友通常一起做什么？

questions.en: What do you look for in a friend now?
questions.zh: 现在交朋友时，你最看重对方什么？

questions.en: What kind or size of bed do you like?
questions.zh: 你喜欢什么类型、什么尺寸的床？

questions.en: What kinds of people do you like the most?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢什么样的人？

questions.en: What quality do you like most in a person?
questions.zh: 一个人身上哪种品质最吸引你？

questions.en: What time do you like the sun to set?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢太阳几点落山？

questions.en: Have you ever tried to persuade somebody to give up a habit?
questions.zh: 你有没有试过劝别人戒掉某个习惯？

questions.en: Have you ever organized a large group of people to do something together?
questions.zh: 你有没有组织过一大群人一起完成某件事？

questions.en: If you could have had any job in history, what would it be and why?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择历史上任何一份工作，你最想做什么？为什么？

questions.en: When discussing your career with others, do you tend to exaggerate, understate, or be factual?
questions.zh: 和别人谈职业发展时，你会夸大、淡化，还是如实描述自己的情况？

questions.en: At sixty-five, will you be broke, still be working, be retired and living comfortably, or be rich?
questions.zh: 到65岁时，你觉得自己会身无分文、还在工作、舒适退休，还是已经很富有？

questions.en: How much is your personal identity and self-worth determined by your job and your success at it?
questions.zh: 你的个人身份认同和自我价值，有多大程度取决于工作以及工作上的成功？

questions.en: If you could choose what hours and days you work, how would you schedule your forty hours?
questions.zh: 如果工作时间和工作日都由你自己安排，你会怎样分配每周四十小时？

questions.en: What responsibility or work did you dislike while growing up but that proved very helpful to you as an adult?
questions.zh: 小时候你最讨厌的哪项责任或劳动，后来却发现对成年生活很有帮助？

questions.en: What would motivate you to work seven days a week, twelve hours a day for a month on an important project?
questions.zh: 如果有一个重要项目需要你连续一个月每天工作12小时、一周7天，什么能让你愿意这样做？

questions.en: Would you cut off federal welfare benefits to people who have not found a job or become self-sufficient in two years?
questions.zh: 如果一个人两年内仍没找到工作或无法自立，你赞成停止向他提供联邦福利吗？

questions.en: Do you stick by a friend even if they hurt you?
questions.zh: 即使朋友伤害过你，你还会继续支持对方吗？

questions.en: Does the use of tenure help or hurt the education system?
questions.zh: 你觉得教师终身教职制度对教育体系是帮助更多，还是伤害更多？

questions.en: Do you think smart kids should skip university to start their own companies?
questions.zh: 你觉得特别聪明的年轻人应该跳过大学、直接创业吗？

questions.en: Have you ever been on a meditation retreat, attended a meditation course, or gone on a yoga retreat?
questions.zh: 你参加过冥想静修、冥想课程或瑜伽静修吗？

questions.en: At a restaurant, if service is good, what percentage do you usually leave for a tip? What if service is bad?
questions.zh: 在餐厅里，如果服务很好你通常会留多少小费？服务不好时呢？

questions.en: What kind of earphones do you prefer?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢哪种耳机？

questions.en: Does anyone you know have a particularly annoying habit?
questions.zh: 你认识的人里，有谁有特别让人受不了的习惯吗？

questions.en: What kind of person would you like to be?
questions.zh: 你希望自己成为怎样的人？

questions.en: What was the worst home decorating or fix-it experience?
questions.zh: 你经历过最糟糕的一次装修或修理房屋的经历是什么？

questions.en: Do you have a friend with a different ethnic background?
questions.zh: 你有族裔背景和自己不同的朋友吗？

questions.en: What daily activity do you treasure more than any other?
questions.zh: 每天哪一项活动是你最珍惜的？

questions.en: What kind of older person do you want to be?
questions.zh: 你希望自己老了以后成为怎样的人？

questions.en: What's a habit you picked up during your earliest years?
questions.zh: 你很小的时候就养成了什么习惯？

questions.en: Where did you and your friends spend time as teenagers?
questions.zh: 你十几岁时通常和朋友在哪里消磨时间？

questions.en: How do the clothes you wear affect your moods and attitudes?
questions.zh: 你穿的衣服会怎样影响你的心情和状态？

questions.en: What kind of person do you want your child to marry?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的孩子将来和什么样的人结婚？

questions.en: What usually goes through your mind just before you fall asleep?
questions.zh: 入睡前，你脑子里通常会想些什么？

questions.en: What one object would you grab if your house was on fire?
questions.zh: 如果家里失火，你只能拿走一件东西，会拿什么？

questions.en: What's the most difficult habit you have tried to get rid of?
questions.zh: 你尝试戒掉过最难戒的习惯是什么？

questions.en: When you look back on your life, what amazes you the most?
questions.zh: 回顾自己的人生，最让你惊讶的是什么？

questions.en: Can you recall a specific incident that got you into trouble at home?
questions.zh: 你能想起一次在家里惹上麻烦的具体经历吗？

questions.en: How often have you kept in touch with people you promised you would?
questions.zh: 你曾经答应会保持联系的人，现在还有多少真的在联系？

questions.en: When home alone, do you shut the door when you use the bathroom?
questions.zh: 一个人在家时，上厕所你会关门吗？

questions.en: When you really want to get to know someone, do you tell them?
questions.zh: 当你真的想深入了解一个人时，你会直接告诉对方吗？

questions.en: How do you like to show love to people who are special to you?
questions.zh: 你喜欢怎样向对自己重要的人表达爱？

questions.en: What artist would you like to commission to create a painting for your home?
questions.zh: 如果可以请一位艺术家为你家创作一幅画，你会选谁？

questions.en: What attitudes and habits did you have to give up to get through life?
questions.zh: 为了更好地生活，你不得不放下过哪些态度或习惯？

questions.en: What is the first thing you do when you wake up in the morning?
questions.zh: 早上醒来后，你做的第一件事通常是什么？

questions.en: When you think of the next ten years, what are you most excited about?
questions.zh: 想到未来十年，你最期待什么？

questions.en: In class or lecture room, did you sit in front or in an inconspicuous place?
questions.zh: 上课或听讲座时，你以前更喜欢坐前排，还是坐在不显眼的位置？

questions.en: What are the landmarks in your life: certain buildings, stores, things you see every day?
questions.zh: 你人生中有哪些“地标”——比如某些建筑、商店或每天都会看到的东西？

questions.en: Do you feel that you give off more positive or negative karma in your daily life?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己日常给周围人带来的能量更多是正面的还是负面的？

questions.en: How often do you shave, what is your method of choice, and where do you shave?
questions.zh: 你多久刮一次毛？通常用什么方式、刮哪些部位？

questions.en: What do others think your worst habit is and what do you think your worst habit is?
questions.zh: 别人觉得你最糟糕的习惯是什么？你自己又觉得是什么？

questions.en: When you see fresh flowers, do you usually take a few moments to breathe in their aroma?
questions.zh: 看到鲜花时，你会不会停一下，闻一闻它们的香味？

questions.en: If you were stranded 500 kilometers from home, do you know someone who would come and get you?
questions.zh: 如果你被困在离家500公里的地方，你知道有谁会来接你吗？

questions.en: If you made a huge mistake at work, would you admit it or pretend it had nothing to do with you?
questions.zh: 如果你在工作中犯了一个严重错误，你会承认，还是装作和自己无关？

questions.en: Do you watch videos online? For what reason(s)?
questions.zh: 你会看网络视频吗？通常是为了什么？

questions.en: Have you ever looked up an old friend online?
questions.zh: 你有没有在网上查找过多年没联系的老朋友？

questions.en: How do you protect your privacy on the internet?
questions.zh: 你会怎样保护自己在互联网上的隐私？

questions.en: Which foreign language would you most like to learn and why?
questions.zh: 你最想学习哪种外语？为什么？

questions.en: Should intellectual events be more popular than sports events? Will it ever happen?
questions.zh: 你觉得知识类、文化类活动应该比体育赛事更受欢迎吗？未来有可能吗？

questions.en: What things would you like to teach your children before they learn them from someone else?
questions.zh: 有哪些事情你希望在孩子从别人那里学到之前，先由你来教他们？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you have learned more in the "classroom of life" than in school?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你会希望从“人生这间教室”里学到的比学校里更多吗？

questions.en: Over the course of your life, what have you probably spent more time pondering than anything else?
questions.zh: 回顾整个人生，你花时间思考最多的事情可能是什么？

questions.en: What have you learned about your partner that you didn't know in your first six months together?
questions.zh: 在和伴侣相处的过程中，有什么是前六个月时你完全不了解、后来才发现的？

questions.en: When you meet people for the first time, what are you most interested in learning about them?
questions.zh: 第一次认识一个人时，你最想先了解对方什么？

questions.en: Should students be required by law to be fluent in a second language before they finish school?
questions.zh: 你赞成法律规定学生必须至少熟练掌握一门外语才能毕业吗？

questions.en: What was the most fun subject in primary school, and what was the subject you dreaded the most?
questions.zh: 小学时最好玩的科目是什么？你最害怕或最不喜欢的科目又是什么？

questions.en: Which teacher would be most proud of you and which one would be the most disappointed in you?
questions.zh: 哪位老师如果看到现在的你会最为你骄傲？哪位可能最失望？

questions.en: Do you have kids?
questions.zh: 你有孩子吗？

questions.en: Do you have a calling?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己有没有一种特别的使命或召唤？

questions.en: Do you have a 401(k) account?
questions.zh: 你有401(k)退休账户吗？

questions.en: Do you have a poem memorized?
questions.zh: 你会背一首完整的诗吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in newspapers?
questions.zh: 你信任报纸吗？

questions.en: Do you have strong emotional needs?
questions.zh: 你有很强的情感需求吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in big business?
questions.zh: 你对大型企业有信心吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in the military?
questions.zh: 你对军队有信心吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in the police?
questions.zh: 你对警察有信心吗？

questions.en: Do you have nicknames for your children?
questions.zh: 你会给自己的孩子取昵称吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in the public schools?
questions.zh: 你对公立学校有信心吗？

questions.en: What topic can you talk about for hours?
questions.zh: 什么话题你可以连续聊几个小时？

questions.en: What type of postage stamp would you design?
questions.zh: 如果让你设计一枚邮票，你会设计成什么样？

questions.en: Do you have anything stored in a self-storage facility?
questions.zh: 你有没有把东西存放在自助仓储设施里？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in the criminal justice system?
questions.zh: 你对刑事司法体系有信心吗？

questions.en: Does your work keep you awake at night? Why?
questions.zh: 工作会让你晚上睡不着吗？为什么？

questions.en: Do you have a child who is most like you?
questions.zh: 你的孩子中，有没有一个性格最像你？

questions.en: Do you have friendships that have lasted over 10 years?
questions.zh: 你有没有持续超过十年的友谊？

questions.en: Do you remember the dates of your best friends' birthdays?
questions.zh: 你记得最好的朋友们的生日日期吗？

questions.en: Do you use social networking for personal or professional reasons?
questions.zh: 你使用社交网络主要是为了私人生活，还是职业用途？

questions.en: Do you have a child who is most like your partner?
questions.zh: 你的孩子中，有没有一个最像你的伴侣？

questions.en: Why should you be hired over other candidates for a job?
questions.zh: 如果求职，你觉得雇主为什么应该选你而不是其他候选人？

questions.en: Do you deliberately make friends with people you think can help you?
questions.zh: 你会不会有意识地去结交你认为将来能帮到自己的人？

questions.en: What work wraps you up and carries you away? Do you achieve flow?
questions.zh: 什么样的工作能让你完全投入、忘记时间？你会进入“心流”状态吗？

questions.en: Would you like to have your significant other working for you? With you?
questions.zh: 你愿意让伴侣为你工作吗？或者和你一起工作？

questions.en: If you had to choose, would you have left home at age fifteen or still live there now?
questions.zh: 如果必须二选一，你宁愿15岁就离家，还是一直住在父母家直到现在？

questions.en: Do you take a daily vitamin? Do you think taking a daily vitamin is helpful, does nothing, is harmful?
questions.zh: 你每天会吃维生素吗？你觉得每天吃维生素有帮助、没什么作用，还是有害？

questions.en: What were your favorite dreams?
questions.zh: 你以前最喜欢做什么样的梦？

questions.en: Would you use wearable technology?
questions.zh: 你愿意使用可穿戴科技产品吗？

questions.en: How comfortable are you using technology?
questions.zh: 你使用科技产品时有多自在？

questions.en: Is your social media profile accurate?
questions.zh: 你的社交媒体资料真实准确吗？

questions.en: Would you post a selfie online?
questions.zh: 你会把自拍照发到网上吗？

questions.en: Do you think that learning takes place in the womb?
questions.zh: 你觉得人在母亲子宫里就已经开始学习了吗？

questions.en: Do you think your school gave you a quality education?
questions.zh: 你觉得你的学校给了你高质量的教育吗？

questions.en: What are five apps that you need on your phone?
questions.zh: 你的手机里有哪五个你离不开的应用？

questions.en: What Web sites do you go to every day or fairly often?
questions.zh: 你每天或经常访问哪些网站？

questions.en: Are you a leader?
questions.zh: 你是一个领导型的人吗？

questions.en: Are you a party person?
questions.zh: 你喜欢参加派对吗？

questions.en: Do you consider yourself pretty/handsome?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己长得好看吗？

questions.en: Are you slow to trust people?
questions.zh: 你是不是比较慢才会信任别人？

questions.en: Are you a leader or a follower?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己更像领导者还是追随者？

questions.en: Are you an extrovert or an introvert?
questions.zh: 你是外向型还是内向型？

questions.en: Do you consider experiences a "luxury good"?
questions.zh: 你会把经历和体验也看作一种“奢侈品”吗？

questions.en: Why do you get up in the morning?
questions.zh: 每天早上是什么让你愿意起床？

questions.en: Are you quick or slow at making new friends?
questions.zh: 你交新朋友的速度快还是慢？

questions.en: Do you consider yourself in or out of shape?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己的身体状态好吗？

questions.en: Do you consider yourself a good flirt and like it?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己很会调情吗？你喜欢调情吗？

questions.en: What kind of company culture and environment are ideal for you?
questions.zh: 什么样的公司文化和工作环境最适合你？

questions.en: You have striven to be what kind of worker with what qualities?
questions.zh: 在工作中，你一直努力成为一个具备哪些品质的人？

questions.en: Do you think the public pension system will still be around when you retire?
questions.zh: 你觉得等你退休的时候，公共养老金制度还会存在吗？

questions.en: Do you think success at work is more likely if you improve the way you look?
questions.zh: 你觉得改善外表会提高职场成功的机会吗？

questions.en: What kind of person do you want to be and how do you need to change?
questions.zh: 你想成为什么样的人？为了做到这一点，你需要改变什么？

questions.en: What do you think of private versus public school education?

questions.zh: 如果和最好的朋友有六个小时，你们会怎么度过？

questions.en: Is there a catalog or store you especially like browsing?
questions.zh: 有没有一家商店或一本商品目录是你特别喜欢逛、特别喜欢看的？

questions.en: What does a truly relaxing evening look like to you?
questions.zh: 对你来说，一个真正放松的晚上是什么样？

questions.en: What qualities make up your idea of an ideal partner?
questions.zh: 你心目中的理想伴侣应该具备哪些品质？

questions.en: What thought has been on your mind the most lately?
questions.zh: 最近你脑子里最常出现的想法是什么？

questions.en: What was a big misunderstanding you had with a friend?
questions.zh: 你和朋友之间发生过最大的误会是什么？

questions.en: What's the most outrageous proposal you've ever received or considered?
questions.zh: 你收到或认真考虑过最离谱的一项提议是什么？

questions.en: Where do you usually make your first move in tic-tac-toe?
questions.zh: 玩井字棋时，你第一步通常下在哪里？

questions.en: Who do you trust more than anyone in the world?
questions.zh: 世界上你最信任的人是谁？

questions.en: Would you lie to keep a friend out of trouble?
questions.zh: 为了让朋友免于麻烦，你会撒谎吗？

questions.en: Do you know the color of all of your friends' eyes?
questions.zh: 你知道自己所有朋友的眼睛是什么颜色吗？

questions.en: Do you usually drive below, at, or above the speed limit?
questions.zh: 开车时你通常低于限速、按限速，还是高于限速？

questions.en: What was the kindest thing a stranger ever did for you?
questions.zh: 陌生人对你做过最善良的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What's a passion of yours that most people don't know about?
questions.zh: 你有没有一个大多数人都不知道的热爱或兴趣？

questions.en: What's the first thing you usually look for at a buffet?
questions.zh: 吃自助餐时，你通常第一样会去找什么？

questions.en: What's your view on equal rights for gay and lesbian people?
questions.zh: 你怎么看同性恋者应享有平等权利这件事？

questions.en: Where would you go to meet people if you were single?
questions.zh: 如果你单身，你会去哪里认识新朋友或潜在伴侣？

questions.en: Who did you think was the smartest person in the world?
questions.zh: 你以前认为世界上最聪明的人是谁？

questions.en: Who was the last person you said "I love you" to?
questions.zh: 你最近一次对谁说“我爱你”？

questions.en: Would you tell a good friend if they had bad breath?
questions.zh: 如果好朋友有口臭，你会告诉他/她吗？

questions.en: If you had to describe yourself in one word, what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果只能用一个词形容自己，你会选什么？

questions.en: If you were going bald, would you shave your head? Wear a wig?
questions.zh: 如果开始秃头，你会把头发剃光，还是戴假发？

questions.en: Why do you think that people have such a hard time quitting a bad habit?
questions.zh: 你觉得人为什么很难戒掉坏习惯？

questions.en: What's your view on gun control and gun licensing?
questions.zh: 你怎么看枪支管制和枪支许可制度？

questions.en: Are you faithful?
questions.zh: 你在感情中忠诚吗？

questions.en: Are you materialistic?
questions.zh: 你物质欲强吗？

questions.en: Are you a hipster?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己算“文艺潮人”或hipster吗？

questions.en: Are you basically lucky?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己总体上运气好吗？

questions.en: Are you into scrapbooking?
questions.zh: 你喜欢做剪贴簿吗？

questions.en: Are you a frequent theatergoer?
questions.zh: 你经常去看舞台剧吗？

questions.en: Are you a good speller?
questions.zh: 你拼写能力好吗？

questions.en: Are you a relentless worker?
questions.zh: 你是不是一个拼命工作的工作狂？

questions.en: Are you an emotional person?
questions.zh: 你是一个情绪比较丰富的人吗？

questions.en: Are you hardworking or lazy?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己勤奋还是懒散？

questions.en: Are you high-energy or low-energy?
questions.zh: 你的精力水平通常很高还是比较低？

questions.en: Are you high-maintenance or low-maintenance?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己属于“高维护型”还是“低维护型”？

questions.en: Are you interested in antiques?
questions.zh: 你对古董感兴趣吗？

questions.en: Are you mild- or hot-tempered?
questions.zh: 你的脾气温和还是火爆？

questions.en: Are you practical or ingenious?
questions.zh: 你更偏实用型，还是很会想新办法？

questions.en: Are you right-brained or left-brained?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己更偏右脑型还是左脑型？

questions.en: Are you yin or yang?
questions.zh: 如果用阴阳来形容自己，你更偏“阴”还是“阳”？

questions.en: Are you a doer or procrastinator?
questions.zh: 你是行动派，还是容易拖延？

questions.en: Are you a glutton for overwork?
questions.zh: 你会不会总是给自己安排过量的工作？

questions.en: Are you good at trivia questions?
questions.zh: 你擅长回答知识问答题吗？

questions.en: Are you nimble with your hands?
questions.zh: 你的手很灵巧吗？

questions.en: Are you right- or left- handed?
questions.zh: 你是右撇子还是左撇子？

questions.en: Are you self-conscious about your height?
questions.zh: 你会因为自己的身高而不自在吗？

questions.en: Are you sympathetic to the underdog?
questions.zh: 你通常会同情处于弱势的一方吗？

questions.en: Are you typical of your generation?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己很符合自己这一代人的典型特征吗？

questions.en: Are you a better talker or listener?
questions.zh: 你更擅长说，还是更擅长听？

questions.en: Are you a predictable or unpredictable person?
questions.zh: 你是一个容易被预测的人，还是常常让人意外？

questions.en: Are you a thinker or a doer?
questions.zh: 你更像思考型的人，还是行动型的人？

questions.en: Are you careful or careless with money?
questions.zh: 你花钱比较谨慎，还是比较随意？

questions.en: Are you good or bad at bluffing?
questions.zh: 你擅长虚张声势或“诈唬”吗？

questions.en: Are you instinctively good at business matters?
questions.zh: 你在商业和生意方面有天生的判断力吗？

questions.en: Are you interested in your genealogical background?
questions.zh: 你对自己的家族谱系和祖先背景感兴趣吗？

questions.en: Are you scared of people in authority?
questions.zh: 面对权威人物时，你会害怕或紧张吗？

questions.en: Are you a Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) fan?
questions.zh: 你喜欢综合格斗（MMA）吗？

questions.en: Are you comfortable talking "baby talk" to babies?
questions.zh: 你会自然地用“宝宝语”跟婴儿说话吗？

questions.en: Are you good or bad at finishing things?
questions.zh: 你擅长把事情坚持做完吗？

questions.en: Are you good or bad at keeping secrets?
questions.zh: 你擅长保守秘密吗？

questions.en: Do you have trouble controlling impulses? Which ones?
questions.zh: 你有没有难以控制的冲动？主要是哪些？

questions.en: Are you a numbers person or a words person?
questions.zh: 你更擅长数字，还是文字？

questions.en: Are you an early bird or a night owl?
questions.zh: 你是早起型还是夜猫子型？

questions.en: Are you cleanliness-compulsive or do you not mind dirt?
questions.zh: 你对清洁有点强迫，还是不太介意脏乱？

questions.en: Are you easy or difficult to get along with?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己容易相处，还是比较难相处？

questions.en: Are you ever too old to fall in love?
questions.zh: 你觉得人会不会有“太老了，不适合再恋爱”的时候？

questions.en: Are you more creative when alone or with others?
questions.zh: 你一个人时更有创造力，还是和别人一起时更有创造力？

questions.en: Are you regarded as a sensitive person or not?
questions.zh: 别人通常会觉得你是个敏感的人吗？

questions.en: Are you willing to pay the price of success?
questions.zh: 为了成功，你愿意付出相应的代价吗？

questions.en: Are you a picture taker or forgetter of the camera?
questions.zh: 你是随时爱拍照的人，还是经常忘记拍照的人？

questions.en: Are you quick or slow at making a witty reply?
questions.zh: 需要机智回应时，你通常反应快还是慢？

questions.en: What quotes do you use often? What is your favorite quotation?
questions.zh: 你经常引用哪些话？最喜欢的一句名言是什么？

questions.en: What do you call a perfect evening out with your significant other?
questions.zh: 你心目中和伴侣外出的完美夜晚是什么样？

questions.en: What do you do to reward yourself when you complete a difficult task?
questions.zh: 完成一项很难的任务后，你会怎样奖励自己？

questions.en: What do you have done at the beauty or barber shop and how often?
questions.zh: 你去美容院或理发店通常会做哪些项目？多久去一次？

questions.en: What do you like to do on a rainy Saturday or other day off?
questions.zh: 下雨的星期六或其他休息日，你最喜欢做什么？

questions.en: What do you look forward to the most and the least about growing old?
questions.zh: 关于变老，你最期待什么？最不期待什么？

questions.en: What do you need changed in your life before you can have more fun?
questions.zh: 你的生活需要改变什么，才能让你玩得更开心、活得更轻松？

questions.en: How do you most often communicate your feelings to close friends when they are not near?
questions.zh: 亲密朋友不在身边时，你最常用什么方式表达自己的感受？

questions.en: What do you know so well and enjoy so much that you never accept less than the best?
questions.zh: 有什么东西是你既特别懂、又特别喜欢，以至于绝不愿意将就？

questions.en: Would you rather talk to everyone at a crowded party for a short time or have a significant conversation with two people?
questions.zh: 参加拥挤的派对时，你宁愿和所有人都短暂聊一下，还是只和两个人深入交谈？

questions.en: What do you often dream of?
questions.zh: 你经常梦见什么？

questions.en: Are you jealous of other people's success?
questions.zh: 看到别人成功时，你会嫉妒吗？

questions.en: Are you possessive or jealous by nature?
questions.zh: 你天生比较占有欲强或容易嫉妒吗？

questions.en: Do you wish you had received premarital counseling?
questions.zh: 你希望自己婚前接受过伴侣咨询吗？

questions.en: Do you dream in color or black and white?
questions.zh: 你做梦是彩色的，还是黑白的？

questions.en: What do you want your last words to be?
questions.zh: 你希望自己临终前最后说的话是什么？

questions.en: What do you want to pass on to your children?
questions.zh: 你最想把什么价值观、经验或东西传给孩子？

questions.en: Do you wish you had slept with more or fewer people?
questions.zh: 你会希望自己过去有更多性伴侣，还是更少？

questions.en: Do you wish you worked more or fewer hours a week?
questions.zh: 你希望自己每周工作更多小时，还是更少小时？

questions.en: What do you wish for on pennies in a wishing well?
questions.zh: 往许愿池里丢硬币时，你通常会许什么愿？

questions.en: What type of wedding ceremony and reception did you have or what type do you dream of?
questions.zh: 你举行过什么样的婚礼和婚宴？如果还没结婚，你梦想中的婚礼是什么样？

questions.en: Have you ever wondered what friends or colleagues are like in bed?
questions.zh: 你有没有好奇过朋友或同事在性生活方面是什么样？

questions.en: What do you think of (internet) net neutrality?
questions.zh: 你怎么看网络中立原则？

questions.en: Should science classes in schools teach an alternative to evolution?
questions.zh: 你觉得学校科学课应该教授进化论之外的另一种解释吗？

questions.en: What's the weirdest/strangest thing you ever took a photo of with your phone or camera?
questions.zh: 你用手机或相机拍过最奇怪的一张照片是什么？

questions.en: Who's someone you respect and why?
questions.zh: 你尊敬谁？为什么？

questions.en: How would you define love to a child?
questions.zh: 如果要向一个孩子解释“爱”是什么，你会怎么说？

questions.en: Who would you trade jobs with and why?
questions.zh: 如果可以和别人交换工作，你会和谁换？为什么？

questions.en: How do you generally view immigration into your country?
questions.zh: 总体来说，你怎么看外来移民进入你的国家？

questions.en: What activity do you most enjoy in each season?
questions.zh: 春夏秋冬各个季节里，你最喜欢做什么活动？

questions.en: Where would you like to go surfing and why?
questions.zh: 如果去冲浪，你最想去哪里？为什么？

questions.en: Who starts more arguments, your significant other or you?
questions.zh: 你和伴侣之间，谁更常主动挑起争论？

questions.en: Who's someone you would describe as a "real character?"?
questions.zh: 你认识的人里，谁可以被形容成特别有个性、很有戏的人？

questions.en: Do your friends tend to have easygoing or difficult personalities?
questions.zh: 你的朋友性格大多随和，还是比较难相处？

questions.en: How important is it that your friends share your values?
questions.zh: 朋友和你拥有相同价值观，对你来说有多重要？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you have made more friends?
questions.zh: 如果可以重新选择，你会希望自己交更多朋友吗？

questions.en: What's a particularly dangerous thing you did with a friend?
questions.zh: 你和朋友一起做过最危险的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Where do you have immense patience and very little patience?
questions.zh: 哪些事情上你特别有耐心？哪些事情上你几乎没有耐心？

questions.en: Who would you take on a month-long backcountry camping expedition?
questions.zh: 如果要进行为期一个月的荒野露营探险，你会带谁一起去？

questions.en: Who's one of the luckiest people you know, and why?
questions.zh: 你认识的人里，谁算特别幸运？为什么？

questions.en: Who's someone you would really like to be friends with?
questions.zh: 你特别想和谁成为朋友？

questions.en: Who's the most naturally gifted person you have worked with?
questions.zh: 你合作过的人里，谁最有天赋？

questions.en: How do you react to music videos featuring scantily clad women?
questions.zh: 看到音乐视频里衣着非常暴露的女性时，你通常有什么反应？

questions.en: Is your current best friend anything like your childhood best friend?
questions.zh: 你现在最好的朋友和小时候最好的朋友性格相似吗？

questions.en: What clubs, social groups, and organizations do you belong to now?
questions.zh: 你现在属于哪些俱乐部、社交团体或组织？

questions.en: What social or country club would you like to belong to?
questions.zh: 你最想加入哪个社交俱乐部或乡村俱乐部？

questions.en: What thoughts come to mind when you see a pregnant teenager?
questions.zh: 看到怀孕的青少年时，你首先会想到什么？

questions.en: Where would you go if you wanted to spark your creativity?
questions.zh: 如果想激发创造力，你会去什么地方？

questions.en: Who would you fire: poor performer/great person or good performer/disliked person?
questions.zh: 如果必须裁掉一个人，你会选工作表现差但人很好的人，还是表现不错但很不讨喜的人？

questions.en: Under what circumstances would you lay your life down for a friend?
questions.zh: 在什么情况下，你愿意为了朋友牺牲自己的生命？

questions.en: What are some funny thing(s) that happened to you and a friend?
questions.zh: 你和朋友之间发生过哪些特别好笑的事情？

questions.en: What would make you join a social movement like Occupy Wall Street?
questions.zh: 什么事情会促使你加入类似“占领华尔街”这样的社会运动？

questions.en: What would you do if a close friend gets arrested for theft?
questions.zh: 如果亲密朋友因为盗窃被捕，你会怎么做？

questions.en: What would you do if someone insults a friend to your face?
questions.zh: 如果有人当着你的面侮辱你的朋友，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Where do you perceive abundance or lack of it in your life?
questions.zh: 在你的人生里，哪些方面让你觉得很富足？哪些方面又觉得欠缺？

questions.en: Where do you place the return address and stamp on an envelope?
questions.zh: 写信封时，你通常把回邮地址和邮票分别放在哪里？

questions.en: Where would you like to go on your first or second honeymoon?
questions.zh: 如果去第一次或第二次蜜月旅行，你最想去哪里？

questions.en: Who would you like to play opposite as leading man or lady?
questions.zh: 如果你担任电影或舞台剧主角，你最想和谁搭档演对手戏？

questions.en: Who's one childhood friend you would like to know what happened to?
questions.zh: 有没有一个童年朋友，是你很想知道后来过得怎样的？

questions.en: Who's the funniest person you have known and how did you meet?
questions.zh: 你认识过最有趣、最会逗人笑的人是谁？你们怎么认识的？

questions.en: Are most of your friends older, younger, or the same age as you?
questions.zh: 你的朋友大多比你年长、年幼，还是和你差不多大？

questions.en: Do differences in social standing reflect what people have made of their opportunities?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会地位的差异主要反映了人们如何利用各自拥有的机会吗？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you have been a leader or a follower?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你更愿意成为领导者还是追随者？

questions.en: Is there a limit to the number of friends a person should have?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个人应该拥有的朋友数量有没有上限？

questions.en: What are three good reasons why someone should have you for a friend?
questions.zh: 请说出三个别人值得和你做朋友的理由。

questions.en: What first comes to mind when you see someone in a military uniform?
questions.zh: 看到穿军装的人时，你第一反应是什么？

questions.en: What friends did you stick by when they went through a tough time?
questions.zh: 有哪些朋友经历困难时，你一直陪在他们身边？

questions.en: What significant social change would you like to see happen in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 你希望有生之年看到哪一种重大的社会改变？

questions.en: What's the worst nightmare you've had, and how often do you have nightmares?
questions.zh: 你做过最可怕的噩梦是什么？你多久会做一次噩梦？

questions.en: Who's the person who can help you negotiate a path through a crisis?
questions.zh: 遇到危机时，谁最能帮你理清局面、找到出路？

questions.en: Do you believe it's generally a bad idea to go into business with friends?
questions.zh: 你觉得和朋友一起做生意通常是个坏主意吗？

questions.en: How do you feel when you see a gay couple showing affection in public?
questions.zh: 看到同性伴侣在公共场合表达亲密时，你有什么感觉？

questions.en: In square meters, what's the smallest home you'd be comfortable in? And the largest?
questions.zh: 如果用平方米来算，你住着舒服的最小房子和最大房子分别是多大？

questions.en: What social event did you not want to go to that turned out great?
questions.zh: 有没有一次你原本不想参加的社交活动，结果最后特别开心？

questions.en: What "moment of glory" have you watched a friend have that you would like, too?
questions.zh: 你见过朋友经历过什么“高光时刻”，让你也很希望自己能有一次？

questions.en: What physical feature do you like most about yourself, and which do you like least?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢自己哪个身体特征？最不喜欢哪个？

questions.en: What would you do if you feel a distance growing between you and a friend?
questions.zh: 如果你感觉自己和朋友之间越来越疏远，你会怎么做？

questions.en: What would you do if your best friend wore a fur coat to your party?
questions.zh: 如果最好的朋友穿着皮草来参加你的派对，你会怎么反应？

questions.en: Who were the major betrayers in your life, especially those you were always loyal to?
questions.zh: 你人生中最严重的背叛来自谁，尤其是那些你一直很忠诚对待的人？

questions.en: What goes through your mind when you see a suspect being restrained by a police officer?
questions.zh: 看到嫌疑人被警察制服时，你脑子里通常会想到什么？

questions.en: Who would you like to get in contact with that you have not spoken to in years?
questions.zh: 有没有一个多年没联系的人，是你很想重新取得联系的？

questions.en: Should employers be able to cite diversity as the reason for who will be laid off from a job?
questions.zh: 你觉得雇主在裁员时可以把“多元化”作为决定留下谁、裁掉谁的理由吗？

questions.en: Have you ever had a favorite bar or hangout?
questions.zh: 你以前有没有特别喜欢去的酒吧或聚会地点？

questions.en: Would you betray a friend to get something you really want?
questions.zh: 为了得到自己非常想要的东西，你会背叛朋友吗？

questions.en: Were you spanked?
questions.zh: 你小时候挨过打屁股吗？

questions.en: What are your addictions?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己有哪些成瘾或难以戒掉的东西？

questions.en: What are your disabilities?
questions.zh: 你有哪些身体或功能上的障碍？

questions.en: How do you acknowledge sneezes?
questions.zh: 别人打喷嚏时，你通常会怎么回应？

questions.en: How do you advertise yourself?
questions.zh: 你通常怎样展示或推销自己？

questions.en: How do you handle compliments?
questions.zh: 别人称赞你时，你会怎么回应？
