questions.en: How much does it matter that most people like you?
questions.zh: 大多数人喜欢你，对你来说有多重要？

questions.en: How much energy have you spent in finding your calling?
questions.zh: 为了找到自己的使命或真正想做的事，你投入了多少精力？

questions.en: How much time per day do you devote to yourself?
questions.zh: 你每天会留多少时间完全给自己？

questions.en: Is it easy or hard for you to find jobs?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己找工作容易还是困难？

questions.en: Is the Human Genome project a good or bad idea?
questions.zh: 你觉得人类基因组计划是好事还是坏事？

questions.en: Tell a story you heard about one of your ancestors.
questions.zh: 讲一个你听过的、关于祖先的故事。

questions.en: To reduce crime, will it help to have more police?
questions.zh: 要减少犯罪，增加警察数量真的有帮助吗？

questions.en: To what charity do you normally donate money or time?
questions.zh: 你通常向哪家慈善机构捐钱或投入时间？

questions.en: What about being a child do you miss the most?
questions.zh: 当孩子时的哪一部分生活，是你现在最怀念的？

questions.en: What are the effects of bad news in the media?
questions.zh: 媒体里的坏消息会对人产生哪些影响？

questions.en: What are the most albums you have by an artist?
questions.zh: 同一位歌手或乐队的专辑，你最多收藏过多少张？

questions.en: What are the things you must do before you die?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己去世前一定要完成哪些事情？

questions.en: What beliefs would you go out on a limb for?
questions.zh: 有哪些信念是你愿意冒险坚持的？

questions.en: What board game have you had the most luck at?
questions.zh: 你玩哪种桌游时运气最好？

questions.en: What character in what novel would you like to be?
questions.zh: 如果能成为某部小说里的一个角色，你会选谁？

questions.en: What did you do during the summers as a kid?
questions.zh: 小时候放暑假时你通常做什么？

questions.en: What did you think when you first saw your baby(ies)?
questions.zh: 第一次看到自己的孩子时，你脑子里最先想到什么？

questions.en: What do you feel you lacked most as a child?
questions.zh: 你觉得童年时自己最缺少什么？

questions.en: What gold medal would you like in your trophy case?
questions.zh: 如果可以拥有一枚金牌，你最希望是哪一个项目？

questions.en: What have you contributed to the welfare of the planet?
questions.zh: 你为地球和环境做过哪些有益的事情？

questions.en: What have you not had enough of in your life?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己人生中什么东西一直不够多？

questions.en: What moment in your life would you like to replay?
questions.zh: 如果可以重播人生中的一个瞬间，你会选哪个？

questions.en: What opportunity do you wish you'd taken as a child?
questions.zh: 小时候有什么机会是你现在很后悔没抓住的？

questions.en: What people were unfriendly to you in the last year?
questions.zh: 过去一年里，有哪些人对你不太友好？

questions.en: What performer would you most like to see in person?
questions.zh: 你最想亲眼看哪位表演者的现场演出？

questions.en: What person has stayed by you through thick and thin?
questions.zh: 谁无论顺境逆境都一直陪在你身边？

questions.en: What scent would you like to bottle as a perfume?
questions.zh: 如果能把一种气味做成香水，你会选什么？

questions.en: What special places do you go to think things out?
questions.zh: 你有哪些特别喜欢去、可以安静想事情的地方？

questions.en: What surprises have you thought up for people you love?
questions.zh: 你为自己爱的人设计过哪些惊喜？

questions.en: What talent would you like to have more than anything?
questions.zh: 如果能获得一种天赋，你最想要什么？

questions.en: What task do you put off until tomorrow most often?
questions.zh: 什么事情是你最常拖到明天再做的？

questions.en: What wakes you up in the middle of the night?
questions.zh: 什么最容易让你半夜醒来？

questions.en: What will be the most powerful nation in 100 years?
questions.zh: 你觉得一百年后哪个国家会成为最强大的国家？

questions.en: What would be a fun new way of greeting people?
questions.zh: 你能想出一种有趣的新式打招呼方式吗？

questions.en: What would you invest in if you had the money?
questions.zh: 如果有钱投资，你最想投什么？

questions.en: What's the most clever thing you ever did for revenge?
questions.zh: 为了报复别人，你做过最聪明的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What's the nicest thing you ever did for someone else?
questions.zh: 你为别人做过最善良的一件事是什么？

questions.en: When's it hardest for you to give or receive hugs?
questions.zh: 什么时候你最难主动拥抱别人，或接受别人的拥抱？

questions.en: Do you know how many countries there are in the world?
questions.zh: 你知道全世界大概有多少个国家吗？

questions.en: How can you make more time for the people you love?
questions.zh: 你怎样才能为自己爱的人腾出更多时间？

questions.en: In what order do you keep your currency in your wallet?
questions.zh: 你钱包里的纸币通常按什么顺序放？

questions.en: Is there any cause you would be willing to die for?
questions.zh: 有没有哪一种事业或信念是你愿意为之牺牲生命的？

questions.en: On a typical workday, what takes up most of your time?
questions.zh: 一个普通工作日里，什么事情最占你的时间？

questions.en: What ancestor of yours would you like to meet the most?
questions.zh: 你的祖先中，你最想见哪一位？

questions.en: What are loving ways to say "I'm not in the mood?"?
questions.zh: 不想亲密时，有哪些温柔、不伤人的方式表达“我现在没心情”？

questions.en: What are things you have not made your mind up about?
questions.zh: 有哪些事情你到现在还没拿定主意？

questions.en: What did you look forward to the most as a child?
questions.zh: 小时候你最期待什么？

questions.en: What do you think reveals a lot about a person's character?
questions.zh: 你觉得什么最能看出一个人的品格？

questions.en: What does a conscience do and where does it come from?
questions.zh: 你觉得良心的作用是什么？它从哪里来？

questions.en: What famous person would you like to have a child with?
questions.zh: 如果能和一位名人生孩子，你会选谁？

questions.en: What is the first thing you turn to in the newspaper?
questions.zh: 拿到报纸时，你第一眼会先看什么？

questions.en: What memento of a famous person would you like to have?
questions.zh: 如果可以拥有一件名人纪念品，你最想要什么？

questions.en: What object in a museum do you most want to see?
questions.zh: 博物馆里你最想亲眼看到哪一件展品？

questions.en: What one thing would you like to change on your face?
questions.zh: 如果可以改变脸上的一个地方，你会改什么？

questions.en: What people would you like to weed out of your life?
questions.zh: 有哪些人是你希望逐渐从自己生活中淡出的？

questions.en: What person did you pursue over a long period of time?
questions.zh: 你曾经花很长时间追求过谁？

questions.en: What person in your life is the best example of love?
questions.zh: 你生命中谁最能代表“爱”是什么？

questions.en: What person would you like to do a love scene with?
questions.zh: 如果要拍一场爱情戏，你最想和谁搭档？

questions.en: What special event would you like a VIP pass to attend?
questions.zh: 如果可以拿到VIP通行证，你最想参加什么特别活动？

questions.en: What things do you check at night before going to bed?
questions.zh: 晚上睡觉前，你通常会检查哪些事情？

questions.en: What values do you want to pass on to your children?
questions.zh: 你最希望把哪些价值观传给孩子？

questions.en: What wedding did you object to or wanted to object to?
questions.zh: 你有没有参加过一场自己反对、或很想提出反对的婚礼？

questions.en: What's the last thing you do before you go to bed?
questions.zh: 睡觉前你做的最后一件事通常是什么？

questions.en: When was a time you performed in front of an audience?
questions.zh: 你什么时候曾在观众面前表演过？

questions.en: At what age will you or did you begin to slow down?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己是从几岁开始明显慢下来的？

questions.en: Is there someone or something you've missed and wondered about for years?
questions.zh: 有没有一个人或一件事，是你多年一直想念、一直想知道后来怎样的？

questions.en: What are the ways you like love to be shown to you?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢别人用哪些方式向你表达爱？

questions.en: What friends do you feel most and least comfortable with and why?
questions.zh: 你和哪些朋友相处最自在？和哪些最不自在？为什么？

questions.en: What is the number of laundry loads you do in a week?
questions.zh: 你一周通常洗几次衣服？

questions.en: What talk show would you most like to be a guest on?
questions.zh: 你最想上哪档谈话节目当嘉宾？

questions.en: Under what circumstances, if any, would you be willing to fight in a war?
questions.zh: 在什么情况下，如果有的话，你愿意参加战争并亲自战斗？

questions.en: To you, is aging decay or growth? What do you do to restore your soul?
questions.zh: 对你来说，变老更像衰退还是成长？你会怎样让自己的精神重新恢复活力？

questions.en: How do you feel about giving the armed forces authority to assist police in counter-terrorism work?
questions.zh: 你怎么看让军方协助警方开展反恐工作的做法？

questions.en: When you reminisce with friends about wild times, do you have to flash back more than five years?
questions.zh: 和朋友回忆那些疯狂往事时，通常是不是要追溯到五年以上以前？

questions.en: What would you do if you were at a party and people started gossiping about a friend who was not there?
questions.zh: 如果聚会上有人开始说一个不在场朋友的八卦，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Will big-business mergers hurt consumers?
questions.zh: 你觉得大型企业合并会伤害消费者吗？

questions.en: When are you apt to cry?
questions.zh: 你通常在什么情况下最容易哭？

questions.en: Do you enjoy reminiscing about the past?
questions.zh: 你喜欢回忆过去吗？

questions.en: In what ways do you express anger?
questions.zh: 你通常会怎样表达愤怒？

questions.en: Is failure always bad and success always good?
questions.zh: 失败一定是坏事、成功一定是好事吗？

questions.en: What people have you hurt that you are sorry about?
questions.zh: 你曾伤害过哪些人，并且对此感到后悔？

questions.en: Are CEO salaries too high?
questions.zh: 你觉得CEO的薪酬是不是太高了？

questions.en: What's the first step toward ending racism?
questions.zh: 你觉得结束种族主义的第一步是什么？

questions.en: What can you do personally to eradicate racism?
questions.zh: 你个人能做些什么来帮助消除种族主义？

questions.en: What evidence of racist attitudes have you witnessed?
questions.zh: 你亲眼见过哪些带有种族主义态度的行为？

questions.en: What presidential candidates did you think were a joke?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪些总统候选人曾经像个笑话？

questions.en: When we die, do we know that we have died?
questions.zh: 你觉得人死后会知道自己已经死了吗？

questions.en: Should every citizen be entitled to free internet?
questions.zh: 你觉得每个公民都应该享有免费互联网吗？

questions.en: Do you think video game content is generally appropriate or inappropriate?
questions.zh: 你觉得电子游戏里的内容总体上适合大众吗？

questions.en: Do you think playing video games affects people's behavior or social development?
questions.zh: 你觉得玩电子游戏会影响人的行为或社交发展吗？

questions.en: Do you think our attention spans have increased or decreased due to technology?
questions.zh: 你觉得科技发展让我们的注意力变长了，还是变短了？

questions.en: Do you think that things you delete from the internet are really deleted?
questions.zh: 你觉得从互联网上“删除”的东西真的彻底消失了吗？

questions.en: Are you a conventional dresser? Always?
questions.zh: 你平时穿衣风格比较传统吗？一直都是吗？

questions.en: What are your definitions of injustice and victimization?
questions.zh: 你会怎样定义“不公正”和“受害”？

questions.en: How do you channel frustration into a nondestructive activity?
questions.zh: 你会怎样把挫败感转化成不会伤害自己的活动？

questions.en: Is your way of tackling problems better than other people's?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己解决问题的方法比大多数人更好吗？

questions.en: What are your thoughts on the role of the United Nations?
questions.zh: 你怎么看联合国应该发挥的作用？

questions.en: How do you make your life more complex than it needs to be?
questions.zh: 你会在哪些方面把生活弄得比实际需要更复杂？

questions.en: How would you explain why radar detectors are sold if they are illegal?
questions.zh: 如果雷达测速探测器是违法的，你会怎样解释为什么市场上还能出售？

questions.en: If somebody or something doesn't fit your system of beliefs, what do you do?
questions.zh: 如果某个人或某件事不符合你的信念体系，你通常怎么处理？

questions.en: What do you carry to protect yourself? In what other ways do you protect yourself?
questions.zh: 你会随身带什么保护自己？除此之外还会用哪些方式保护自己？

questions.en: How do you talk about the person in your life when you are not with them?
questions.zh: 伴侣不在身边时，你会怎样向别人谈起对方？

questions.en: Were you ever given real help and encouragement in finding out what you wanted to do?
questions.zh: 在人生早期，有没有人真正帮助、鼓励你找到自己想做的事情？

questions.en: Have you ever had predictive dreams?
questions.zh: 你有没有做过后来似乎预示未来的梦？

questions.en: Do you ever daydream about future events? How often?
questions.zh: 你会幻想未来可能发生的事情吗？多久一次？

questions.en: How do you plan to spend the last years of your life?
questions.zh: 你计划怎样度过人生最后的那些年？

questions.en: What do you usually wish for when you blow out birthday candles?
questions.zh: 吹生日蜡烛时，你通常会许什么愿？

questions.en: What's the biggest mistake you have made on a social network site? What was the most embarrassing thing that has happened to you online?
questions.zh: 你在社交网站上犯过最大的错误是什么？网上发生过最让你尴尬的事情是什么？

questions.en: What's the perfect age and why?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪个年龄最理想？为什么？

questions.en: Does advertising significantly influence your buying decisions?
questions.zh: 广告会明显影响你的购买决定吗？

questions.en: What are you obsessive about and why?
questions.zh: 你对什么事情特别执着，甚至有点强迫？为什么？

questions.en: What self-improvement techniques have you experimented with?
questions.zh: 你尝试过哪些自我提升的方法？

questions.en: What's the trustworthiness of consumer marketing reports?
questions.zh: 你觉得消费者营销报告有多可信？

questions.en: Would you rather be 7′2′′ or 4′2′′?
questions.zh: 你宁愿身高2.18米左右，还是1.27米左右？

questions.en: Would you rather be funny or kind?
questions.zh: 你宁愿自己很幽默，还是很善良？

questions.en: Would you rather be taller or shorter?
questions.zh: 你宁愿自己更高一点，还是更矮一点？

questions.en: Would you rather deliver babies or pizzas?
questions.zh: 你宁愿接生婴儿，还是送披萨？

questions.en: Would you rather go blind or deaf?
questions.zh: 你宁愿失明还是失聪？

questions.en: Would you rather skydive or hang glide?
questions.zh: 你宁愿跳伞还是玩悬挂式滑翔？

questions.en: Would you rather water-ski or snow ski?
questions.zh: 你宁愿滑水还是滑雪？

questions.en: Are any illegal acts justified under certain circumstances?
questions.zh: 你觉得某些情况下违法行为也可能是合理的吗？

questions.en: How has experience determined your attitudes and beliefs?
questions.zh: 你的经历怎样塑造了你的态度和信念？

questions.en: Is there anyone you now envy and why?
questions.zh: 你现在有没有羡慕的人？为什么？

questions.en: What frustrates you most about your current relationships?
questions.zh: 目前的人际关系中，什么最让你感到挫败？

questions.en: What's the most regrettable event in international history?
questions.zh: 你觉得国际历史上最令人遗憾的事件是什么？

questions.en: Would you rather have ten children or none?
questions.zh: 你宁愿有十个孩子，还是一个都没有？

questions.en: Would you rather laugh or make others laugh?
questions.zh: 你宁愿自己笑得开心，还是让别人笑？

questions.en: Would you rather roller skate or ice skate?
questions.zh: 你宁愿轮滑还是滑冰？

questions.en: Can you make some predictions for your children, grandchildren?
questions.zh: 你会怎样预测自己的孩子或孙辈将来会变成什么样？

questions.en: From whom have you received unconditional love and acceptance?
questions.zh: 谁曾给过你无条件的爱和接纳？

questions.en: In what organizations and extracurricular activities did you participate?
questions.zh: 你以前参加过哪些组织和课外活动？

questions.en: What are restrictions that you cannot stand living with?
questions.zh: 有哪些限制是你最无法忍受的？

questions.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of arranged marriages?
questions.zh: 包办婚姻有哪些优点和缺点？

questions.en: What brands were extremely trendy during your teenage years?
questions.zh: 你十几岁时哪些品牌特别流行？

questions.en: What childlike quality have you maintained throughout your life?
questions.zh: 你一直保留着哪一种孩子般的特质？

questions.en: What drives you craziest about children, yours or others?
questions.zh: 不论是不是自己的孩子，孩子哪些行为最容易让你抓狂？

questions.en: What event raised your understanding of the larger world?
questions.zh: 哪件事让你第一次更深刻理解这个更大的世界？

questions.en: What is the direction and process of your teeth-brushing?
questions.zh: 你刷牙时通常从哪里开始、按什么顺序刷？

questions.en: What would be a practical alternative to business cards?
questions.zh: 你觉得名片有什么实用的替代方式？

questions.en: What would the world be like without superpower nations?
questions.zh: 如果世界上没有超级大国，会变成什么样？

questions.en: What's media's impact on our knowledge of world events?
questions.zh: 媒体会怎样影响我们对世界事件的了解？

questions.en: What's one superhuman ability you would choose to have?
questions.zh: 如果可以拥有一种超能力，你会选什么？

questions.en: What's one wedding tradition you would change or eliminate?
questions.zh: 婚礼传统里，有哪一项你最想改变或取消？

questions.en: What's the most beautiful word in the English language?
questions.zh: 你觉得英语里最美的一个词是什么？

questions.en: What's the most interesting question anyone ever asked you?
questions.zh: 别人问过你最有意思的问题是什么？

questions.en: Would you rather avoid challenge or seek it out?
questions.zh: 你宁愿避开挑战，还是主动寻找挑战？

questions.en: Would you rather be a librarian or a chemist?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当图书管理员还是化学家？

questions.en: Would you rather die before or after your partner?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你希望自己比伴侣先离世，还是后离世？

questions.en: Would you rather die by fire or by drowning?
questions.zh: 如果必须二选一，你宁愿死于火灾还是溺水？

questions.en: Would you rather fly a kite or jump rope?
questions.zh: 你宁愿放风筝还是跳绳？

questions.en: Would you rather spend time or money on something?
questions.zh: 对于一件想要的东西，你宁愿花时间还是花钱？

questions.en: Would you rather watch a drama or a comedy?
questions.zh: 你宁愿看剧情片还是喜剧？

questions.en: Can you describe your first punishment for doing something bad?
questions.zh: 你能描述一下小时候第一次因为做错事而受到惩罚的经历吗？

questions.en: Can you manage life situations as easily as most people?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己处理生活中的各种情况，和大多数人一样轻松吗？

questions.en: Can you name three currently popular musicians or musical groups?
questions.zh: 你能说出三个现在很流行的歌手或乐队吗？

questions.en: Do powerful countries interfere too much in other countries' affairs?
questions.zh: 你觉得强国是否过度干预其他国家的事务？

questions.en: Does the National Rifle Association reflect your views about guns?
questions.zh: 美国全国步枪协会对枪支的立场和你的看法相符吗？

questions.en: Does your choice of car reflect something about your personality?
questions.zh: 你开的车会不会反映出你的某些性格？

questions.en: For what particular person do you have the most respect?
questions.zh: 你最尊敬的一个人是谁？

questions.en: Has anything that happened to you changed all your priorities?
questions.zh: 有没有一件发生在你身上的事，彻底改变了你所有的优先顺序？

questions.en: In a trivia game, which category are you best at?
questions.zh: 玩知识问答游戏时，你最擅长哪个类别？

questions.en: In what ways are men and women different in communication?
questions.zh: 你觉得男性和女性在沟通方式上有哪些不同？

questions.en: In your relationships, do you make most of the decisions?
questions.zh: 在你的关系中，大多数决定通常是你做的吗？

questions.en: Is enough being done to prevent terrorism where you live?
questions.zh: 你觉得你生活的地方在预防恐怖主义方面做得够多吗？

questions.en: What additional Commandment would you add to the Ten Commandments?
questions.zh: 如果给《十诫》加一条，你会加什么？

questions.en: What adjustments must be made by a couple with children?
questions.zh: 有了孩子以后，一对伴侣通常需要做哪些调整？

questions.en: What advice do you offer for getting along with stepparents?
questions.zh: 对于怎样和继父母或继母相处，你有什么建议？

questions.en: What annually televised event is an absolute must-see for you?
questions.zh: 每年电视直播的活动里，有什么是你一定会看的？

questions.en: What astrological signs are you most and least compatible with?
questions.zh: 从星座角度看，你觉得自己和哪些星座最合、最不合？

questions.en: What company, organization, or institution would you like to run?
questions.zh: 如果可以管理一家公司、组织或机构，你最想管理哪一个？

questions.en: What continually robs you from appreciating or enjoying the moment?
questions.zh: 什么事情总是在阻碍你真正享受当下？

questions.en: What does your ethnic and cultural background mean to you?
questions.zh: 你的族裔和文化背景对你来说意味着什么？

questions.en: What elements would a picture of your typical day include?
questions.zh: 如果把你典型的一天画成一幅图，里面会有哪些元素？

questions.en: What fragrance reminds you of someone you were once with?
questions.zh: 哪一种香味会让你想起曾经在一起过的人？

questions.en: What games and activities do you play with your children?
questions.zh: 你会和孩子一起玩哪些游戏、做哪些活动？

questions.en: What messages have you received from others about your body?
questions.zh: 别人曾经给过你哪些关于自己身体的评价或信息？

questions.en: What needs to change for you to have greater contentment?
questions.zh: 你觉得什么需要改变，才能让自己更知足、更满足？

questions.en: What painting would you like to "walk into" and "experience"?
questions.zh: 如果可以“走进”一幅画里亲身体验，你会选哪一幅？

questions.en: What professions or occupations are actually more harmful than good?
questions.zh: 哪些职业实际上对社会造成的伤害可能大于贡献？

questions.en: What seems to accumulate in great abundance in your life?
questions.zh: 你的生活里什么东西总是不知不觉越积越多？

questions.en: What self-limiting thoughts or fears would you like to overcome?
questions.zh: 你最想克服哪些限制自己的想法或恐惧？

questions.en: What things, people, concepts, or ideas do you deeply hate?
questions.zh: 有哪些事物、人物、观念或想法是你非常厌恶的？

questions.en: What's something you know more about than anyone you know?
questions.zh: 有什么事情是你觉得自己比身边任何人都更懂的？

questions.en: What's something you said or did that still bothers you?
questions.zh: 有没有一件你说过或做过的事，到现在仍让你介意？

questions.en: What's the greatest amount of emotional pain you have endured?
questions.zh: 你经历过最大的情感痛苦是什么？

questions.en: What's the greatest gift you have to offer your partner?
questions.zh: 你能给伴侣最珍贵的礼物是什么？

questions.en: What's the most outrageous thing you have done for money?
questions.zh: 为了钱，你做过最离谱的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What's the most selfless thing you have done for someone?
questions.zh: 你为别人做过最无私的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What's the most shocking thing you could tell about yourself?
questions.zh: 如果要说一件最让人震惊的关于你的事，会是什么？

questions.en: When were you dressed inappropriately and felt out of place?
questions.zh: 有没有一次你穿得很不合场合，因此觉得自己格格不入？

questions.en: When's surrendering a weakness and when is it a strength?
questions.zh: 什么时候“放弃”是一种软弱？什么时候反而是一种力量？

questions.en: Will life on another planet be discovered in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 你觉得在你有生之年，人类会发现其他星球上的生命吗？

questions.en: Would you rather be a dentist or a dress designer?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当牙医还是服装设计师？

questions.en: Would you rather be a police officer or a firefighter?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当警察还是消防员？

questions.en: Would you rather be very good looking or very smart?
questions.zh: 你宁愿长得非常好看，还是非常聪明？

questions.en: Would you rather run a marathon or swim eight kilometers?
questions.zh: 你宁愿跑一场马拉松，还是游八公里？

questions.en: Are teenagers being pushed into acting older than they really are?
questions.zh: 你觉得青少年是不是被迫太早表现得像成年人？

questions.en: Can security measures ever rid the economy of theft and fraud?
questions.zh: 再多的安保措施，能彻底消除经济活动中的盗窃和欺诈吗？

questions.en: Can you see yourself driving across the country in an RV?
questions.zh: 你能想象自己开房车横穿全国吗？

questions.en: Could you be incredibly rich and still have a good conscience?
questions.zh: 一个人能不能非常有钱，同时仍然问心无愧？

questions.en: Does other people's ignorance appall you or can you tolerate it?
questions.zh: 别人的无知会让你非常受不了，还是你比较能包容？

questions.en: How can you become more knowledgeable and current in your field?
questions.zh: 你可以怎样让自己在专业领域里更有知识、跟上最新发展？

questions.en: How can you discipline children while still showing you love them?
questions.zh: 怎样管教孩子，同时还能让他们感受到你爱他们？

questions.en: How can you even out the workload between mothers and fathers?
questions.zh: 怎样才能更公平地分配父母双方的家庭和育儿工作？

questions.en: How can you tell when people are really listening to you?
questions.zh: 你怎样判断别人是真的在认真听你说话？

questions.en: How do incompetent and obnoxious people manage to keep their jobs?
questions.zh: 为什么一些能力不足、又让人讨厌的人还能一直保住工作？

questions.en: How many apps do you regularly use on your mobile devices?
questions.zh: 你在手机或平板上真正经常使用的应用大概有多少个？

questions.en: What about yourself would you like to always keep the same?
questions.zh: 你希望自己有哪些部分永远不要改变？

questions.en: What album have you listened to the most times and why?
questions.zh: 你听得次数最多的一张专辑是哪张？为什么？

questions.en: What are the most hopeful signs of progress in race relations?
questions.zh: 你觉得种族关系正在改善的最有希望的迹象有哪些？

questions.en: What are things you once believed that more knowledge proved different?
questions.zh: 有哪些事情是你以前深信不疑，后来因为了解更多才发现并非如此？

questions.en: What are three questions you would like a world survey of?
questions.zh: 如果能做一项全球调查，你最想问全世界哪三个问题？

questions.en: What are three things you wouldn't allow your children to do?
questions.zh: 有哪三件事是你绝不会允许孩子做的？

questions.en: What are two things that are appealing about men (or women)?
questions.zh: 男性或女性身上，有哪两点是你觉得特别有吸引力的？

questions.en: What benefits do you see in believing in a higher power?
questions.zh: 你觉得相信更高层次的力量会带来哪些好处？

questions.en: What buzzword or phrase was highly popular during your teenage years?
questions.zh: 你十几岁时最流行的一个词或一句口头语是什么？

questions.en: What changes would you like to see made at your company?
questions.zh: 你希望自己所在的公司发生哪些改变？

questions.en: What did you once find frightening that no longer scares you?
questions.zh: 以前有什么事情让你害怕，但现在已经不怕了？

questions.en: What else might nations do, besides war, to settle their differences?
questions.zh: 你觉得国家之间除了战争，还能用什么方式解决分歧？

questions.en: What goes through your mind when you see a newborn child?
questions.zh: 看到刚出生的婴儿时，你脑子里最先会想到什么？

questions.en: What grade would you like to substitute teach for two months?
questions.zh: 如果代课两个月，你最想教哪个年级？

questions.en: What inanimate object would you choose to be the latest fad?
questions.zh: 如果让一个没有生命的物品成为下一个潮流，你会选什么？

questions.en: What one month on the calendar would you like to eliminate?
questions.zh: 如果可以从日历里删掉一个月，你会删哪个？

questions.en: What personality traits would you like to eliminate or manage better?
questions.zh: 你最想消除或更好控制自己的哪些性格特质？

questions.en: What serious illnesses or accidents did you have as a child?
questions.zh: 小时候你得过哪些严重疾病或发生过哪些事故？

questions.en: What signs of aging are you starting to see in yourself?
questions.zh: 你开始在自己身上看到哪些变老的迹象？

questions.en: What sound would you miss if suddenly unable to hear it?
questions.zh: 如果突然再也听不到一种声音，你最会想念什么？

questions.en: What steps have you taken to prevent climate change from worsening?
questions.zh: 为了防止气候变化继续恶化，你采取过哪些行动？

questions.en: What stories have you been told about yourself as a baby?
questions.zh: 别人跟你讲过哪些关于你婴儿时期的故事？

questions.en: What words would you love to have whispered in your ear?
questions.zh: 你最想听到别人贴着耳边对你说什么？

questions.en: What would be your company's epitaph if it went under tomorrow?
questions.zh: 如果你的公司明天倒闭，你觉得最适合写在它“墓碑”上的一句话是什么？

questions.en: What would you want to be if talentwise it was possible?
questions.zh: 如果完全不受天赋限制，你最想成为什么？

questions.en: What's a word for which you have always needed a synonym?
questions.zh: 有没有一个词，你总是需要查它的近义词？

questions.en: What's an ideal way to spend a hot Saturday in mid-July?
questions.zh: 七月中旬一个炎热的星期六，你理想的度过方式是什么？

questions.en: What's one of the simple pleasures of life you truly enjoy?
questions.zh: 生活中有哪些简单的小快乐是你真正享受的？

questions.en: What's one thing about living in this country that you value?
questions.zh: 生活在这个国家，你最珍惜哪一点？

questions.en: What's one thing about your life now that you wouldn't change?
questions.zh: 你现在的生活里，有哪一件事是你完全不想改变的？

questions.en: What's one thing in life that you care most deeply about?
questions.zh: 人生中你最在乎的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What's something someone said or did that you found very unattractive?
questions.zh: 别人说过或做过什么，让你瞬间觉得对方很没有吸引力？

questions.en: What's something you forgot once that you will never forget again?
questions.zh: 有什么事情你曾经忘记过一次，从那以后就再也不会忘？

questions.en: What's something you would like to do to improve your life?
questions.zh: 你最想做哪一件事来改善自己的生活？

questions.en: What's the most difficult thing for you to say "no" to?
questions.zh: 什么事情最让你难以说“不”？

questions.en: What's the most exciting thing you have done on a dare?
questions.zh: 你因为别人激将或打赌而做过最刺激的事是什么？

questions.en: What's the oldest age that you would want to begin parenthood?
questions.zh: 你认为开始当父母最晚可以到多少岁？

questions.en: When was the last time you made an international telephone call?
questions.zh: 你上一次打国际长途电话是什么时候？

questions.en: Would you rather be a painter, a writer, or a musician?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当画家、作家还是音乐家？

questions.en: Would you rather go to an opera or a county fair?
questions.zh: 你宁愿去看歌剧，还是去参加县级嘉年华？

questions.en: Would you rather have the power to fly or to disappear?
questions.zh: 你宁愿拥有飞行能力，还是隐身能力？

questions.en: If you had to live in one of the two biggest cities in your country, which would you choose?
questions.zh: 如果必须住在你们国家最大的两座城市之一，你会选哪座？

questions.en: Would you rather swim in the ocean or in a pool?
questions.zh: 你宁愿在海里游泳，还是在泳池里？

questions.en: Can civilians who never served in the military ever fully understand war?
questions.zh: 从未参军的平民，真的能完全理解战争吗？

questions.en: Does your mind ever go blank in the middle of doing something?
questions.zh: 你有没有做到一半时脑子突然一片空白的情况？

questions.en: How can one keep from becoming too dependent on one's loved one?
questions.zh: 怎样才能在亲密关系中避免对爱的人过度依赖？

questions.en: How does one "shape the will without breaking the spirit" of children?
questions.zh: 怎样在不伤害孩子精神和自尊的情况下培养他们的意志力？

questions.en: How were you affected by the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001?
questions.zh: 2001年9月11日恐怖袭击对你产生了什么影响？

questions.en: In your closest relationships, what is the connection between intimacy and independence?
questions.zh: 在最亲密的关系里，你觉得亲密和独立之间是什么关系？

questions.en: Is it harder, easier, or the same to love an adopted child?
questions.zh: 爱一个收养的孩子，会比爱亲生孩子更难、更容易，还是一样？

questions.en: Tell a story you heard about one of your aunts or uncles.
questions.zh: 讲一个你听过的、关于叔叔或阿姨的故事。

questions.en: Tell about an incident with a child in a supermarket or store.
questions.zh: 说说一次你在超市或商店里遇到孩子的难忘经历。

questions.en: Under what circumstances, if any, is it okay to hit a child?
questions.zh: 在什么情况下，如果有的话，你觉得打孩子是可以接受的？

questions.en: What activities in your community would you like to take part in?
questions.zh: 你希望参加社区里的哪些活动？

questions.en: What are some of the most tragic things happening in our world?
questions.zh: 你觉得当今世界正在发生哪些最悲惨的事情？

questions.en: What are the most negative changes you have seen in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 你有生以来看到过哪些最负面的社会变化？

questions.en: What are the most positive changes you have seen in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 你有生以来看到过哪些最积极的社会变化？

questions.en: What are two things that are not appealing about men (or women)?
questions.zh: 男性或女性身上，有哪两点是你觉得不太有吸引力的？

questions.en: What checks do you write every month that you hate to sign?
questions.zh: 每个月有哪些账单是你最不情愿签支票或付款的？

questions.en: What could you do, change, or eliminate to help simplify your life?
questions.zh: 你可以做什么、改变什么或删掉什么，让生活更简单？

questions.en: What leading figure in a field would you like to hear speak?
questions.zh: 你最想听哪个领域的顶尖人物现场演讲？

questions.en: What might you have been like if you had had perfect nurturing?
questions.zh: 如果你从小得到的是完美的照顾和养育，你觉得自己现在会是什么样？

questions.en: What musical instrument would you like to be able to play professionally?
questions.zh: 如果可以达到职业演奏水平，你最想会哪种乐器？

questions.en: What person did you successfully pursue in a short amount of time?
questions.zh: 你曾经在很短时间里成功追求到谁？

questions.en: What person did you unsuccessfully pursue over a long period of time?
questions.zh: 你曾长期追求过但最终没有成功的人是谁？

questions.en: What physical activity, like running or kayaking, would you like to begin?
questions.zh: 你想开始哪一种身体活动，比如跑步或皮划艇？

questions.en: What problem, if solved, would give you the greatest peace of mind?
questions.zh: 如果有一个问题能被彻底解决，什么最能让你获得内心平静？

questions.en: What project(s) have you worked on that didn't turn out as planned?
questions.zh: 你参与过哪些最后没有按计划完成的项目？

questions.en: What things did you see or overhear that no one knew about?
questions.zh: 你曾看到或无意听到过哪些别人完全不知道你知道的事情？

questions.en: What things do you do to make it through a tough workday?
questions.zh: 特别难熬的工作日里，你会做什么让自己撑过去？

questions.en: What things do you say and do when put on telephone hold?
questions.zh: 电话被要求等待时，你通常会说什么、做什么？

questions.en: What three wishes do you have for your genie in a bottle?
questions.zh: 如果你有一个神灯精灵，可以许三个愿，你会许什么？

questions.en: What word would you not want to spell in a spelling bee?
questions.zh: 参加拼字比赛时，哪个单词是你最不希望抽到的？

questions.en: What would be the message you would like to give your great-grandchildren?
questions.zh: 如果能给曾孙辈留一句话，你最想告诉他们什么？

questions.en: What would you say to the person you lost and later found?
questions.zh: 如果见到一个曾经失去、后来又找回的人，你最想对他说什么？

questions.en: What would your company be like if you had never worked there?
questions.zh: 如果你从没在现在的公司工作过，你觉得它会有什么不同？

questions.en: What's a more suitable first name for you or someone you know?
questions.zh: 如果可以给自己或认识的人换个更合适的名字，你会选什么？

questions.en: What's one personality trait you have tried hardest to change in yourself?
questions.zh: 你最努力想改变自己的哪一个性格特质？

questions.en: What's something in nature that you would like to bottle and sell?
questions.zh: 大自然里的什么东西，是你很想装进瓶子里拿来卖的？

questions.en: What's something you think moms will always be better at than dads?
questions.zh: 你觉得有哪些事情妈妈永远会比爸爸更擅长？

questions.en: What's the most difficult or time-consuming task you have done by hand?
questions.zh: 你亲手完成过最困难或最耗时间的任务是什么？

questions.en: Can you be nonviolent in a conflict with a violent adversary and survive?
questions.zh: 面对一个暴力的对手，坚持非暴力还能生存下来吗？

questions.en: Do elected officials care more about being reelected than doing what is right?
questions.zh: 你觉得民选官员更关心连任，还是更关心做正确的事？

questions.en: Do you know someone whose life or personality has been changed by money?
questions.zh: 你认识有没有谁因为钱而明显改变了人生或性格？

questions.en: Does what we say to each other make a difference in our self-confidence?
questions.zh: 我们彼此说的话，会不会直接影响对方的自信？

questions.en: Does your lifestyle undermine any values you would want your kids to have?
questions.zh: 你的生活方式有没有违背你希望孩子拥有的某些价值观？

questions.en: How can you help your children to get along better with other children?
questions.zh: 你可以怎样帮助孩子和其他孩子相处得更好？

questions.en: How has the role of romance changed in your life over the years?
questions.zh: 这些年里，浪漫在你生活中的角色发生了怎样的变化？

questions.en: How many times have you felt you wouldn't recover from a broken heart?
questions.zh: 你有多少次心碎到觉得自己再也恢复不过来？

questions.en: Is it hard for you to sit still or are you mainly sedentary?
questions.zh: 你很难安静坐着，还是本身比较少动？

questions.en: Is there someone you confide in or do you keep troubles to yourself?
questions.zh: 你有会倾诉烦恼的人吗，还是通常自己扛着？

questions.en: The Middle East: are your sympathies more with the Israelis or the Palestinians?
questions.zh: 关于中东问题，你的同情更多偏向以色列还是巴勒斯坦？

questions.en: What age would you like to be for the rest of your life?
questions.zh: 如果余生都能停留在某个年龄，你会选几岁？

questions.en: What are you doing or did you do to escape a bad situation?
questions.zh: 你现在或过去曾做过什么来逃离一段糟糕处境？

questions.en: What aspects of other cultures would you like to incorporate in your life?
questions.zh: 其他文化中有哪些东西，是你很想融入自己生活的？

questions.en: What event(s) did you want to see that you bought scalper tickets for?
questions.zh: 你有没有为了看某场活动，从黄牛手里买过票？是什么活动？

questions.en: What issue concerns you the most and what have you done about it?
questions.zh: 哪个问题最让你担心？你为此做过什么？

questions.en: What is actually worth buying in a discount shop?
questions.zh: 在折扣店里，有哪些东西特别值得买？

questions.en: What people of great potential have you known and what happened to them?
questions.zh: 你认识过哪些很有潜力的人？他们后来怎么样了？

questions.en: What steps have you taken to prevent the destruction of the rain forest?
questions.zh: 为了减少雨林被破坏，你采取过哪些行动？

questions.en: What struggles or weaknesses in your life have brought you the greatest frustration?
questions.zh: 你人生中哪些挣扎或弱点给你带来过最大的挫败感？

questions.en: What talents or skills of yours are now rusty from lack of practice?
questions.zh: 你有哪些才能或技能因为太久没练而生疏了？

questions.en: What things, people, or activities give you peace of mind and restore you?
questions.zh: 哪些东西、人或活动最能让你安心、恢复能量？

questions.en: What three instructions would you leave loved ones on getting through life successfully?
questions.zh: 如果只能给亲人留下三条成功过人生的指示，你会写什么？

questions.en: What would be the ideal number of children if money was no concern?
questions.zh: 如果完全不用考虑经济压力，你觉得理想的孩子数量是多少？

questions.en: What would be the premise of a novel you would like to write?
questions.zh: 如果你写一部小说，最想用什么故事设定或核心情节？

questions.en: What would it take for you to give up all your worldly possessions?
questions.zh: 什么条件会让你愿意放弃所有世俗财产？

questions.en: What would you say to your latest ex if you saw them again?
questions.zh: 如果再次见到最近的一位前任，你最想说什么？

questions.en: What's a choice in life that you would never want to make again?
questions.zh: 人生中有什么选择是你绝不想再做一次的？

questions.en: What's an area in which you would be able to teach to others?
questions.zh: 有什么领域是你有能力教别人的？

questions.en: What's funny about yourself that makes you smile when you think about it?
questions.zh: 想到自己哪一点时，会让你觉得很好笑、忍不住微笑？

questions.en: What's the best and worst thing that has happened with your current partner?
questions.zh: 你和现在的伴侣之间，发生过最好和最糟糕的事情分别是什么？

questions.en: What's the minimum amount of money you need a year to support yourself?
questions.zh: 你一年最低需要多少钱，才能维持自己的生活？

questions.en: What's the worst and best thing an ex-lover has ever done to you?
questions.zh: 前任为你做过最好和最糟糕的事情分别是什么？

questions.en: What's the worst rejection you have experienced and how did you handle it?
questions.zh: 你经历过最严重的一次拒绝是什么？你当时怎么应对？

questions.en: When picking a life partner, do you follow your head or your heart?
questions.zh: 选择终身伴侣时，你更多听理智还是听感情？

questions.en: Are there any parts of the body that you dislike touching or having touched?
questions.zh: 你身体上有没有哪些部位是不喜欢碰别人、也不喜欢别人碰的？

questions.en: At 100 years old, what would you be doing and where would you be?
questions.zh: 如果活到100岁，你觉得自己会在哪里、做什么？

questions.en: How many hands do you keep on the steering wheel when driving a car?
questions.zh: 开车时你通常会把几只手放在方向盘上？

questions.en: Talk about "your crowd" - the people with whom you spend the most time.
questions.zh: 说说“你的圈子”——也就是你最常相处的那群人。

questions.en: What goes through your mind when you see people who have endured great hardship?
questions.zh: 看到经历过巨大苦难的人时，你脑子里通常会想到什么？

questions.en: What is the last thing you see before you close your eyes at night?
questions.zh: 晚上闭眼前，你最后看到的通常是什么？

questions.en: What wall, boundary, or border would you like to dismantle somewhere in the world?
questions.zh: 世界上有什么墙、边界或国境，是你最希望被拆除的？

questions.en: What would be the advantages and disadvantages of one language for the whole world?
questions.zh: 如果全世界都使用同一种语言，会有哪些优点和缺点？

questions.en: What would someone have to do to make you fall in love with them?
questions.zh: 一个人需要做什么，才最有可能让你爱上他/她？

questions.en: What's a new belief system(s) you adopted and how did it change your life?
questions.zh: 你后来接受过哪一种新的信念体系？它怎样改变了你的人生？

questions.en: What's one of the best ways for someone to express their love for you?
questions.zh: 别人表达爱时，哪一种方式最能让你感受到？

questions.en: What's one thing you really disliked as a child that you now fully appreciate?
questions.zh: 小时候你特别讨厌、但现在完全懂得欣赏的东西是什么？

questions.en: What's something you would like to do that you are not allowed to do?
questions.zh: 有什么事情是你很想做、但规则或法律不允许做的？

questions.en: What's the best thing that could happen if you took a risk and succeeded?
questions.zh: 如果你冒一次风险而且成功了，最好的结果可能是什么？

questions.en: What's the most likely reason someone would want to join or leave your company?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个人最可能因为什么加入或离开你的公司？

questions.en: Could you stand up for something you thought was right, even though many may disagree?
questions.zh: 即使很多人反对，你也能为自己认为正确的事站出来吗？

questions.en: How much time a day do you spend in front of some kind of screen?
questions.zh: 你每天大概有多少时间面对各种屏幕？

questions.en: In what areas of your life do you need long-term solutions rather than quick fixes?
questions.zh: 你的生活中哪些问题需要长期方案，而不是临时补救？

questions.en: In what situations would you like to be more bold and courageous or more assertive?
questions.zh: 在哪些情况下，你希望自己能更大胆、更勇敢或更果断？

questions.en: Is it easy or hard to adapt your behavior to the company you are in?
questions.zh: 你觉得根据身边不同的人调整自己的行为容易吗？

questions.en: Is there more or less crime in your city or area than a year ago?
questions.zh: 和一年前相比，你所在城市或地区的犯罪更多还是更少？

questions.en: What are five people, places, or things that best define your country's style right now?
questions.zh: 说出五个人、地点或事物，你觉得最能代表当今你所在国家的风格。

questions.en: What are the first thoughts that go through your mind the moment you wake up?
questions.zh: 刚醒来的第一瞬间，你脑子里通常会冒出什么想法？

questions.en: What behavior of yours that doesn't represent the real you do you want to change?
questions.zh: 你有哪些行为其实并不代表真正的自己，是你想改变的？

questions.en: What games have you played to get on the right side of people who matter?
questions.zh: 为了讨好重要人物、和对方建立好关系，你曾用过哪些“策略”？

questions.en: What things do you do between turning off the alarm and walking out the door?
questions.zh: 关掉闹钟到真正走出家门之间，你通常会做哪些事？

questions.en: What things would you want to convey to children to help them along in life?
questions.zh: 你最想告诉孩子哪些人生经验，帮助他们以后走得更顺？

questions.en: What would you say or do if someone offered you a week's pay to shave your head?
questions.zh: 如果有人给你一周的工资让你剃光头，你会答应吗？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you got to choose how you would die?
questions.zh: 如果可以自己选择死亡方式，你会怎么选？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you were given a fortune to spend on helping other people?
questions.zh: 如果你得到一大笔钱，只能用来帮助别人，你会怎么用？

questions.en: What's one function in our culture that you would like to see become more efficient?
questions.zh: 我们的社会文化中，有哪一项功能是你最希望效率更高的？

questions.en: What's the one form of entertainment you would want on a desert island with you?
questions.zh: 如果被困在荒岛上只能带一种娱乐，你会选什么？

questions.en: What's the stupidest thing you bought that seemed like a good idea at the time?
questions.zh: 你买过最愚蠢、但当时觉得特别合理的东西是什么？

questions.en: For what one activity would you like to regain the hours you have lost doing it?
questions.zh: 如果能把浪费在某项活动上的时间全部拿回来，你最想拿回哪一项？

questions.en: What brand names do you buy and swear by and that you would never switch from?
questions.zh: 有哪些品牌是你一直认准、几乎绝不会换的？

questions.en: What category on a quiz show would you choose to get the best chance of winning?
questions.zh: 如果参加电视知识竞赛，为了最大概率获胜，你会选哪个题目类别？

questions.en: What criticism directed at you has been the most difficult for you to let go of?
questions.zh: 别人对你的哪条批评，是你最难放下的？

questions.en: What places do you go to in your mind when you want some peace and quiet?
questions.zh: 当你想得到安静与平和时，脑海里最常去到什么地方？

questions.en: What's one key thing you could do to produce a quantum leap in your personal life?
questions.zh: 如果只做一件关键的事，就能让个人生活出现巨大跃升，你会做什么？

questions.en: What's one negative in your life that you have been able to turn into a positive?
questions.zh: 你成功把生活中的哪一个负面因素转化成了正面的东西？

questions.en: If you were in love with someone but they wanted to stay friends; could you do it?
questions.zh: 如果你爱上一个人，但对方只想做朋友，你还能继续只当朋友吗？

questions.en: Is the aim of schooling to teach how to think or to teach certain skills and facts?
questions.zh: 你觉得学校教育的目的主要是教人思考，还是传授具体技能和知识？

questions.en: What are three steps you need to take to become the person you were meant to be?
questions.zh: 为了成为你真正想成为的人，你现在需要采取哪三个步骤？

questions.en: What natural phenomenon or act of nature would you like to see if you would be safe?
questions.zh: 如果绝对安全，你最想亲眼看到哪一种自然现象？

questions.en: What people do you know who have been laid off or fired in the last economic downturn?
questions.zh: 上一轮经济低迷时，你认识哪些被裁员或解雇的人？

questions.en: What secret fantasies and games did you have as a child that you told no one about?
questions.zh: 小时候你有哪些从没告诉过任何人的秘密幻想或游戏？

questions.en: What would be the effect of women on national security if they were used in direct combat?
questions.zh: 如果女性被安排直接参加战斗，你觉得这会怎样影响国家安全？

questions.en: What's something you had to do that you wouldn't want your children to ever have to do?
questions.zh: 有没有一件你自己不得不经历的事，是你绝不希望自己的孩子也要经历的？

questions.en: What's something you would be tempted to do if you knew you would never be found out?
questions.zh: 如果你知道永远不会被发现，什么事情最可能诱惑你去做？

questions.en: What clubs, social groups, and organizations did you used to belong to and why do you not belong anymore?
questions.zh: 你以前参加过哪些俱乐部、社交团体或组织？后来为什么不再参加了？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you were standing in line and someone cut in front of you?
questions.zh: 如果排队时有人插到你前面，你会说什么或做什么？

questions.en: Define "hope"?
questions.zh: 你会怎样定义“希望”？

questions.en: Name five childhood accomplishments.
questions.zh: 说出五件你童年时期完成过、让自己有成就感的事情。

questions.en: What are your life goals?
questions.zh: 你的人生目标有哪些？

questions.en: What are your unfulfilled dreams?
questions.zh: 你还有哪些没有实现的梦想？

questions.en: Can you describe your first great accomplishment?
questions.zh: 你能描述一下人生中第一次真正重大的成就吗？

questions.en: What cares do you wish to drop?
questions.zh: 有哪些牵挂或烦恼是你希望放下的？

questions.en: What's outlawed that you wish was not?
questions.zh: 现在有哪些被禁止的事情，是你希望它其实合法的？

questions.en: Where did your family go on vacation?
questions.zh: 你小时候家里通常去哪里度假？

questions.en: Will you make a good old person?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己以后会成为一个不错的老人吗？

questions.en: Have you had a recurring dream throughout life?
questions.zh: 你人生中有没有反复出现的同一个梦？

questions.en: What people do you respect for creative achievement?
questions.zh: 你尊敬哪些在创造力方面取得突出成就的人？

questions.en: What will you not tolerate no matter what?
questions.zh: 无论如何你都绝不会容忍什么？

questions.en: What would you like a T-shirt to say?
questions.zh: 如果设计一件T恤，你希望上面写什么？

questions.en: What would you like to be famous for?
questions.zh: 你希望自己因为什么而出名？

questions.en: What would you like to let go of?
questions.zh: 你最想放下什么？

questions.en: Who's someone you wish you had never met?
questions.zh: 有没有一个人是你希望自己从来没认识过的？

questions.en: Are you optimistic or pessimistic about the nation's future?
questions.zh: 对于国家的未来，你更乐观还是更悲观？

questions.en: Of what early accomplishment are you the most proud?
questions.zh: 早年的哪项成就最让你感到骄傲？

questions.en: What business or company do you wish you owned?
questions.zh: 如果可以拥有一家公司，你最想拥有哪一家？

questions.en: What contributions do you dream of making to others?
questions.zh: 你梦想为别人或社会作出什么贡献？

questions.en: What people do you wish you had not trusted?
questions.zh: 有哪些人是你后悔曾经信任过的？

questions.en: What should be the energy resources of the future?
questions.zh: 你觉得未来最应该依赖哪些能源？

questions.en: What's a dream you have had more than once?
questions.zh: 你有没有一个做过不止一次的梦？

questions.en: What would you like to "program" your dreams to be?
questions.zh: 如果能“设定”自己的梦，你希望梦到什么？

questions.en: What would you like to be doing in twenty years?
questions.zh: 二十年后，你最希望自己在做什么？

questions.en: What would you like to be when you grow up?
questions.zh: 如果重新回答“长大后想做什么”，你现在会怎么答？

questions.en: What would you like to build if you knew how?
questions.zh: 如果会做，你最想亲手建造什么？

questions.en: What would you like to do for your children's weddings?
questions.zh: 孩子结婚时，你最希望为他们做什么？

questions.en: How can you relate a recent dream to a current problem?
questions.zh: 你能把最近做的一个梦和现实中的某个问题联系起来吗？

questions.en: Share a hope and a fear you have about the future.
questions.zh: 说一个你对未来的希望，以及一个担忧。

questions.en: What would be the most difficult thing to forgive someone for?
questions.zh: 别人做什么最让你难以原谅？

questions.en: What would you like to own that you don't already own?
questions.zh: 有什么东西是你还没有、但很想拥有的？

questions.en: What's the number one thing to do on your bucket list?
questions.zh: 你的愿望清单上排第一的事情是什么？

questions.en: What is the BEST way to deal with someone who has hurt you?
questions.zh: 对待一个伤害过你的人，最好的方式是什么？

questions.en: When a couple breaks up, does it mean one of the partners has failed?
questions.zh: 一对伴侣分手，是否意味着其中一个人失败了？

questions.en: What's the worst thing that could happen to you if you took a risk and failed?
questions.zh: 如果冒险失败了，最糟糕的后果可能是什么？

questions.en: In what ways might your own attitudes be racist or bigoted?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己的哪些态度可能带有种族偏见或成见？

questions.en: What two people would you like to see in the next presidential race?
questions.zh: 如果下届总统大选可以由你选两个人参选，你会选谁？

questions.en: Should alcoholic beverages be sold online or via mail order?
questions.zh: 你觉得酒精饮料应该允许通过网络或邮购销售吗？

questions.en: Do you think the ends usually justify the means?
questions.zh: 你觉得为了结果，通常可以不择手段吗？

questions.en: Where would you move tomorrow if you could, and why?
questions.zh: 如果明天就能搬去任何地方，你会搬到哪里？为什么？

questions.en: Were you encouraged to explore all your talents and interests no matter how often they changed?
questions.zh: 小时候无论兴趣怎么变化，你都被鼓励去探索自己的各种天赋和兴趣吗？

questions.en: Have you ever been defriended by someone on a social network site? Have you ever defriended anyone?
questions.zh: 你有没有在社交网络上被别人删除好友？你自己删过别人吗？

questions.en: Do you remember your idols?
questions.zh: 你还记得小时候崇拜过的偶像吗？

questions.en: Do you remember any childhood illnesses?
questions.zh: 你还记得童年时得过哪些病吗？

questions.en: Do you remember your bedtime rituals?
questions.zh: 你还记得小时候睡前有哪些固定习惯吗？

questions.en: Do you remember what you daydreamt about?
questions.zh: 你还记得小时候经常幻想什么吗？

questions.en: Do you remember your first big disappointment?
questions.zh: 你还记得人生中第一次重大的失望吗？

questions.en: Do you remember your most embarrassing moment?
questions.zh: 你还记得自己最尴尬的一次经历吗？

questions.en: Do you consider your childhood a happy one?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己的童年总体上快乐吗？

questions.en: Do you remember a gift you made for someone?
questions.zh: 你还记得自己亲手为别人做过什么礼物吗？

questions.en: Do you remember names of the people you meet?
questions.zh: 你擅长记住刚认识的人的名字吗？

questions.en: Do you think you can truly escape your past?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个人真的能摆脱自己的过去吗？

questions.en: Have you ever achieved a success without experiencing fulfillment?
questions.zh: 你有没有取得过很大的成功，却完全没有感到满足？

questions.en: What hobbies did your parents have during your childhood?
questions.zh: 你小时候，父母各自有什么爱好？

questions.en: What kind of work did your father's parents do?
questions.zh: 你父亲那边的祖父母以前做什么工作？

questions.en: What kind of work did your mother's parents do?
questions.zh: 你母亲那边的祖父母以前做什么工作？

questions.en: Do you remember who told you about the birds and bees?
questions.zh: 你还记得是谁第一次向你解释性和生育知识的吗？

questions.en: Do you stay in contact with many people from your past?
questions.zh: 你现在还和过去认识的很多人保持联系吗？

questions.en: Why were we created?
questions.zh: 你觉得人类为什么被创造出来？

questions.en: Why are homeless people homeless?
questions.zh: 为什么有些人会无家可归？

questions.en: Why do moms and dads fight?
questions.zh: 爸爸妈妈为什么会吵架？

questions.en: If you were infertile; would you adopt?
questions.zh: 如果你无法生育，你会考虑收养孩子吗？

questions.en: Why do you want to have kids?
questions.zh: 你为什么想要孩子？

questions.en: Describe your best friends during your teen years.
questions.zh: 描述一下你十几岁时最好的朋友们。

questions.en: Why do people try to change each other?
questions.zh: 人为什么总想改变别人？

questions.en: Would you rather be highly educated or highly successful?
questions.zh: 你宁愿受过很高的教育，还是取得很大的成功？

questions.en: If you went on a honeymoon; where would you go?
questions.zh: 如果去度蜜月，你最想去哪里？

questions.en: Would you rather be known for your intelligence or your personality?
questions.zh: 你宁愿别人因为你的聪明才智还是你的性格记住你？

questions.en: Would you rather be known for your looks or your personality?
questions.zh: 你宁愿别人记住你的外貌，还是你的性格？

questions.en: Would you rather browse through a bookstore or a record store?
questions.zh: 你宁愿逛书店还是唱片店？

questions.en: Would you rather go to war or be a conscientious objector?
questions.zh: 你宁愿上战场，还是因为良心原因拒绝服兵役？

questions.en: Would you rather win by cheating or lose while playing fair?
questions.zh: 你宁愿作弊赢，还是公平比赛但输掉？

questions.en: Would you rather write a bestseller or be a famous model?
questions.zh: 你宁愿写出一本畅销书，还是成为著名模特？

questions.en: Would you rather have no rules or live with the ones that exist?
questions.zh: 你宁愿完全没有规则，还是生活在现有规则之下？

questions.en: Would you rather see Elvis Presley or John Lennon return from the dead?
questions.zh: 如果只能让一位已故音乐传奇复活，你选猫王还是约翰·列侬？

questions.en: Define "commitment." What is the scariest thing and the most rewarding thing about commitment?
questions.zh: 你会怎样定义“承诺”？承诺最可怕和最有回报的部分分别是什么？

questions.en: If a friend of yours wanted a shotgun/whirlwind wedding; would you advise against it?
questions.zh: 如果朋友想非常仓促地结婚，你会劝他/她不要这么做吗？

questions.en: Would you rather be healthy and homeless or have AIDS and live in luxury?
questions.zh: 你宁愿身体健康但无家可归，还是患有艾滋病但过奢华生活？

questions.en: Would you rather live a life of luxury or be known for your generosity?
questions.zh: 你宁愿过奢华生活，还是以慷慨闻名？

questions.en: Do your takes on the joys and anxieties of child-rearing complement or contradict your partner's?
questions.zh: 你和伴侣对育儿的快乐和焦虑，看法更互补还是更冲突？

questions.en: What's something (not immoral or controversial) that if you did it, it would shock everyone?
questions.zh: 有没有一件不违法也不争议的事，如果你去做，会让认识你的人全部震惊？

questions.en: What's something memorable that you experienced that your children will probably never get to experience?
questions.zh: 你经历过什么难忘的事情，是你觉得自己的孩子可能永远没有机会体验的？

questions.en: What's something you truly appreciate or enjoy doing that most others probably don't care for?
questions.zh: 有没有一件事是你真心喜欢、也特别欣赏，但大多数人可能完全不感兴趣？

questions.en: Would you rather be a half hour early to a party or an hour-and-a-half late?
questions.zh: 参加派对你宁愿提前半小时到，还是迟到一个半小时？

questions.en: Would you rather go a week without brushing your teeth or without taking a shower?
questions.zh: 你宁愿一周不刷牙，还是一周不洗澡？

questions.en: Would you rather try everything and not succeed or try only one thing and succeed?
questions.zh: 你宁愿什么都尝试却都没成功，还是只尝试一件事并取得成功？

questions.en: What's one modern-day convenience you didn't have as a child that was easy to live without?
questions.zh: 现在的哪一种便利设施，是你小时候没有却也完全能过得好好的？

questions.en: What's something you did for your children that you would never have done for anyone else?
questions.zh: 你为孩子做过什么事情，是你觉得自己绝不会为其他人做的？

questions.en: What's the one thing that someone has said or done that showed their support for you?
questions.zh: 别人说过或做过什么，让你最明显感受到对方在支持你？

questions.en: When was a time that peer pressure influenced you and was the outcome positive or negative?
questions.zh: 有没有一次同伴压力影响了你？最后结果是正面的还是负面的？

questions.en: Would you rather live safely and longer or go hog wild and live a shorter time?
questions.zh: 你宁愿安全谨慎地活得更久，还是疯狂尽兴但寿命更短？

questions.en: Do terrorism threats ever stop you from attending a big event or going out in public places?
questions.zh: 恐怖袭击的威胁会不会让你因此不去大型活动或公共场所？

questions.en: What has been the most difficult decision or series of decisions where your integrity was at risk?
questions.zh: 你做过最艰难的一项决定是什么，尤其是那种会考验你诚信的决定？

questions.en: What is the BEST way to show children that you really love them, besides hugs and kisses?
questions.zh: 除了拥抱和亲吻之外，向孩子表达真心爱他们最好的方式是什么？

questions.en: Would you rather be a star and die at forty-two or live to ninety without any fame?
questions.zh: 你宁愿成为明星但42岁去世，还是活到90岁却毫无名气？

questions.en: Would you rather confront someone about lying or let it slide and try to forget about it?
questions.zh: 如果发现别人撒谎，你宁愿当面对质，还是算了、尽量忘掉？

questions.en: Would you rather fall in love and lose that person or never fall in love at all?
questions.zh: 你宁愿真正爱过一个人但最终失去对方，还是一生从未爱上任何人？

questions.en: What are the best and worst business decisions you ever made and how did they affect your life?
questions.zh: 你做过最好和最糟糕的商业决定分别是什么？它们怎样影响了你的人生？

questions.en: What different careers would you like to have if you had to make a change every seven years?
questions.zh: 如果人生每七年必须换一次职业，你最想依次体验哪些职业？

questions.en: When telling stories or relating details of your day, do you tend to exaggerate, understate, or be factual?
questions.zh: 讲述故事或分享一天的细节时，你通常会夸大、淡化，还是尽量客观？

questions.en: Can people be in love with each other even if they don't want to stay together as life partners?
questions.zh: 两个人即使不想继续作为终身伴侣，也仍然可能彼此相爱吗？

questions.en: How do we move away from the pursuit of the right answer to the capacity to generate profound questions?
questions.zh: 我们怎样才能不再只追求“正确答案”，而是培养提出深刻问题的能力？

questions.en: What are three barriers that keep you from reaching your full potential and what would help you overcome them?
questions.zh: 阻碍你发挥全部潜力的三个主要障碍是什么？怎样才能克服？

questions.en: What's the difference between you and your partner that you value the most and one that you consider problematic?
questions.zh: 你和伴侣之间，你最珍惜哪一种差异？哪一种差异又最容易造成问题？

questions.en: Does a woman have the right to get pregnant even if her partner has said they doesn't want a child?
questions.zh: 如果伴侣明确表示不想要孩子，女性是否仍有权决定怀孕？

questions.en: What five people would you take to a desert island and what would each contribute to the quality of life?
questions.zh: 如果流落荒岛，你会带哪五个人？每个人分别能为生活质量贡献什么？

questions.en: What new devices or machines would you like to have five to ten years from now to make life easier?
questions.zh: 未来五到十年，你最希望出现哪些新设备或机器来让生活更轻松？

questions.en: What do you own that is worth almost nothing but that you would not sell at any price?
questions.zh: 你拥有的什么东西几乎不值钱，却无论出多少钱你都不会卖？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you had eight hectares of land and the money to develop it as you choose?
questions.zh: 如果你有八公顷土地和足够的钱，可以随意开发，你会怎么规划？

questions.en: What's the one thing you would be willing to practice at least one hour a day until you became great at it?
questions.zh: 有没有一件事是你愿意每天至少练一个小时，直到真正做到很厉害的？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you were given a choice to either be a baby again or a fifty year old?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择重新变成婴儿，或直接变成50岁的人，你会选哪个？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you knew that you were going to have a disabled baby early enough to terminate the pregnancy?
questions.zh: 如果怀孕早期就知道孩子会有残障，而且仍可以选择终止妊娠，你会怎么做？

questions.en: What's the right choice between a man and a woman equally qualified for a managerial position when there are no other women at the top?
questions.zh: 如果一个男性和一个女性对管理职位同样合格，但公司高层完全没有女性，你觉得应该怎样选择？

questions.en: What would you say or do if you were chosen to join a space mission to colonize the universe and you would never set foot on Earth again?
questions.zh: 如果你被选中参加一项开拓宇宙的太空任务，而且再也不能回到地球，你会说什么、做什么？

questions.en: You can have one person from any time in history call you for advice and follow what you tell them to do. Who would you want it to be?
questions.zh: 如果历史上任何一个人都能打电话来向你求建议，而且一定会照做，你希望是谁？

questions.en: Where did you grow up?
questions.zh: 你在哪里长大？

questions.en: What type of grandparent would you be?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己会成为怎样的祖父母？

questions.en: What occupational certifications would you like to achieve?
questions.zh: 你还想取得哪些职业资格或认证？

questions.en: What higher educational degrees would you like to achieve?
questions.zh: 你还想获得哪些更高的学历或学位？

questions.en: Who's your favorite relative apart from your parents and siblings?
questions.zh: 除了父母和兄弟姐妹之外，你最喜欢哪位亲戚？

questions.en: Do you believe that it is possible to divine the future?
questions.zh: 你相信人可以预知未来吗？

questions.en: What five projects do you wish you were presently involved with?
questions.zh: 如果可以自由选择，你现在最希望参与哪五个项目？

questions.en: What great accomplishments or world developments have occurred during your lifetime?
questions.zh: 在你有生之年，发生过哪些伟大的成就或世界性发展？

questions.en: What tokens of your childhood do you wish you had saved?
questions.zh: 童年时期有哪些纪念物，是你现在希望当时保存下来的？

questions.en: What was your family's favorite snack when you were growing up?
questions.zh: 你小时候家里最常吃、最喜欢的零食是什么？

questions.en: What will you absolutely not do in front of another person?
questions.zh: 有什么事情是你绝不会在别人面前做的？

questions.en: What's something you found out that you wish you never knew?
questions.zh: 你曾得知过什么事实，是你希望自己从来不知道的？

questions.en: What's something you have dreamed of doing for a long time?
questions.zh: 有什么事情是你已经梦想做了很多年的？

questions.en: What's something you wish you never had to worry about again?
questions.zh: 你希望自己从今以后再也不用担心什么？

questions.en: If you could choose something to dream about, what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果可以指定今晚的梦，你会选择梦见什么？

questions.en: In what ways do you wish you could change your business history?
questions.zh: 你的商业经历中，有哪些地方是你希望可以改写的？

questions.en: What about you as a child do you hope people will remember?
questions.zh: 关于童年时的你，你最希望别人记住什么？

questions.en: What mentors, dead or alive, do you wish you had access to?
questions.zh: 无论对方已经去世还是还活着，你最希望有机会得到哪位导师的指导？

questions.en: What's something you got rid of that you wish you had back?
questions.zh: 有没有什么东西你已经扔掉或处理掉，现在却很想拿回来？

questions.en: What's something you really wish you had not started earlier in life?
questions.zh: 人生早期开始过什么事情，是你现在真心希望自己当时没开始的？

questions.en: Who's someone you wish you had seen more of as an adult?
questions.zh: 成年以后，有没有一个人是你希望当时能更多见面的？

questions.en: What would you like to be able to create with your own hands?
questions.zh: 如果可以亲手创造一样东西，你最想做什么？

questions.en: What would you like to receive or do for your anniversary this year?
questions.zh: 今年的结婚纪念日，你最希望收到什么或做什么？

questions.en: What's the greatest goal you want to achieve within the next five years?
questions.zh: 未来五年内，你最想实现的最大目标是什么？

questions.en: What are three things you would most like to accomplish in the next year?
questions.zh: 未来一年里，你最想完成哪三件事？

questions.en: What did you wish for more often and/ or more sincerely than anything else?
questions.zh: 你过去最经常、最真诚地祈愿过什么？

questions.en: What would you like to say to adults who wish they were children again?
questions.zh: 对于那些希望自己重新变成孩子的成年人，你最想说什么？

questions.en: What would you like to see featured in the news in the near future?
questions.zh: 你希望近期新闻里更多报道什么？

questions.en: Will you let a robot physically assist you or monitor you as you get older?
questions.zh: 等你年纪大了，你愿意让机器人扶助你或监测你的身体状况吗？

questions.en: If an activity doesn't result in progress toward a goal, is it a waste of time?
questions.zh: 如果一项活动不能推动你靠近任何目标，它就是浪费时间吗？

questions.en: If your country offered a national health insurance scheme, would you sign up or opt out?
questions.zh: 如果国家推出全民医保计划，你会参加，还是选择不参加？

questions.en: Which public service gives you the best value for your tax money - defense, police, public broadcasting, schools, or something else?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪项公共服务最对得起你交的税——国防、警察、公共广播、学校，还是其他？

questions.en: How do we leverage the immense power and potential of the internet to enable learners and teachers to connect in purposeful ways and make the world a safer, saner, and more just place?
questions.zh: 我们怎样利用互联网巨大的力量，让学习者和教师有目的地连接，同时让世界更安全、更理性、更公平？

questions.en: Would you skydive?
questions.zh: 你会跳伞吗？

questions.en: Would you change careers?
questions.zh: 你会考虑转行吗？

questions.en: Would you scuba dive?
questions.zh: 你会潜水吗？

questions.en: Would you try s&m?
questions.zh: 你会尝试S&M或施虐受虐式性行为吗？

questions.en: Would you deliver a baby?
questions.zh: 你愿意帮人接生吗？

questions.en: Would you report software piracy?
questions.zh: 如果发现软件盗版，你会举报吗？

questions.en: Would you shoot a burglar?
questions.zh: 如果有人闯入你家盗窃，你会开枪吗？

questions.en: Would you try parachute jumping?
questions.zh: 你会尝试跳伞运动吗？

questions.en: How would you fix "the system?"?
questions.zh: 如果让你“修好这个体制”，你会从哪里下手？

questions.en: How would you solve littering problems?
questions.zh: 你会怎样解决乱扔垃圾的问题？

questions.en: Would you ever adopt a child?
questions.zh: 你会考虑收养孩子吗？

questions.en: Would you ever be a whistleblower?
questions.zh: 你会成为揭发内部问题的“吹哨人”吗？

questions.en: Would you like to live forever?
questions.zh: 你想永远活下去吗？

questions.en: Would you report a too-large paycheck?
questions.zh: 如果工资单多发了很多钱，你会主动报告吗？

questions.en: How would you battle an unscrupulous manufacturer?
questions.zh: 面对一个不讲道德的制造商，你会怎样对抗？

questions.en: Were you generally popular or unpopular? Why?
questions.zh: 你以前总体上算受欢迎还是不受欢迎？为什么？

questions.en: Would you compete in a beauty contest?
questions.zh: 你会参加选美比赛吗？

questions.en: Would you swim across the Amazon River?
questions.zh: 你敢横渡亚马逊河吗？

questions.en: Would you take a golden parachute plan?
questions.zh: 如果公司给你一笔高额离职补偿，你会接受吗？

questions.en: Would you try participating in an orgy?
questions.zh: 你会尝试参加多人性行为吗？

questions.en: How would you describe your choice of jeans?
questions.zh: 你会怎样形容自己选择牛仔裤的标准？

questions.en: How would you like to influence people's minds?
questions.zh: 如果可以，你希望怎样影响别人的想法？

questions.en: What would you do if you went blind?
questions.zh: 如果失明了，你会怎么生活？

questions.en: Would you ever donate money to a televangelist?
questions.zh: 你会捐钱给电视布道者吗？

questions.en: Would you want your children to be lawyers?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的孩子以后当律师吗？

questions.en: How would you like to change your outer life?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的外在生活发生什么变化？

questions.en: How would you react if your child was homosexual?
questions.zh: 如果你的孩子是同性恋，你会怎么反应？

questions.en: What would you do if the draft was reinstated?
questions.zh: 如果恢复征兵制，你会怎么应对？

questions.en: What would you do on a free sunny afternoon?
questions.zh: 一个阳光明媚、完全自由的下午，你会做什么？

questions.en: What's the most boring thing you can imagine doing?
questions.zh: 你能想象最无聊的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Would you clean the outside windows of a skyscraper?
questions.zh: 你愿意清洗摩天大楼外侧的窗户吗？

questions.en: Would you clone yourself if you had the chance?
questions.zh: 如果有机会，你会克隆一个自己吗？

questions.en: Would you ever have your sperm or eggs frozen?
questions.zh: 你会考虑冷冻自己的精子或卵子吗？

questions.en: Would you like to be on a talk show?
questions.zh: 你想上谈话节目吗？

questions.en: Would you marry someone who is atheist or agnostic?
questions.zh: 你会和无神论者或不可知论者结婚吗？

questions.en: Would you perjure yourself to protect someone you love?
questions.zh: 为了保护自己爱的人，你会在法庭上作伪证吗？

questions.en: Would you ride 150 mph in a race car?
questions.zh: 你愿意坐赛车以每小时150英里的速度行驶吗？

questions.en: Would you try something new if your partner asked?
questions.zh: 如果伴侣提出要求，你愿意尝试以前没做过的新东西吗？

questions.en: How would you like to spend most of your time?
questions.zh: 你最希望把大部分时间花在什么事情上？

questions.en: If you were a plant, what kind would you be?
questions.zh: 如果你是一种植物，你会是什么？

questions.en: What would you do if you met your exact double?
questions.zh: 如果遇到一个和你完全一模一样的人，你会怎么做？

questions.en: What would you do if your teenager stole from you?
questions.zh: 如果你的青少年孩子偷你的东西，你会怎么处理？

questions.en: Would you like to take an ancestry genetic DNA test?
questions.zh: 你想做祖源基因DNA检测吗？

questions.en: Would you turn in a lawbreaker or play it safe?
questions.zh: 如果知道有人违法，你会举报，还是为了安全选择不管？

questions.en: If you could choose your height, how tall would you be?
questions.zh: 如果可以自己选择身高，你希望多高？

questions.en: What would you do for a kid having a temper tantrum?
questions.zh: 孩子大发脾气时，你会怎么处理？

questions.en: What would you do if you found out you had AIDS?
questions.zh: 如果发现自己感染了艾滋病病毒或患有艾滋病，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Would you like to disappear for a long period of time?
questions.zh: 你有没有想过消失很长一段时间，不和任何人联系？

questions.en: Would you sit in the front seat of a roller coaster?
questions.zh: 坐过山车时你会愿意坐第一排吗？

questions.en: What would you do if you were handed a month's wages to spend on anything?
questions.zh: 如果有一个月的工资可以随便花，你会买什么或做什么？

questions.en: Would you like to be on a jury or try to get out of it?
questions.zh: 你愿意当陪审员，还是会想办法避免？

questions.en: What's your saddest memory?
questions.zh: 你最悲伤的一段记忆是什么？

questions.en: What's your most treasured memory?
questions.zh: 你最珍贵的一段记忆是什么？

questions.en: If you were lonely, who would you seek out?
questions.zh: 如果感到孤独，你会去找谁？

questions.en: Would you lie so as not to hurt someone's feelings?
questions.zh: 为了不伤害别人的感受，你会撒谎吗？

questions.en: Do you still use any foreign languages you spoke while growing up?
questions.zh: 你小时候会说的外语，现在还有在使用吗？

questions.en: What kind of life would a child born to teenage parents experience?
questions.zh: 由青少年父母生下的孩子，可能会经历怎样的生活？

questions.en: Are there unforgivable acts? What are they and why?
questions.zh: 你觉得有些行为是永远无法原谅的吗？哪些？为什么？

questions.en: Why can't a nuclear weapons freeze be successfully negotiated?
questions.zh: 为什么核武器冻结或限制协议这么难谈成？

questions.en: How can we grow global-mindedness in youth? Does it matter?
questions.zh: 怎样才能让年轻人拥有更全球化的视野？这重要吗？

questions.en: If you don't have kids already, do you want kids?
questions.zh: 如果你现在还没有孩子，将来想要吗？

questions.en: If you had to, could you kill someone in war?
questions.zh: 如果在战争中必须这么做，你能杀死一个人吗？

questions.en: If love makes the world go round; what does lust do?
questions.zh: 如果爱让世界运转，那欲望又会让世界怎样？

questions.en: If you got a tattoo, where and what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果纹身，你会纹在哪里、纹什么？

questions.en: Was there ever a bully in your life? What was they like?
questions.zh: 你人生中遇到过霸凌者吗？对方是什么样的人？

questions.en: If you had to do it over; would you marry the same person?
questions.zh: 如果人生重来一次，你还会和同一个人结婚吗？

questions.en: To whom did you turn for advice as a teenager? Why that person?
questions.zh: 十几岁时你最常向谁寻求建议？为什么是那个人？

questions.en: Do you know your credit score? Do you know how to find out your credit score?
questions.zh: 你知道自己的信用评分吗？知道怎样查询吗？

questions.en: Is it possible to agree on a basic set of values to teach schoolchildren? Which ones?
questions.zh: 你觉得大家能否就学校应该教给孩子的一套基本价值观达成共识？应该包括哪些？

questions.en: Would you rather pick out your engagement or wedding ring or be surprised by your fiancé(e)?
questions.zh: 订婚或结婚戒指，你宁愿自己挑，还是让未婚夫/未婚妻给你惊喜？

questions.en: What part of your life is "on hold" now? What has to happen before you can move on?
questions.zh: 你现在生活中的哪一部分像是被按下了暂停键？需要发生什么你才能继续往前？

questions.en: Would you rather be rich beyond counting but exiled from your homeland, or stay and have little money?
questions.zh: 你宁愿富可敌国但被永久驱逐出祖国，还是留在祖国但没什么钱？

questions.en: Would you rather be the worst player on a championship team or the best player on a last-place team?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当冠军队里最差的球员，还是垫底球队里最好的球员？

questions.en: What's one item that symbolizes the times in which we live and why do you see it as a symbol?
questions.zh: 如果选一样东西代表我们所处的这个时代，你会选什么？为什么？

questions.en: Where did they settle and why?
questions.zh: 他们最后在哪里定居？为什么选择那里？

questions.en: What do you contribute to your family?
questions.zh: 你为家庭贡献了什么？

questions.en: What do you depend on your family for?
questions.zh: 你会依赖家人为你提供哪些东西或支持？

questions.en: Do you share the same values as your parents?
questions.zh: 你和父母的价值观大体一致吗？

questions.en: What do you and your siblings have in common?
questions.zh: 你和兄弟姐妹有哪些共同点？

questions.en: Do you need to be indispensable to family and friends?
questions.zh: 你会不会很需要自己成为家人和朋友不可替代的人？

questions.en: What's the last place you went for a family vacation?
questions.zh: 你上一次全家一起度假去了哪里？

questions.en: Do you look up to or avoid a brother or sister?
questions.zh: 你更仰慕某个兄弟姐妹，还是会尽量避开他/她？

questions.en: What would you like to introduce and share with your children to help them grow intellectually?
questions.zh: 你最想和孩子分享什么，帮助他们在智力和思维上成长？

questions.en: What's something you have not yet done that you believe you can accomplish in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 有什么事情是你还没做过，但相信自己这辈子一定可以完成的？

questions.en: When you make choices about right or wrong, do you consider mainly present or future consequences?
questions.zh: 判断一件事对不对时，你主要考虑眼前后果还是长期后果？

questions.en: What would you like to teach your children about different cultures and races and about people with disabilities?
questions.zh: 关于不同文化、种族以及残障人士，你最想教孩子什么？

questions.en: When you accomplish something, do you make sure everyone knows, or do you keep your success to yourself?
questions.zh: 取得成就后，你会让所有人都知道，还是更喜欢低调不说？

questions.en: Describe your grandfathers.
questions.zh: 描述一下你的两位祖父。

questions.en: Describe your grandmothers.
questions.zh: 描述一下你的两位祖母。

questions.en: Describe your decorating style.
questions.zh: 你会怎样形容自己的家居装饰风格？

questions.en: Describe your first kiss.
questions.zh: 描述一下你的初吻。

questions.en: Describe yourself at eighty.
questions.zh: 想象一下80岁时的自己，会是什么样？

questions.en: Would you consider yourself well-behaved or badly-behaved?

questions.en: If you could choose, would you have changed your appearance?

questions.zh: 你会考虑为孩子雇保姆或监护人吗？

questions.zh: 你会通过众筹平台投资一家公司吗？

questions.zh: 为了让孩子做到最优秀，你会愿意让他们付出几乎任何代价吗？

questions.en: How would you like to spend the last minutes of your life?
questions.zh: 你希望怎样度过人生最后几分钟？

questions.en: If someone gave you a crystal ball, would you look in it?
questions.zh: 如果有人送你一颗能看到未来的水晶球，你会看吗？

questions.zh: 如果现在完全负担得起，你最想买什么？

questions.zh: 如果可以重新选择，你会希望小时候更有竞争心吗？

questions.zh: 如果可以画世界上的任何东西，你最想画什么？

questions.zh: 如果你在监狱里，你会怎样安排自己的时间？

questions.zh: 如果你的祖先从其他国家移民而来，他们原本来自哪里？

questions.zh: 有没有哪家公司或投资，是你后悔自己没有更早买入的？

questions.zh: 如果你发现自家后院存在致癌化学物质，你会怎么做？

questions.zh: 如果真的获得了自己一直想要的自由，你会做什么？

questions.zh: 如果你只听从自己内心的声音，你的人生会变成什么样？

questions.zh: 如果可以改变世界历史中的一件事，你会改什么？

questions.zh: 如果可以雇一个私人助理，你希望他/她为你处理哪些事情？

questions.zh: 如果你被冤枉入狱，后来获释，你会想报复吗？

questions.zh: 如果要做一件真正体现善意和恩典的事，你会做什么？

questions.zh: 如果有人全额买单，让你有一周时间随意做任何事，你会怎么过？

questions.zh: 有没有一个人，是你可以想象和他/她度过余生的？

questions.zh: 如果只有你一个人目击了一起犯罪，你会报警吗？

questions.zh: 你希望一辈子待在同一家公司，以换取职业安全感吗？

questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你会希望自己在另一个年代或时代长大吗？

questions.zh: 如果你是艺术家，你的绘画最常围绕什么主题？

questions.zh: 如果被要求参加一场你认为不正义的战争，你会怎么做？

questions.zh: 如果你生活在20世纪60年代，你觉得自己会成为嬉皮士吗？

questions.en: Would you live your life differently if you knew that you were going to die soon?

questions.zh: 如果你有某种成瘾问题，你会寻求专业帮助，还是先尝试自己解决？

questions.en: Would you stop your child from living on a coed floor or in a coed dorm?
questions.zh: 你会阻止孩子住在男女混住楼层或宿舍吗？

questions.en: If you could give some of the good in your life to someone, who would it be?
questions.zh: 如果能把你生活中的一部分好运和美好送给一个人，你会送给谁？

questions.en: If you could have a different point of view, how would you like to see the world?
questions.zh: 如果能换一个全新的视角，你最想怎样重新看这个世界？

questions.en: If you were in prison for a long term and had an opportunity to escape, would you?

questions.zh: 参加活动时发现有人和你穿一模一样的衣服，你会怎么做？

questions.zh: 如果能救你一命，你会接受来自猪的心脏移植吗？

questions.zh: 一位很亲近的朋友真心想听你的意见，但你知道真实想法可能会让他/她很受伤。你会说实话吗？

questions.en: What was the worst disappointment in your life?
questions.zh: 你人生中最严重的一次失望是什么？

questions.en: What was the worst heartbreak you ever experienced?
questions.zh: 你经历过最严重的一次心碎是什么？

questions.en: What was the worst investment you ever made?
questions.zh: 你做过最糟糕的一项投资是什么？

questions.en: What was your last random act of kindness?
questions.zh: 你最近一次随机善举是什么？

questions.en: What was your most creative act thus far?
questions.zh: 到目前为止，你做过最有创造力的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What were the fads during your teen years?
questions.zh: 你十几岁时流行过哪些潮流？

questions.en: What's the most exhilarating experience you ever had?
questions.zh: 你经历过最让人热血沸腾或兴奋到极点的事情是什么？

questions.en: What's your most painful memory of your father?
questions.zh: 关于父亲，你最痛苦的一段回忆是什么？

questions.en: What's your most painful memory of your mother?
questions.zh: 关于母亲，你最痛苦的一段回忆是什么？

questions.en: Did you have any serious accidents as a child?
questions.zh: 你小时候发生过严重事故吗？

questions.en: Did you like decorating when you were a child?
questions.zh: 小时候你喜欢装饰房间或做布置吗？

questions.en: Did you try to grow up in a hurry?
questions.zh: 小时候你是不是很急着长大？

questions.en: HAVE YOU ever fallen in love by email alone?
questions.zh: 你有没有只通过电子邮件交流就爱上过一个人？

questions.en: Have you ever joined a student club or society?
questions.zh: 你加入过学生社团吗？

questions.en: What dances were popular when you were a teenager?
questions.zh: 你十几岁时流行哪些舞蹈？

questions.en: What mementos of your early childhood do you have?
questions.zh: 你还保存着哪些童年早期的纪念品？

questions.en: What was the best festive holiday you've ever had?
questions.zh: 你过得最开心的一次节日是哪一次？

questions.en: What was the best pick-up line you ever heard?
questions.zh: 你听过最好的搭讪台词是什么？

questions.en: What was the last significant crossroads in your life?
questions.zh: 你人生中最近一次重要的十字路口是什么？

questions.en: What was the most difficult paycheck you ever earned?
questions.zh: 你赚过最辛苦的一笔工资是什么？

questions.en: What was your upbringing: rich, poor, or middle class?
questions.zh: 你成长的家庭经济状况大致属于富裕、贫困还是中产？

questions.en: What were the saddest stories of the past year?
questions.zh: 过去一年里你听到过哪些最悲伤的故事？

questions.en: What's one of your best and worst childhood memories?
questions.zh: 说一段你最好的童年回忆，以及一段最糟糕的。

questions.en: Have you been paid fairly at jobs throughout your life?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己一生中的工作报酬总体公平吗？

questions.en: What are the things you used to be afraid of?
questions.zh: 有哪些东西是你以前很怕、现在已经不怕了的？

questions.en: What do you know about your mother's work and responsibilities?
questions.zh: 你了解母亲的工作和她承担的责任吗？都知道些什么？

questions.en: What kind of work did or does your father do?
questions.zh: 你父亲以前或现在做什么工作？

questions.en: What was the craziest thing you did in your youth?
questions.zh: 你年轻时做过最疯狂的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What was the most perverted situation you were ever in?
questions.zh: 你经历过最越界或最变态的一种情境是什么？

questions.en: What was the worst storm you have ever been in?
questions.zh: 你经历过最可怕的一场暴风雨是什么？

questions.en: What was your verdict in the O. J. Simpson trial?
questions.zh: 如果你是O.J.辛普森案的陪审员，你会作出什么判决？

questions.en: Have you ever been to a school dance or graduation ball?
questions.zh: 你参加过学校舞会或毕业舞会吗？

questions.en: How did you find out that boys and girls are different?
questions.zh: 你小时候是怎么发现男孩和女孩不一样的？

questions.en: What was the craziest thing you ever did in the woods?
questions.zh: 你在树林或野外做过最疯狂的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Have you ever reported someone for cheating on a test or paper?
questions.zh: 你有没有举报过考试或论文作弊的人？

questions.en: Is there a scent or perfume that reminds you of your mother?
questions.zh: 有没有一种气味或香水会让你想起母亲？

questions.en: Is there an aftershave or scent that reminds you of your father?
questions.zh: 有没有一种须后水或气味会让你想起父亲？

questions.en: What do you remember about your oldest relative(s) whom you knew personally?
questions.zh: 你还记得自己亲自认识过的最年长亲戚哪些事情？

questions.en: What was a fad in the decade in which you were born?
questions.zh: 你出生的那个年代流行过什么风潮？

questions.en: What's the greatest distance you traveled by car on a family vacation?
questions.zh: 你们全家自驾度假时，开过最远的一次有多远？

questions.en: What do you think the postal system of the future will be like?
questions.zh: 你觉得未来的邮政系统会是什么样？

questions.en: What funny or crazy experience do you remember from a family gathering or vacation?
questions.zh: 你还记得哪次家庭聚会或度假中发生过特别好笑或疯狂的事？

questions.en: What person in your family would you like to travel back in time to meet?
questions.zh: 如果能穿越回过去见一位家人，你最想见谁？

questions.en: Would you get into a driverless vehicle? Do you think driverless vehicles are the future?
questions.zh: 你愿意坐无人驾驶汽车吗？你觉得无人驾驶会成为未来吗？

questions.en: What do you wish your parents would have told you while you were still a kid?
questions.zh: 你希望父母在你还小的时候告诉过你什么？

questions.en: Do you wish you were born into a big family, medium-sized family, or as an only child?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你希望出生在大家庭、中等规模家庭，还是当独生子女？

questions.en: Have you mostly voted for winners or losers?
questions.zh: 你投票时支持的人通常最后赢得多还是输得多？

questions.en: Is owning a Taser gun a good form of protection? Have you ever been Tasered or Tasered someone?
questions.zh: 你觉得拥有电击枪是一种好的自卫方式吗？你被电击枪击中过或用它击中过别人吗？

questions.en: Describe your wedding(s) - or the one you would like to have.
questions.zh: 描述一下你的婚礼，或者你梦想中的婚礼。

questions.en: Would you feel comfortable about your significant other not wearing their wedding ring?
questions.zh: 如果伴侣不戴婚戒，你会觉得自在吗？

questions.en: If you could create a new, unique position for yourself in your organization, what it would be?
questions.zh: 如果可以在自己的组织里为自己创造一个全新的职位，你会设计成什么？

questions.en: If you were head of the country, what rules would you make so citizens would be well-educated?
questions.zh: 如果你是国家领导人，你会制定哪些规则，让国民受到良好教育？

questions.en: What would you do if your baby was born with Down syndrome or any other developmental disability?
questions.zh: 如果你的宝宝出生时患有唐氏综合征或其他发育障碍，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Would you discourage your child from developing a talent that may not provide a lot of money?
questions.zh: 如果孩子很有天赋，但这项才能将来可能赚不到很多钱，你会劝他/她不要继续发展吗？

questions.en: If allowed to make only a fifteen-minute videotape for your kids before you die, what would you say?
questions.zh: 如果临终前只能给孩子录一段15分钟的视频，你最想说什么？

questions.en: If wind farms harm some birds, do you still think they are a good form of renewable energy?
questions.zh: 如果风力发电场会伤害部分鸟类，你仍然认为它是一种好的可再生能源吗？

questions.en: If you could experience another culture firsthand, which one would it be and what intrigues you about it?
questions.zh: 如果可以亲身体验一种不同文化，你会选哪一种？什么最吸引你？

questions.en: If you could "uninvent" one thing in the world so that it would no longer exist, what would you choose?
questions.zh: 如果可以让世界上的一项发明从未存在过，你会取消什么？

questions.en: If your life has not gone where you thought it would, was it your actions that held you back or your thinking?
questions.zh: 如果你的人生没有走向原本预期的方向，你觉得更多是自己的行为拖住了你，还是思维方式？

questions.en: If 100 people your age were chosen at random, how many do you think would be leading a life more satisfying than yours?
questions.zh: 如果随机挑选100个和你同龄的人，你觉得有多少人的生活满意度会高于你？

questions.en: If the leaders of our nation followed the views of the public more closely, do you think the nation would be better or worse off?
questions.zh: 如果国家领导人更严格按照公众意见行事，你觉得国家会变得更好还是更糟？

questions.en: If your accountant could set up a fictitious company for you in a tax haven and reduce the taxes you pay, would you go for it?
questions.zh: 如果会计师能在避税天堂为你设立一家虚构公司来减少税款，你会接受吗？

questions.en: Are you close to your siblings?
questions.zh: 你和兄弟姐妹关系亲近吗？

questions.en: Are you friends with your cousins?
questions.zh: 你和表兄弟姐妹或堂兄弟姐妹是朋友吗？

questions.en: Are you better off than your parents were?
questions.zh: 你现在的生活条件比父母当年更好吗？

questions.en: Have you ever chewed on things (fingernails, pens, etc.)?
questions.zh: 你有没有习惯性咬东西，比如指甲、笔之类？

questions.en: Have you ever witnessed something you just cannot forget?
questions.zh: 你有没有亲眼见过一件自己到现在都忘不了的事情？

questions.en: Have you ever had any out-of-body or déjà vu experiences?
questions.zh: 你经历过灵魂出窍或似曾相识的感觉吗？

questions.en: Have you ever worn uncomfortable shoes because they looked good?
questions.zh: 你有没有为了好看而穿过非常不舒服的鞋？

questions.en: Have you ever felt detached from your body and everything else?
questions.zh: 你有没有感觉自己好像和身体以及周围的一切脱离了？

questions.en: Have you ever been in the studio audience of a talk show?
questions.zh: 你参加过谈话节目的现场观众录制吗？

questions.en: Have you ever felt good about doing something bad, inappropriate, or illegal?
questions.zh: 你有没有因为做了不合适、错误甚至违法的事，反而觉得很爽？

questions.en: Have you ever accidentally called your current significant other by an ex's name?
questions.zh: 你有没有不小心把现任伴侣叫成前任的名字？

questions.en: Have you ever had a feud with someone that went on too long?
questions.zh: 你有没有和某个人长期不和，拖得太久？

questions.en: Have you ever tried to do the right thing and have it backfire?
questions.zh: 你有没有试着做正确的事，结果反而弄巧成拙？

questions.en: Have you ever seen firsthand the damage war can do to people or places?
