questions.zh: 你有没有亲眼见过战争对人或地方造成的破坏？

questions.en: Have you ever given advice when you really didn't know what you were talking about?
questions.zh: 你有没有在其实并不懂的情况下给别人提过建议？

questions.en: Have you ever worked for minimum wage when you were over the age of 21?
questions.zh: 21岁以后，你有没有做过只拿最低工资的工作？

questions.en: Have you ever been passed over for a promotion and what did you do about it?
questions.zh: 你有没有被跳过升职机会？当时你怎么处理？

questions.en: Have you ever gone on strike or had to deal with a strike at your workplace?
questions.zh: 你有没有参加过罢工，或在工作中遇到过罢工？

questions.en: Are your pets allowed to ride in the car, lie on the furniture, go visiting with you, go on family vacations, be fed at the table?
questions.zh: 你的宠物可以坐车、上家具、跟你访友、一起度假，甚至在餐桌旁吃东西吗？

questions.en: If someone refuses to answer a question to avoid incriminating themselves, do you assume they are guilty?
questions.zh: 如果有人为了避免自证其罪而拒绝回答问题，你会因此觉得对方有罪吗？

questions.en: DESCRIBE an experience you consider close to a miracle.
questions.zh: 描述一次你觉得接近“奇迹”的经历。

questions.en: If you are disconnected electronically, how long would it take before you are uncomfortable?
questions.zh: 如果完全断开网络和电子设备，你多久会开始觉得不舒服？

questions.en: If you started a new talk show, who would be your first guest(s) and why?
questions.zh: 如果你开一档新的谈话节目，第一位嘉宾会请谁？为什么？

questions.en: If you didn't have to worry about making a living, what would you most like to do for the rest of your life?
questions.zh: 如果完全不用考虑生计，余生你最想做什么？

questions.en: How do you feel about your family?
questions.zh: 你对自己的家庭整体有什么感觉？

questions.en: How do you remember playing with siblings?
questions.zh: 你还记得小时候怎样和兄弟姐妹一起玩吗？

questions.en: What details do you remember of your childhood bedroom(s)?
questions.zh: 你还记得童年卧室的哪些细节？

questions.en: What object do you remember vividly from your childhood?
questions.zh: 童年里有没有一件物品是你到现在仍记得特别清楚的？

questions.en: What things do you remember about your childhood neighborhood(s)?
questions.zh: 你还记得童年社区的哪些事情？

questions.en: What was a very difficult educational experience for you?
questions.zh: 你经历过最困难的一段学习或教育经历是什么？

questions.en: What was the most anti-establishment thing you ever did?
questions.zh: 你做过最反传统、最挑战体制的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What was your country's lowest moment in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 在你有生之年，你的国家最灰暗的时刻是什么？

questions.en: What was your country's proudest moment in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 在你有生之年，你的国家最值得自豪的时刻是什么？

questions.en: What were the largest and smallest schools you attended?
questions.zh: 你读过规模最大和最小的学校分别是什么样？

questions.en: What would you change about your childhood and why?
questions.zh: 关于自己的童年，你最想改变什么？为什么？

questions.en: What's your most beautiful childhood memory of your parents?
questions.zh: 童年时关于父母最美好的一段记忆是什么？

questions.en: What's your most horrifying childhood memory of your parents?
questions.zh: 童年时关于父母最可怕或最痛苦的一段记忆是什么？

questions.en: Have you ever blamed your parents for your own flaws?
questions.zh: 你有没有把自己的某些缺点怪到父母头上？

questions.en: How do you feel about having relatives stay with you?
questions.zh: 有亲戚住到你家时，你通常是什么感觉？

questions.en: Was there anything unusual that happened to you in childhood?
questions.zh: 你童年有没有发生过什么很不寻常的事情？

questions.en: What was the funniest thing someone wrote in your yearbook?
questions.zh: 别人曾在你的年鉴上写过最好笑的一句话是什么？

questions.en: What was the most creative or exciting place you worked?
questions.zh: 你工作过最有创意或最让人兴奋的地方是哪里？

questions.en: What was the most memorable musical performance you have heard?
questions.zh: 你听过最难忘的一场音乐演出是什么？

questions.en: What was the worst New Year's Eve you ever experienced?
questions.zh: 你经历过最糟糕的一次跨年夜是什么？

questions.en: What were the first fully understandable words your children spoke?
questions.zh: 你的孩子最早说出的、真正清楚可理解的话是什么？

questions.en: What's one famous quote you want your children to remember?
questions.zh: 有没有一句著名的话，是你希望自己的孩子一直记得的？

questions.en: Have you changed a deeply held belief because of practical experience?
questions.zh: 你有没有因为现实经验而改变过一个自己原本非常坚定的信念？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you live your childhood over again?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你愿意把童年重新过一遍吗？

questions.en: Tell about the time when you were the coldest, the hottest.
questions.zh: 说说你经历过最冷和最热的时候。

questions.en: What event in your country's history do you remember most vividly?
questions.zh: 你的国家历史上，哪一件事你记得最清楚？

questions.en: What scary creatures did you think were in your childhood bedroom?
questions.zh: 小时候你曾想象卧室里藏着什么可怕的怪物或生物？

questions.en: What warnings and old wives' tales were you taught growing up?
questions.zh: 成长过程中，大人教过你哪些警告、迷信或老一辈说法？

questions.en: What was a seminar or workshop that really stuck with you?
questions.zh: 有没有一场研讨会或工作坊是你到现在都记得很清楚的？

questions.en: What was the biggest news event during your life so far?
questions.zh: 截至目前，你一生中最大的新闻事件是什么？

questions.en: What was the greatest amount of physical pain you ever endured?
questions.zh: 你经历过最严重的身体疼痛是什么？

questions.en: What was the greatest peer pressure you felt as an adult?
questions.zh: 成年以后，你经历过最大的同伴压力是什么？

questions.en: What was the most compelling news story of the past year?
questions.zh: 过去一年里，哪条新闻故事最吸引你、最让你关注？

questions.en: What was the most difficult thing to overcome from your childhood?
questions.zh: 你童年留下的影响中，最难克服的是什么？

questions.en: What was the most important decision you ever had to make?
questions.zh: 你人生中做过最重要的决定是什么？

questions.en: What was the most interesting legal case of the past year?
questions.zh: 过去一年里，哪个法律案件最让你感兴趣？

questions.en: What was the worst or most uncomfortable place you ever slept?
questions.zh: 你睡过最糟糕或最不舒服的地方是什么？

questions.en: What was your honeymoon spot and why did you pick it?
questions.zh: 你的蜜月去了哪里？当时为什么选那里？

questions.en: What were the three superstitions you heard most while growing up?
questions.zh: 成长过程中你最常听到的三种迷信说法是什么？

questions.en: What's still the same about you as when you were young?
questions.zh: 现在的你有哪些地方和小时候完全没变？

questions.en: Did you ever falsify a time card, report card, or expense report?
questions.zh: 你有没有伪造过工时卡、成绩单或报销单？

questions.en: How do you feel about job sharing and other family-friendly employee benefits?
questions.zh: 你怎么看岗位共享以及其他对家庭友好的员工福利？

questions.en: What early lesson from childhood have you continued to follow throughout life?
questions.zh: 童年时学到的哪一条早期教训，你一直遵循到现在？

questions.en: What magical things happened in your childhood that you still cannot explain?
questions.zh: 童年里有没有发生过什么带着“魔法感”、至今仍无法解释的事情？

questions.en: What people did you have to take care of while growing up?
questions.zh: 你成长过程中需要照顾过哪些人？

questions.en: What was the most unforgettable coincidence you ever experienced or heard about?
questions.zh: 你经历或听说过最不可思议的一次巧合是什么？

questions.en: What was the worst thing that happened to you in an elevator?
questions.zh: 你在电梯里遇到过最糟糕的事情是什么？

questions.en: What were your first words and who told you what they were?
questions.zh: 你出生后说的第一句话是什么？是谁告诉你的？

questions.en: What's one thing you would like to be sure your children remember?
questions.zh: 有没有一件事是你特别希望孩子一定记住的？

questions.en: What's something in the past week that reminded you of your childhood?
questions.zh: 过去一周里，有什么事情突然让你想起童年？

questions.en: Would you rather spend time with your family or with your friends?
questions.zh: 你宁愿和家人一起度过时间，还是和朋友一起？

questions.en: Did you do as you were told when young or did you rebel?
questions.zh: 小时候你通常会听话照做，还是比较反叛？

questions.en: Did you have your own telephone growing up, or any other special privileges?
questions.zh: 你成长过程中有没有自己的电话，或其他特别的待遇？

questions.en: Did you think that you would turn out the way that you have?
questions.zh: 你小时候有想过自己最后会变成现在这样吗？

questions.en: Have you tried breaking the what-shall-I-do logjam by taking one step, any step?
questions.zh: 当你卡在“不知道该做什么”时，你有没有试过先迈出任何一步再说？

questions.en: What was the most enjoyable club, league, or team to which you belonged?
questions.zh: 你参加过最开心的俱乐部、联赛或团队是什么？

questions.en: HAVE YOU ever been in love with more than one person at a time?
questions.zh: 你有没有同时爱上过不止一个人？

questions.en: What qualities do you feel make you different as an adult from your childhood?
questions.zh: 你觉得成年后的自己和童年时相比，最大的性格差异是什么？

questions.en: What's one thing you would like to be sure your children remember about you?
questions.zh: 你最希望孩子记住关于你的哪一件事？

questions.en: What's the biggest change since your childhood in the way people act or think?
questions.zh: 和你小时候相比，现在人们的行为或思维方式最大的变化是什么？

questions.en: When you were young, were you allowed to complain when the going got rough?
questions.zh: 小时候遇到困难时，大人允许你抱怨吗？

questions.en: Would you rather die without warning or die slowly, surrounded by family and friends?
questions.zh: 你宁愿毫无预兆地突然去世，还是慢慢离世、身边围着家人和朋友？

questions.en: Did you have a special place where you went to be alone as a child?
questions.zh: 小时候你有没有一个专门去独处的地方？

questions.en: What were you called when you were younger and how did you feel about it?
questions.zh: 小时候别人怎么称呼你？你当时喜欢那个称呼吗？

questions.en: When you were young, were you told you could do or be anything you wanted?
questions.zh: 你小时候是否被告诉“只要想做，就可以成为任何人、做到任何事”？

questions.en: Which areas of your past are most important for you to discuss with a fiancé(e)?
questions.zh: 订婚前，你觉得自己过去的哪些部分最需要和未婚夫或未婚妻谈清楚？

questions.en: What excuses do you use or have you used to get out of dates or appointments?
questions.zh: 为了逃掉约会或预约，你用过哪些借口？

questions.en: What was a decision you made in an instant that gave you a lifetime of heartache?
questions.zh: 你有没有一瞬间做出的决定，却给自己带来了很长时间的痛苦？

questions.en: What was an entertainment or sporting goods item that ended up being a waste of money?
questions.zh: 你买过哪件娱乐或运动用品，后来发现完全是浪费钱？

questions.en: When looking back at your childhood, what do you and do you not want to repeat?
questions.zh: 回看自己的童年，哪些东西你希望重复？哪些绝不想重复？

questions.en: Have you personally been a victim of racism or other prejudice?
questions.zh: 你本人有没有成为种族主义或其他偏见的受害者？

questions.en: Would you break the law in certain situations? Which ones?
questions.zh: 在某些情况下你会违法吗？哪些情况？

questions.en: Would you do homeschooling? Do you think it's a good idea?
questions.zh: 你会考虑在家教育孩子吗？你觉得这是个好主意吗？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you take back something you did? If so, what?
questions.zh: 如果可以选择，你会撤回自己曾做过的一件事吗？会是哪件？

questions.en: Would you sign a request for a life-support machine to be switched off? When?
questions.zh: 你会签署允许关闭生命支持设备的文件吗？在什么情况下？

questions.en: What would you do if you earned a fortune every single day? How would your life change?
questions.zh: 如果你每天都能赚到一大笔钱，你会怎么生活？生活会发生什么变化？

questions.en: What would you do if you were invisible for a day? Is there some wrong you would right?
questions.zh: 如果你能隐身一天，你会做什么？有没有哪件错事是你想趁机纠正的？

questions.en: Who did something for you that seemed insignificant at the time that ultimately had profound impact on your life? What did this person do and how did it impact you?
questions.zh: 有没有一个人当时为你做了一件看似很小的事，后来却深刻改变了你的人生？对方做了什么？怎样影响了你？

questions.en: Did/do your parents understand you?
questions.zh: 你的父母理解你吗？过去理解你吗？

questions.en: How warm is your family?
questions.zh: 你的家庭氛围有多温暖？

questions.en: What are your parents like?
questions.zh: 你的父母是什么样的人？

questions.en: What makes a great parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得什么样的人算好父母？

questions.en: What's a parent's greatest accomplishment?
questions.zh: 你觉得父母最大的成就是什么？

questions.en: Who were your father's heroes?
questions.zh: 你父亲过去崇拜哪些英雄或人物？

questions.en: Who were your mother's idols?
questions.zh: 你母亲过去崇拜过哪些人？

questions.en: Who's your family ashamed of?
questions.zh: 你家里有没有谁让全家觉得丢脸？

questions.en: Who's your most eccentric relative?
questions.zh: 你家里最古怪、最有个性的亲戚是谁？

questions.en: Could you sketch your family tree?
questions.zh: 你能画出自己的家谱吗？

questions.en: Have you ever been cyberbullied? Cyberstalked?
questions.zh: 你遭遇过网络霸凌或网络跟踪吗？

questions.en: What did/do you call your grandparents?
questions.zh: 你以前或现在怎么称呼祖父母？

questions.en: What family reunions have you attended?
questions.zh: 你参加过哪些家庭团聚活动？

questions.en: What's worse: overprotective or permissive parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得过度保护型父母和过度放任型父母，哪一种更糟？

questions.en: Who's your family particularly proud of?
questions.zh: 你们家最为谁感到骄傲？

questions.en: Did you play tricks on your siblings?
questions.zh: 你小时候会捉弄兄弟姐妹吗？

questions.en: Do you know your family's special recipes?
questions.zh: 你知道家里有哪些特别的传统食谱吗？

questions.en: Have you accomplished more than your parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己的成就是不是已经超过父母？

questions.en: How did your mother and father meet?
questions.zh: 你的父母当初是怎么认识的？

questions.en: How often do you contact your siblings?
questions.zh: 你多久会联系一次兄弟姐妹？

questions.en: Tell a story of an eccentric relative.
questions.zh: 讲一个关于某位古怪亲戚的故事。

questions.en: What did you hide from your parents?
questions.zh: 你小时候会向父母隐瞒什么？

questions.en: What did you learn from your parents?
questions.zh: 你从父母身上学到了什么？

questions.en: What do/did you like about your parents?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢父母的哪些地方？

questions.en: What genetic diseases run in your family?
questions.zh: 你家族里有哪些遗传性疾病？

questions.en: What stories were told about your grandparents?
questions.zh: 家里曾给你讲过哪些关于祖父母的故事？

questions.en: What things about your parents worry you?
questions.zh: 父母的哪些事情最让你担心？

questions.en: What was the most memorable family outing?
questions.zh: 你们家最难忘的一次外出活动是什么？

questions.en: What were your parents' most distinguishing features?
questions.zh: 你父母最鲜明、最容易被人认出的特点是什么？

questions.en: What's an endearing characteristic of your family?
questions.zh: 你们家最让人觉得可爱、温暖的一个特点是什么？

questions.en: What's something you wish for your father?
questions.zh: 你最希望父亲得到或实现什么？

questions.en: What's something you wish for your mother?
questions.zh: 你最希望母亲得到或实现什么？

questions.en: What's the biggest mystery in your family?
questions.zh: 你们家最大的谜团是什么？

questions.en: What's the location of your family's memorabilia?
questions.zh: 你们家的纪念品通常放在哪里？

questions.en: Which parent are you closest to now?
questions.zh: 现在你和父母中的哪一位更亲近？

questions.en: Who has the largest family you know?
questions.zh: 你认识的人里，谁的家庭最大？

questions.en: Who wins most of your family arguments?
questions.zh: 你们家里发生争论时，通常谁最常“赢”？

questions.en: Who's the best cook in your family?
questions.zh: 你家里谁做饭最好吃？

questions.en: Who's the funniest person in your family?
questions.zh: 你家里谁最有幽默感？

questions.en: Who's the relative you most enjoy visiting?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢去拜访哪位亲戚？

questions.en: As children, did you play with your cousins?
questions.zh: 小时候你会和表亲或堂亲一起玩吗？

questions.en: How did your parents handle the empty-nest experience?
questions.zh: 孩子离家后，你的父母是怎样适应“空巢期”的？

questions.en: How did your parents react to your grades?
questions.zh: 你小时候拿成绩回家时，父母通常怎么反应？

questions.en: How would you describe your father or mother?
questions.zh: 你会怎样描述自己的父亲或母亲？

questions.en: Is it possible to be a perfect parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得可能存在“完美父母”吗？

questions.en: What are the stupidest rules your parents had?
questions.zh: 你父母定过最荒唐的一条规矩是什么？

questions.en: What deaths in the family affected you strongly?
questions.zh: 家里哪些人的去世对你影响特别大？

questions.en: What did your grandparents do for a living?
questions.zh: 你的祖父母以前做什么工作？

questions.en: What troubles did you have with your parents?
questions.zh: 你和父母之间曾经有哪些主要矛盾？

questions.en: What values did your parents instill in you?
questions.zh: 父母在你身上培养了哪些价值观？

questions.en: What was the birth order among your siblings?
questions.zh: 你在兄弟姐妹中排行第几？

questions.en: What was your proudest moment as a parent?
questions.zh: 作为父母，你最骄傲的一个时刻是什么？

questions.en: What's the ideal age to become a parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得成为父母最理想的年龄是多少？

questions.en: What's the most important duty of a parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得父母最重要的一项责任是什么？

questions.en: What's the oldest family photograph that you have?
questions.zh: 你现在拥有的最老一张家庭照片是什么？

questions.en: What's the silliest thing your parents ever did?
questions.zh: 你父母做过最傻、最好笑的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Which is better: being a parent or grandparent?
questions.zh: 你觉得当父母更好，还是当祖父母更好？

questions.en: Who lived the longest in your family's history?
questions.zh: 你的家族史中，谁活得最长？

questions.en: Who's the family member most similar to you?
questions.zh: 家里谁和你最相似？

questions.en: Who's the most musical member of your family?
questions.zh: 你家里谁最有音乐天赋？

questions.en: Who's the most serious person in your family?
questions.zh: 你家里谁最严肃？

questions.en: Would (or do) your parents make good grandparents?
questions.zh: 你的父母会成为或已经是很好的祖父母吗？

questions.en: Would family and friends describe you as ethical?
questions.zh: 你的家人和朋友会觉得你是一个有道德原则的人吗？

questions.en: Are your parents proud of what you have accomplished?
questions.zh: 你的父母为你已经取得的成就感到骄傲吗？

questions.en: Does your brother or sister embarrass or enchant you?
questions.zh: 你的兄弟姐妹更常让你觉得尴尬，还是让你觉得可爱、有趣？

questions.en: For what reasons are you proud of your sibling(s)?
questions.zh: 你为什么为自己的兄弟姐妹感到骄傲？

questions.en: How can you make your dad or mom smile?
questions.zh: 怎样最容易让你的爸爸或妈妈笑起来？

questions.en: How did your parents feel about their own parents?
questions.zh: 你的父母当年怎么看他们自己的父母？

questions.en: How often would you like to see your parents?
questions.zh: 你希望多久见父母一次？

questions.en: How was affection expressed in your family growing up?
questions.zh: 你成长的家庭里，大家通常怎样表达亲密和关爱？

questions.en: In what way are you and a parent alike?
questions.zh: 你和父母中的某一位，哪些地方最相似？

questions.en: What excuses do you use to not see relatives?
questions.zh: 为了不去见亲戚，你会用什么借口？

questions.en: What family member do you take after the most?
questions.zh: 你最像哪位家人，不论外貌还是性格？

questions.en: What family or person you know seems genuinely happy?
questions.zh: 你认识的哪个家庭或哪个人，看起来是真正幸福的？

questions.en: What habit did you pick up from a relative?
questions.zh: 你从某位亲戚身上学来了什么习惯？

questions.en: What is the BEST part of being a parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得当父母最好的一点是什么？

questions.en: What person from your family do you most admire?
questions.zh: 家人里你最敬佩谁？

questions.en: What phrase or advice did your father often repeat?
questions.zh: 你父亲最常重复哪句话或哪条建议？

questions.en: What phrase or advice did your mother often repeat?
questions.zh: 你母亲最常重复哪句话或哪条建议？

questions.en: What things did you love doing with your family?
questions.zh: 你以前最喜欢和家人一起做哪些事情？

questions.en: What was the worst family trip you went on?
questions.zh: 你经历过最糟糕的一次家庭旅行是什么？

questions.en: What's a concern you have for a family member?
questions.zh: 你现在最担心哪位家人的什么事？

questions.en: What's a trait you don't share with your siblings?
questions.zh: 你有哪些性格特质和兄弟姐妹并不相同？

questions.en: What's an unusual occupation of a friend or relative?
questions.zh: 你的朋友或亲戚中，有谁从事很特别的职业？

questions.en: What's one thing you would change about your parents?
questions.zh: 如果可以改变父母的一件事，你会改什么？

questions.en: When did you ever feel sorry for your parents?
questions.zh: 你什么时候曾经为父母感到心疼？

questions.en: When was a time your family was in danger?
questions.zh: 有没有一次你的家人处于真正的危险中？

questions.en: Who had more influence on you: mother or father?
questions.zh: 母亲和父亲相比，谁对你的影响更大？

questions.en: Who in your family do you most look like?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己长得最像家里的谁？

questions.en: Who usually calls more often: your parents or you?
questions.zh: 你和父母相比，通常是谁更常主动打电话？

questions.en: Would you like to have more brothers and sisters?
questions.zh: 你希望自己有更多兄弟姐妹吗？

questions.en: Are you more accepting of racial diversity than your parents?
questions.zh: 你比父母更能接受种族和文化多样性吗？

questions.en: Did you ever feel ashamed of either of your parents?
questions.zh: 你小时候有没有为父母中的某一位感到过羞耻？

questions.en: Did you share a room with a sibling growing up?
questions.zh: 小时候你和兄弟姐妹共用过房间吗？

questions.en: Have your mother and father said "I love you" enough?
questions.zh: 你的父母有没有足够经常对你说“我爱你”？

questions.en: How would you change the rules your parents gave you?
questions.zh: 如果能改变父母给你定过的规则，你会怎么改？

questions.en: If adopted, would you try to find your birth parents?
questions.zh: 如果你是被收养的，你会尝试寻找亲生父母吗？

questions.en: What could your family plan that would make you happy?
questions.zh: 如果让全家计划一件事，什么最能让你开心？

questions.en: What happens to the family when it is under stress?
questions.zh: 家庭承受巨大压力时，通常会发生什么？

questions.en: What would you like to learn about your family history?
questions.zh: 关于自己的家族历史，你最想了解什么？

questions.en: What's a very happy memory you have of your family?
questions.zh: 你关于家庭的一段非常快乐的回忆是什么？

questions.en: What's the one family value you believe in the most?
questions.zh: 你最相信哪一项家庭价值观？

questions.en: What's the thing you disagree about most as a family?
questions.zh: 你们一家人最常意见不合的事情是什么？

questions.en: With what family member would you most like to work?
questions.zh: 如果必须和一位家人共事，你最愿意选谁？

questions.en: Would you care for your parents in their old age?
questions.zh: 父母年老后，你愿意亲自照顾他们吗？

questions.en: As a child, were you closer to your mother or father?
questions.zh: 小时候你更亲近母亲还是父亲？

questions.en: Do you ever feel you were here in a previous life?
questions.zh: 你有没有感觉自己前世曾经来过这个世界？

questions.en: How did you usually eat dinner as a family growing up?
questions.zh: 你小时候一家人通常怎样吃晚餐？

questions.en: How does your family celebrate the biggest holiday of the year?
questions.zh: 你家过一年中最重要的节日时，通常怎么庆祝？

questions.en: What are the ways you tried to make your parents happy?
questions.zh: 小时候你会用哪些方式让父母开心？

questions.en: What was a family project you worked on as a child?
questions.zh: 小时候你参与过什么家庭项目？

questions.en: What was the worst thing that a sibling did to you?
questions.zh: 兄弟姐妹曾对你做过最糟糕的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Which relative did you or do you get along best with?
questions.zh: 你和哪位亲戚相处得最好？

questions.en: Do you think that the welfare system should exist and what should be its place in the future?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会福利制度应该存在吗？未来应该扮演什么角色？

questions.en: If you had a criminal past, when you met someone new, would you hide it or share it?
questions.zh: 如果你有犯罪前科，认识新朋友时会隐瞒，还是主动说明？

questions.en: Have you ever felt like a fraud or impostor and that others might find out you are not so great and that you have reached your level of competence?
questions.zh: 你有没有觉得自己像个冒牌货，担心别人发现你并没有看起来那么厉害，甚至觉得自己已经到达能力极限？

questions.en: Would there be more advantages or problems if nobody ever died? What would they be?
questions.zh: 如果人永远不会死，优点会更多还是问题更多？会有哪些？

questions.en: If you had siblings, did you get along with them?
questions.zh: 如果你有兄弟姐妹，你们小时候相处得好吗？

questions.en: How do you get the attention of your friends and family?
questions.zh: 你通常怎样吸引朋友和家人的注意？

questions.en: If you had the power, how would you change your family?
questions.zh: 如果你有能力改变自己的家庭，你最想改什么？

questions.en: Have you ever had to make a great sacrifice for a relative?
questions.zh: 你有没有为了某位亲戚作出过很大的牺牲？

questions.en: Have you ever had a friend who became like a member of your family?
questions.zh: 你有没有一个朋友后来几乎成了家人？

questions.en: Have you ever stopped speaking with your parents for a long period of time?
questions.zh: 你有没有和父母长期完全不说话、不联系过？

questions.en: Have you ever told a friend or family member what you honestly think of them?
questions.zh: 你有没有直接告诉朋友或家人自己对他们真正的看法？

questions.en: What's the most innovative practice, service, or product your organization has launched in the past year?
questions.zh: 过去一年里，你所在组织推出过最有创新性的做法、服务或产品是什么？

questions.en: If you could choose your childhood and youth to live over again, how would it be different?
questions.zh: 如果童年和青春可以重来一次，你会让它有哪些不同？

questions.en: Of what ideas and lifestyles are you less or more tolerant of now than when you were younger?
questions.zh: 和年轻时相比，现在你对哪些思想或生活方式更宽容？又对哪些更不宽容？

questions.en: What do you enjoy or dislike most about having a committed relationship?
questions.zh: 长期稳定的伴侣关系中，你最喜欢和最不喜欢的部分是什么？

questions.en: What's your biggest regret?
questions.zh: 你人生中最大的遗憾是什么？

questions.en: What's your most recent regret?
questions.zh: 你最近一次感到后悔是什么？

questions.en: How do you feel about changing jobs?
questions.zh: 你对换工作这件事有什么感觉？

questions.en: What was one of your father's strongest characteristics?
questions.zh: 你父亲最突出的优点之一是什么？

questions.en: What was one of your mother's strongest characteristics?
questions.zh: 你母亲最突出的优点之一是什么？

questions.en: Which/who stresses you more: partner, family, boss, coworkers?
questions.zh: 伴侣、家人、老板和同事中，谁最容易让你感到压力？

questions.en: Who's the most patient/helpful/generous/loving member of the family?
questions.zh: 家里谁最有耐心、最乐于助人、最慷慨或最有爱心？

questions.en: Would your parents consider you well-behaved or badly-behaved?
questions.zh: 你的父母会觉得你小时候算乖，还是比较调皮？

questions.en: Did your family experience a tragedy during your childhood?
questions.zh: 你童年时，家里经历过重大悲剧吗？

questions.en: What family events or activities give you happy memories?
questions.zh: 哪些家庭活动或事件给你留下了快乐的回忆？

questions.en: What were the special stories your grandparents told you?
questions.zh: 祖父母曾给你讲过哪些特别的故事？

questions.en: What's one thing you really appreciate about your family?
questions.zh: 你最欣赏自己家庭的一点是什么？

questions.en: What's something that made your mother or father happy?
questions.zh: 什么事情最容易让你的母亲或父亲开心？

questions.en: What's something your father or mother considered very important?
questions.zh: 父亲或母亲最看重的一件事是什么？

questions.en: With what family member have you regrettably lost touch?
questions.zh: 你和哪位家人失去联系，是你最觉得遗憾的？

questions.en: Do you ever feel guilty about killing insects or rodents?
questions.zh: 杀死昆虫或老鼠时，你会感到内疚吗？

questions.en: Does your family have strong traditions that you still observe?
questions.zh: 你的家庭有没有一些至今仍坚持的传统？

questions.en: How many generations can you trace of your family's heritage?
questions.zh: 你能追溯自己的家族历史到多少代？

questions.en: How much affection did your parents show for each other?
questions.zh: 你父母彼此之间会表现出多少亲密和爱意？

questions.en: Was there a time when your parents really embarrassed you?
questions.zh: 有没有一次父母真的把你尴尬坏了？

questions.en: Were your parents happy with the circumstances of their lives?
questions.zh: 你的父母对自己的人生处境满意吗？

questions.en: What are the differences between your mother and your father?
questions.zh: 你的母亲和父亲最明显的不同有哪些？

questions.en: What are your family's traits: hotheads, worriers, avoiders of conflict?
questions.zh: 你们家更像哪一种：容易发脾气、容易担忧，还是习惯回避冲突？

questions.en: What are your grandparents' names and where did/do they live?
questions.zh: 你的祖父母分别叫什么名字？他们以前或现在住在哪里？

questions.en: What family member would every adult do well to emulate?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪位家人的做法最值得所有成年人学习？

questions.en: What objects do you remember from your parents' living room?
questions.zh: 你还记得父母家客厅里有哪些特别的物品？

questions.en: What unanswered question would you like to ask your grandparents?
questions.zh: 如果能问祖父母一个一直没有答案的问题，你最想问什么？

questions.en: What were your most memorable experiences shared with your grandparents?
questions.zh: 你和祖父母一起经历过哪些最难忘的事情？

questions.en: What word or phrase describes your mother's or father's personality?
questions.zh: 用一个词或一句短语形容父亲或母亲的性格。

questions.en: What's an embarrassing thing you found out about your parents?
questions.zh: 你曾发现父母什么事情，让你觉得特别尴尬？

questions.en: Who were your parents' friends while you were growing up?
questions.zh: 你成长过程中，父母的朋友都有哪些人？

questions.en: Who's a family member who you have distanced yourself from?
questions.zh: 有没有一位家人是你主动和他/她保持了距离？

questions.en: Do you get embarrassed when people do something special for you?
questions.zh: 别人特别为你做一件事时，你会不会反而觉得尴尬？

questions.en: Do you know what your mother's or father's childhood was like?
questions.zh: 你知道父亲或母亲小时候的生活是什么样吗？

questions.en: Do you prefer to attend big family reunions or school reunions?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢参加大型家庭聚会，还是学校同学会？

questions.en: Have you or your family been affected by a natural disaster?
questions.zh: 你或你的家人有没有受到过自然灾害影响？

questions.en: How are you different from your siblings, if you have any?
questions.zh: 如果你有兄弟姐妹，你和他们最大的不同是什么？

questions.en: How would your father or mother describe their father or mother?
questions.zh: 你的父亲或母亲会怎样形容他们自己的父母？

questions.en: Name something you like or admire about someone in your family.
questions.zh: 说一件你喜欢或欣赏某位家人的地方。

questions.en: Talk about a family secret or skeleton in the family closet.
questions.zh: 说说一个家庭秘密，或一个大家很少谈起的家族往事。

questions.en: What (if anything) do you remember or know about your great-grandparents?
questions.zh: 你对曾祖父母还记得或了解些什么？

questions.en: What advice do you wish you had taken from your parents?
questions.zh: 父母给过你的哪条建议，是你现在后悔当初没听的？

questions.en: What are the most difficult things single parents have to face?
questions.zh: 单亲父母最难面对的问题有哪些？

questions.en: What are the most important things you learned from your father?
questions.zh: 你从父亲身上学到最重要的东西有哪些？

questions.en: What are the most important things you learned from your mother?
questions.zh: 你从母亲身上学到最重要的东西有哪些？

questions.en: What are three things you like and dislike about your parents?
questions.zh: 说出你喜欢父母的三点，以及不喜欢的三点。

questions.en: What are/were your parents' names and what did you call them?
questions.zh: 你的父母叫什么名字？你平时怎么称呼他们？

questions.en: What arguments did you have over and over with your parents?
questions.zh: 你和父母之间，有哪些争论是反复发生的？

questions.en: What elderly relative would you like to get to know better?
questions.zh: 有没有一位年长亲戚，是你希望更深入了解的？

questions.en: What family tradition would you love to continue and pass on?
questions.zh: 你最想延续并传给下一代的家庭传统是什么？

questions.en: What is the BEST stuff your parents taught you about life?
questions.zh: 父母教给你关于人生最有价值的东西是什么？

questions.en: What things did your parents argue about when you were little?
questions.zh: 你小时候，父母最常为什么事情争吵？

questions.en: What things do you hide when your family comes to visit?
questions.zh: 家人来你家拜访时，你会特意藏起什么东西？

questions.en: What troubles did you have with your mom when growing up?
questions.zh: 成长过程中，你和母亲之间主要有哪些矛盾？

questions.en: What was the worst trouble you were in with your parents?
questions.zh: 你曾因为做什么事和父母闹到最严重？

questions.en: What's one thing you are especially glad your parents told you?
questions.zh: 父母告诉过你什么，是你现在特别庆幸自己当时听到了的？

questions.en: What's something you like or liked about one of your relatives?
questions.zh: 某位亲戚身上有什么是你特别喜欢的？

questions.en: What's the most surprising thing you learned about your parents' childhood?
questions.zh: 关于父母的童年，你后来知道的最意外的一件事是什么？

questions.en: Who are two famous people you would have liked as parents?
questions.zh: 如果能从两位名人中选父母，你最想选哪两个人？

questions.en: Who's the "talker" of your family and who is the "listener"?
questions.zh: 你家里谁最爱说话？谁最会听？

questions.en: Whose life have you made better (other than a family member)?
questions.zh: 除了家人之外，你曾让谁的人生变得更好？

questions.en: Have you ever run your own business? How did you start it?
questions.zh: 你自己经营过生意吗？当时是怎么开始的？

questions.en: How did you get along with your parents, especially as a teenager?
questions.zh: 你和父母相处得怎么样，尤其是青少年时期？

questions.en: How strong are your relationships with the members of your original family?
questions.zh: 你和原生家庭成员之间的关系有多紧密？

questions.en: If you could choose, would you have been nicer to your parents?
questions.zh: 如果可以重来，你会希望自己以前对父母更好一点吗？

questions.en: What advice did your parents give you that you remember and use?
questions.zh: 父母给过你哪条建议，是你到现在还记得并且会用的？

questions.en: What are your sisters and brothers like and what do they do?
questions.zh: 你的兄弟姐妹分别是什么样的人？现在都做什么？

questions.en: What difference is there in satisfaction for parents raising an adopted child?
questions.zh: 养育收养孩子和亲生孩子，在父母的满足感上会有不同吗？

questions.en: What family heirlooms do you have and how did you get them?
questions.zh: 你家里有哪些传家宝？它们是怎么传到你手上的？

questions.en: What family trait would you like to pass on to your descendants?
questions.zh: 你最希望把家族中的哪种特质传给后代？

questions.en: What friends, neighbors, and relatives of yours were involved in a war?
questions.zh: 你的朋友、邻居或亲戚中，有哪些人曾参与战争？

questions.en: What lessons did your parents feel strongly about passing on to you?
questions.zh: 父母特别坚持要教给你的道理有哪些？

questions.en: What sights, smells, or sounds do you remember from your grandparents' houses?
questions.zh: 你还记得祖父母家里的哪些景象、气味或声音？

questions.en: What was something you and a brother or sister did together regularly?
questions.zh: 你小时候会和兄弟姐妹固定一起做什么？

questions.en: What would a typical evening be like when your parents entertained friends?
questions.zh: 父母邀请朋友到家里时，一个典型的晚上通常是什么样？

questions.en: What would you do if everyone in your family forgot your birthday?
questions.zh: 如果全家人都忘了你的生日，你会怎么做？

questions.en: What would you really like to say to your brother or sister?
questions.zh: 你真正很想对兄弟或姐妹说的一句话是什么？

questions.en: What's an attribute of your own father you see most in yourself?
questions.zh: 你父亲身上的哪个特点，在你自己身上最明显？

questions.en: What's an attribute of your own mother you see most in yourself?
questions.zh: 你母亲身上的哪个特点，在你自己身上最明显？

questions.en: What's more important to you: work and accomplishments or friends and family?
questions.zh: 工作和成就，与朋友和家人相比，哪一个对你更重要？

questions.en: What's the nicest thing a brother or sister ever did for you?
questions.zh: 兄弟姐妹为你做过最贴心的一件事是什么？

questions.en: What's the way your sibling(s) and you act toward each other now?
questions.zh: 你和兄弟姐妹现在通常怎样相处？

questions.en: Which of your male or female relatives served in the armed forces?
questions.zh: 你的男性或女性亲戚中，有谁服过兵役？

questions.en: Who in the family do you have the most difficulty communicating with?
questions.zh: 家里谁是你最难沟通的人？

questions.en: Do little sisters and brothers have it easier or harder than older siblings?
questions.zh: 你觉得年幼的弟弟妹妹比年长的兄姐过得更容易还是更难？

questions.en: Do you ever feel as if you don't have anyone to talk to?
questions.zh: 你有没有过觉得身边完全没有人可以说话的时候？

questions.en: Do you feel children have a responsibility for the care of elderly parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得子女有责任照顾年迈的父母吗？

questions.en: Have your parents played an important role in the lives of your children?
questions.zh: 你的父母在你孩子的人生中扮演了重要角色吗？

questions.en: How often did your parents say they loved you when you were young?
questions.zh: 你小时候，父母多久会对你说一次“我爱你”？

questions.en: If your parents used a social media site, would you still use it?
questions.zh: 如果你的父母开始使用某个社交媒体平台，你还会继续用吗？

questions.en: In your family, did everyone have their own seat at the dinner table?
questions.zh: 你们家吃饭时，每个人是不是都有固定座位？

questions.en: What character or physical traits did you inherit from your mother and father?
questions.zh: 你从父母那里分别遗传了哪些性格或身体特征？

questions.en: What habits or mannerisms of yours remind you of your mother or father?
questions.zh: 你有哪些习惯或小动作会让人想到你的父亲或母亲？

questions.en: What present did you get from your parents that sticks in your memory?
questions.zh: 父母送过你的哪件礼物最让你记忆深刻？

questions.en: What things are you good at that your parents were good at too?
questions.zh: 你擅长的哪些事情，也是父母擅长的？

questions.en: What TV mom or dad do you think you are most similar to?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己最像哪一位电视剧里的妈妈或爸爸？

questions.en: What's one of the ways you and a brother or sister are alike?
questions.zh: 你和某个兄弟姐妹有哪些相似之处？

questions.en: What's one thing you would like to have changed in your father's life?
questions.zh: 如果能改变父亲人生中的一件事，你会改什么？

questions.en: What's one thing you would like to have changed in your mother's life?
questions.zh: 如果能改变母亲人生中的一件事，你会改什么？

questions.en: What's the way your sibling(s) and you acted toward each other as kids?
questions.zh: 小时候你和兄弟姐妹通常怎样对待彼此？

questions.en: When you fall in love, do your relationships with friends and family change?
questions.zh: 当你恋爱时，你和朋友、家人的关系会发生变化吗？

questions.en: Can you love your stepparents or adopted parents as much as a biological parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个人能像爱亲生父母一样爱继父母或养父母吗？

questions.en: Did you become who you are because of or in spite of your parents?
questions.zh: 你成为现在的自己，是因为父母的影响，还是某种程度上克服了父母的影响？

questions.en: Have either of your parents ever said they were sorry or asked your forgiveness?
questions.zh: 你的父母有没有向你道过歉或请求过你的原谅？

questions.en: How much time did your parents spend with you when you were a child?
questions.zh: 小时候父母花多少时间真正陪伴你？

questions.en: What qualities of your grandparents and parents would you like your children to have?
questions.zh: 你希望自己的孩子继承祖父母和父母的哪些品质？

questions.en: What was an issue that caused a great rift between your parents and yourself?
questions.zh: 你和父母之间曾有什么问题造成过很大的裂痕？

questions.en: What was one of the more unique aspects of your family when growing up?
questions.zh: 你成长的家庭有哪些特别独特的地方？

questions.en: What would your reaction be if a close family member announced they was gay?
questions.zh: 如果一位亲近家人宣布自己是同性恋，你会有什么反应？

questions.en: What's one piece of advice you would give to a new mother or father?
questions.zh: 如果给新手父母一条建议，你会说什么？

questions.en: What's something you did as a child that your parents still don't know about?
questions.zh: 你小时候做过什么事，是父母到现在都不知道的？

questions.en: What's the first thing that comes to mind when you think of your family?
questions.zh: 一想到“家庭”，你脑子里最先出现什么？

questions.en: Did anyone in your family know someone or have an encounter with someone really famous?
questions.zh: 你的家人有没有认识或偶遇过真正很有名的人？

questions.en: Do you get so angry that you shout at people who are closest to you?
questions.zh: 你会不会气到对最亲近的人大喊大叫？

questions.en: Have you been able to forgive your mother and father for their failures and imperfections?
questions.zh: 你能原谅父母的失败和不完美吗？

questions.en: How did you typically get into trouble with your parents and how were you punished?
questions.zh: 你小时候通常因为什么和父母惹麻烦？父母会怎样惩罚你？

questions.en: If you could give an award to someone in your family, what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果给家里某个人颁一个奖，你会颁什么奖？

questions.en: What activity or event do you think every family should experience together at least once?
questions.zh: 你觉得每个家庭至少应该一起体验一次什么活动或事件？

questions.en: What game(s) or song(s) did your family play or sing while traveling in the car?
questions.zh: 全家开车旅行时，你们会玩哪些游戏或唱哪些歌？

questions.en: What provisions will you make for your parents if they cannot take care of themselves?
questions.zh: 如果父母将来无法照顾自己，你准备怎样安排他们的生活？

questions.en: What would you like to do for your parents to make their life more enjoyable?
questions.zh: 你最想为父母做什么，让他们生活得更开心？

questions.en: Do you need other people in order to feel happy or can you make yourself happy?
questions.zh: 你需要别人才能感到幸福，还是自己一个人也能让自己幸福？

questions.en: How does family life differ for your children from the way family life was for you?
questions.zh: 你的孩子现在的家庭生活，和你小时候相比有哪些不同？

questions.en: If you could change the balance between work, family, and play, in what way would you?
questions.zh: 如果可以重新平衡工作、家庭和娱乐，你会怎样调整？

questions.en: Do you feel that your parents did a bad, fair, good, or excellent job in raising you?
questions.zh: 你觉得父母把你养大这件事做得差、一般、不错，还是非常好？

questions.en: How often do you see or talk to relatives or family members who don't live with you?
questions.zh: 你多久见一次或联系一次不和你同住的亲戚或家人？

questions.en: If money was not an issue, what gift would you like to buy someone in your family?
questions.zh: 如果完全不用考虑钱，你最想给某位家人买什么礼物？

questions.en: What are all the things you would like or would have liked to say to your mother?
questions.zh: 有哪些话是你很想对母亲说，或者曾经很想说却没说的？

questions.en: Did you ever have to care for or parent one of your parents when you were a child?
questions.zh: 小时候你有没有反过来照顾父母，甚至像“家长”一样承担责任？

questions.en: What will be the one thing you will miss about your parents when they are no longer alive?
questions.zh: 有一天父母不在了，你最会想念他们哪一点？

questions.en: If you discovered one of your parents having an affair?
questions.zh: 如果你发现父母中的一方有婚外情，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Do you have a fear of insects? Which kind?
questions.zh: 你怕昆虫吗？最怕哪一种？

questions.en: Did you get rejected by any colleges? If so, which ones?
questions.zh: 你申请大学时被哪所学校拒绝过吗？

questions.en: How often do you trim your fingernails and toenails? Have you ever had a pedicure?
questions.zh: 你多久修一次手指甲和脚趾甲？做过足部护理吗？

questions.en: If you had to choose, would you dress like your parents or act like them?
questions.zh: 如果只能选一个，你宁愿穿得像父母，还是行为举止像父母？

questions.en: If you had to choose, would you be an only child or one of ten children?
questions.zh: 如果只能选一个，你宁愿当独生子女，还是十个孩子中的一个？

questions.en: If you had to choose, would you lie to your mom or to your significant other?
questions.zh: 如果必须撒谎，你宁愿骗妈妈还是骗伴侣？

questions.en: If you had to choose, would you be the oldest child or the baby of the family?
questions.zh: 如果只能选一个，你宁愿当家里最大的孩子，还是最小的孩子？

questions.en: Do you monitor your kids on social media networks? Do your parents monitor you on social media networks?
questions.zh: 你会监看孩子的社交媒体吗？你的父母会监看你的吗？

questions.en: If you had to choose, would you hang out with your dad or your mom on a Saturday night?
questions.zh: 星期六晚上如果只能选一个，你更愿意和爸爸还是妈妈一起出去？

questions.en: How do you feel about guns?
questions.zh: 你对枪支总体是什么感觉？

questions.en: How do you feel about teenage marriages?
questions.zh: 你怎么看青少年结婚？

questions.en: How do you feel about your schedule?
questions.zh: 你对自己现在的日程安排满意吗？

questions.en: How do you feel about spanking a child?
questions.zh: 你怎么看打孩子屁股这种管教方式？

questions.en: How do you feel when someone teases you?
questions.zh: 别人取笑你时，你通常有什么感觉？

questions.en: Do you think you look younger than/older than/exactly your age?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己看起来比实际年龄年轻、年长，还是差不多？

questions.en: How do you feel about the way you spend most days?
questions.zh: 你对自己大多数日子是怎样度过的满意吗？

questions.en: What member of your family do you feel closest to and why?
questions.zh: 你和哪位家人最亲近？为什么？

questions.en: Do adopted children love their adoptive parents as they would have loved their birth parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得被收养的孩子能像爱亲生父母一样爱养父母吗？

questions.en: How would you make choices for a parent facing a long and agonizing physical deterioration?
questions.zh: 如果父母面临长期而痛苦的身体衰退，你会怎样替他们做医疗和生活上的选择？

questions.en: What's one of the ways your mother and grandmother were/are alike (or father and grandfather)?
questions.zh: 你的母亲和外祖母，或父亲和祖父，有哪些相似之处？

questions.en: Does your work define your identity, or is it defined by family role and personal interests?
questions.zh: 你的身份更多由工作定义，还是由家庭角色和个人兴趣定义？

questions.en: Would you report a family member to the police if you knew they had committed a crime?
questions.zh: 如果你知道某位家人犯了罪，你会去报警吗？

questions.en: Would you invite one of your parents to live with you if they was all alone and older?
questions.zh: 如果年迈的父亲或母亲独自生活，你会邀请他/她搬来和你住吗？

questions.en: What decision would you like your family to make regarding your life if you were mentally or physically incapacitated?
questions.zh: 如果你在精神或身体上失去自主能力，你希望家人替你做出怎样的决定？

questions.en: What members of your family would you like to write or call that you have not kept in touch with?
questions.zh: 有哪些家人是你很久没联系、现在想写信或打电话给他们的？

questions.en: What would you do if a close friend or family member who is terminally ill asks you to help them die?
questions.zh: 如果一位身患绝症的亲友请求你帮助他/她结束生命，你会怎么做？

questions.en: What was the most important thing that your parents did in raising you that you would like to do for your children?
questions.zh: 父母养育你时做过最重要的哪一件事，是你也想对自己的孩子做到的？

questions.en: What's something your parents did that you have never forgiven them for and what would it take for you to forgive them?
questions.zh: 父母做过什么事情是你一直没能原谅的？要怎样你才可能原谅？

questions.en: If your friends or family members were willing to bluntly and honestly tell you what they really thought of you, would you want them to?
questions.zh: 如果朋友或家人愿意非常直接、诚实地告诉你他们真正怎么看你，你想听吗？

questions.en: What do you enjoy most and least about married life?
questions.zh: 婚姻生活中你最喜欢和最不喜欢的部分分别是什么？

questions.en: What scares you?
questions.zh: 什么最让你害怕？

questions.en: What makes you sad?
questions.zh: 什么最容易让你难过？

questions.en: Do you fear nuclear war?
questions.zh: 你害怕核战争吗？

questions.en: What makes you feel guilty?
questions.zh: 什么事情最容易让你产生内疚感？

questions.en: What worries you the most?
questions.zh: 你最担心什么？

questions.en: When do you feel impatient?
questions.zh: 你通常什么时候最没有耐心？

questions.en: Do you feel comfortable selling anything?
questions.zh: 你会觉得向别人推销东西很自在吗？

questions.en: Do you worry about identity theft?
questions.zh: 你担心身份盗窃吗？

questions.en: Do you worry about terrorist attacks?
questions.zh: 你担心恐怖袭击吗？

questions.en: What about love makes you afraid?
questions.zh: 爱情中什么最让你害怕？

questions.en: What are your embarrassments and regrets?
questions.zh: 你最尴尬和最遗憾的事情有哪些？

questions.en: What consistently worries you each day?
questions.zh: 每天有什么事情会反复让你担心？

questions.en: What kinds of situations embarrass you?
questions.zh: 哪些情境最容易让你尴尬？

questions.en: What were you most afraid of?
questions.zh: 你以前最害怕什么？

questions.en: Can you be very poor but happy?
questions.zh: 一个人非常贫穷，也可以很幸福吗？

questions.en: Does your happiness outweigh regret in general?
questions.zh: 总体来说，你人生中的幸福是否多于遗憾？

questions.en: How do people know you are angry?
questions.zh: 别人通常怎样看出你正在生气？

questions.en: Describe the first time you fell in love.
questions.zh: 描述一下你第一次真正爱上一个人的经历。

questions.en: What parenting moment would make you most proud?
questions.zh: 作为父母，什么样的时刻会让你最骄傲？

questions.en: What tends to make you angry with yourself?
questions.zh: 什么最容易让你对自己生气？

questions.en: What's an activity that makes you feel alive?
questions.zh: 什么活动最能让你感觉自己真正活着？

questions.en: What's something you feel too young to do?
questions.zh: 有没有什么事情是你觉得自己年纪还太小，不适合做的？

questions.en: When you're happy, what do you want most?
questions.zh: 当你很开心时，你最想要什么？

questions.en: Do you feel that you are an ethical person?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己是一个有道德原则的人吗？

questions.en: Do you feel you have enough time/too much/not enough?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己的时间是刚刚好、太多，还是不够？

questions.en: Have you been happy with the way you look?
questions.zh: 你对自己的外貌一直满意吗？

questions.en: How did you feel each time you changed homes?
questions.zh: 每次搬家时，你通常有什么感觉？

questions.en: Is there something you feel too old to do?
questions.zh: 有没有什么事情是你觉得自己年纪太大，不适合再做的？

questions.en: What are some big things that make you happy?
questions.zh: 有哪些大事情会让你真正开心？

questions.en: What are some little things that make you happy?
questions.zh: 有哪些很小的事情也会让你开心？

questions.en: What are three things you feel totally neutral about?
questions.zh: 说出三件你完全没有特别感觉、保持中立的事情。

questions.en: What did you fear most about becoming an adult?
questions.zh: 小时候想到“成为成年人”，最让你害怕的是什么？

questions.en: What gives you a feeling of abundance in life?
questions.zh: 生活中什么最能让你感觉富足、拥有很多？

questions.en: What smell makes you feel safe and cared for?
questions.zh: 哪一种气味最能让你感到安全、被照顾？

questions.en: What things can you do to feel less lonely?
questions.zh: 你可以做哪些事情让自己不那么孤独？

questions.en: What time of day do you feel most creative?
questions.zh: 一天中你什么时候最有创造力？

questions.en: What was the one thing you worried about most?
questions.zh: 你过去最担心的一件事是什么？

questions.en: When are some times you have had low self-esteem?
questions.zh: 你什么时候曾特别没有自信或自尊很低？

questions.en: When was a time when a child embarrassed you?
questions.zh: 有没有一次孩子做了什么让你特别尴尬？

questions.en: Do you feel that climate change is a serious problem?
questions.zh: 你觉得气候变化是一个严重问题吗？

questions.en: Do you feel vengeful or forgiving if someone hurts you?
questions.zh: 别人伤害你时，你更容易想报复，还是更容易原谅？

questions.en: Do you think that you are/would be a good parent?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己现在或将来会是一个好父母吗？

questions.en: What areas of research do you feel should be broadened?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪些研究领域应该获得更广泛的研究和投入？

questions.en: What do other people do that makes you feel embarrassed?
questions.zh: 别人做什么最容易让你替他们尴尬或觉得难堪？

questions.en: Do you feel you look better in long or short hair?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己留长发还是短发更好看？

questions.en: What activities would you do if you were not so afraid?
questions.zh: 如果不是因为害怕，你会去做哪些事情？

questions.en: What things were you once afraid of, but are no longer?
questions.zh: 有哪些事情是你以前害怕、现在已经不怕了的？

questions.en: When my partner is happy, I am happy: true or false?
questions.zh: “伴侣开心，我就开心。”这句话对你来说是对还是错？

questions.en: If you didn't know your parents, what two people would you choose as your mother and father?
questions.zh: 如果完全不认识自己的父母，你会选哪两个人分别当母亲和父亲？

questions.en: Did you ever pretend that you were from somewhere else? That you did something else for a living?
questions.zh: 你有没有假装自己来自另一个地方，或假装从事另一种职业？

questions.en: What do you really believe in?
questions.zh: 你真正深信什么？

questions.en: Do you follow the results of public opinion polls?
questions.zh: 你会关注民意调查的结果吗？

questions.en: Do you obey rules you consider unfair or ridiculous?
questions.zh: 即使你觉得某条规则不公平或很荒唐，你仍会遵守吗？

questions.en: Do you support the Occupy Wall Street (OWS) movement?
questions.zh: 你支持“占领华尔街”运动吗？

questions.en: What do you believe our individual rights should be?
questions.zh: 你觉得个人应该享有哪些基本权利？

questions.en: What do you think about young adults living with parents?
questions.zh: 你怎么看成年子女继续和父母住在一起？

questions.en: Have you ever experienced the feeling that you don't really exist?
questions.zh: 你有没有经历过一种“自己好像根本不存在”的感觉？

questions.en: If you were a child again; what would you tell your parents?
questions.zh: 如果你重新变成一个孩子，你最想对父母说什么？

questions.en: What do you think is the worst part of having a close family?
questions.zh: 你觉得家庭非常亲密可能带来的最糟糕一面是什么？

questions.en: What do you think your parents worried about when they were your age?
questions.zh: 你觉得父母在你这个年龄时最担心什么？

questions.en: What family vacations were taken and where? What was a particularly memorable one?
questions.zh: 你们家以前去过哪些地方度假？哪一次特别难忘？

questions.en: Would you ever let a relative live with you? Why or why not?
questions.zh: 你愿意让某位亲戚长期住在你家吗？为什么？

questions.en: Have you ever known any born-again Christians and how did you feel about them?
questions.zh: 你认识过重生派基督徒吗？你对他们有什么感觉？

questions.en: Were your grandparents born where you live now? If not, how did they come here?
questions.zh: 你的祖父母出生在你现在生活的地方吗？如果不是，他们当初是怎么来的？

questions.en: Would you ever elope? Would that suit you? Would it hurt your family or friends?
questions.zh: 你会考虑私奔结婚吗？这适合你吗？会伤害家人或朋友吗？

questions.en: How many people do you follow on social media? Who - friends and family, or celebrities?
questions.zh: 你在社交媒体上关注多少人？主要关注朋友家人，还是名人？

questions.en: Have you ever given someone a nickname that you knew they would hate and feel hurt by?
questions.zh: 你有没有故意给别人取一个你知道对方会讨厌、会受伤的外号？

questions.en: How do you behave when you feel depressed and what do you need most at that time?
questions.zh: 感到抑郁低落时，你通常会怎么表现？那时你最需要什么？

questions.en: Are you the parent of a boomerang child who has returned home as a young adult? Are or were you a boomerang child?
questions.zh: 你是“回巢子女”的父母吗——孩子成年后又搬回家？或者你自己曾经是回巢子女吗？

questions.en: How do you feel about news media's coverage of presidential campaigns?
questions.zh: 你怎么看新闻媒体对总统竞选的报道方式？

questions.en: Did your parents choose a legal guardian for you if they died prematurely? If so, who?
questions.zh: 如果你的父母早逝，他们有没有预先指定你的法定监护人？是谁？

questions.en: Where should funding of the arts come from?
questions.zh: 你觉得艺术经费应该主要从哪里来？

questions.en: Is your organization top-of-the-line, fair-to-middling, or sad and struggling?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己所在的组织属于一流、一般，还是处境艰难？

questions.en: Where's it easiest for you to have important talks?
questions.zh: 你最容易在哪里进行重要、深入的谈话？

questions.en: In what circumstances do you feel most susceptible to temptation?
questions.zh: 在什么情况下，你最容易抵挡不住诱惑？

questions.en: What are your feelings about the space program in general?
questions.zh: 总体来说，你怎么看太空计划？

questions.en: Do you feel comfortable introducing old lovers to a current one?
questions.zh: 把前任介绍给现任时，你会觉得自在吗？

questions.en: What was your most embarrassing moment in front of a group?
questions.zh: 你在一群人面前经历过最尴尬的时刻是什么？

questions.en: Are rich people happier than you, less happy, or about the same?
questions.zh: 你觉得有钱人比你更幸福、更不幸福，还是差不多？

questions.en: Do you have a favorable or unfavorable opinion of Hillary Rodham Clinton?
questions.zh: 你对希拉里·罗德姆·克林顿的看法总体偏正面还是负面？

questions.en: Do you have an understanding of how public opinion polls are conducted?
questions.zh: 你了解民意调查通常是怎样设计和执行的吗？

questions.en: How did someone once help you when you were not feeling well?
questions.zh: 你身体不舒服时，别人曾经怎样帮助过你？

questions.en: What activity has most consistently given you a feeling of inner peace?
questions.zh: 哪一种活动最稳定地带给你内心的平静？

questions.en: What issue do you feel strongly about but have kept to yourself?
questions.zh: 有没有一个你立场很强烈、但一直没向别人说出口的议题？

questions.en: What thoughts and feelings come to mind when you think of "play?"?
questions.zh: 一想到“玩耍”这个词，你会想到哪些画面和感受？

questions.en: With what tool, implement, or utensil do you feel most at ease?
questions.zh: 你使用哪一种工具、器具或厨房用具时最得心应手？

questions.en: Do you think adopted children have the right to know their birth parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得被收养的孩子有权知道自己的亲生父母是谁吗？

questions.en: Do you think preschool-age children suffer if both parents work outside the home?
questions.zh: 如果父母双方都在外工作，你觉得学龄前儿童会因此受到负面影响吗？

questions.en: What are three things you think you need in order to be happy?
questions.zh: 说出三样你认为获得幸福所需要的东西。

questions.en: What physical change do you worry about most in the next twenty years?
questions.zh: 未来二十年里，你最担心自己发生什么身体变化？

questions.en: What would you do differently if you had no fear of making mistakes?
questions.zh: 如果完全不怕犯错，你会在哪些方面做得不一样？

questions.en: Do you think it is a problem when children are born to single parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子由单亲父母抚养本身是个问题吗？

questions.en: What do you worry people might assume about you when they first meet you?
questions.zh: 第一次见面时，你最担心别人会对你作出什么错误判断？

questions.en: How often would you be embarrassed if others knew exactly what was on your mind?
questions.zh: 如果别人完全知道你脑子里在想什么，你觉得自己会多常感到尴尬？

questions.en: Was there a time when you could have helped someone and regret not doing so?
questions.zh: 有没有一次你本来可以帮别人，却没有帮，现在仍然后悔？

questions.en: When was a time you felt guilty and how do you feel about it now?
questions.zh: 有没有一次你感到很内疚？现在回头看是什么感觉？

questions.en: Do you feel hurt if people don't try to cheer you up when you are unhappy?
questions.zh: 当你不开心时，如果别人不试着安慰你，你会觉得受伤吗？

questions.en: Do you feel that models in magazines give off the wrong signals by being so skinny?
questions.zh: 你觉得杂志里的模特太瘦，会不会向大众传递错误信息？

questions.en: Do you have phobias - real or imagined - or do you think you have none?
questions.zh: 你有没有恐惧症——不论是真的还是你自己觉得有？还是觉得自己完全没有？

questions.en: Of all the things someone could say about you, what would make you feel the best?
questions.zh: 别人可能对你说的所有话里，哪一句最能让你感觉特别好？

questions.en: Do you think you said or have said "I love you" enough to your mother and father?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己对父母说“我爱你”说得够多吗？

questions.en: Is there a hole in your life, that is, a person you feel you should have been with?
questions.zh: 你的人生中有没有一个“空缺”，也就是一个你觉得本来应该和自己在一起的人？

questions.en: Describe the "ideal" family.
questions.zh: 描述一下你心目中的“理想家庭”。

questions.en: Describe a typical family dinner.
questions.zh: 描述一顿典型的家庭晚餐。

questions.en: Describe your mother's most annoying habit.
questions.zh: 你母亲最让你受不了的习惯是什么？

questions.en: What's your opinion of soap operas?
questions.zh: 你怎么看肥皂剧？

questions.en: What's your overall opinion of Israel?
questions.zh: 总体来说，你怎么看以色列？

questions.en: Describe each family member in one word.
questions.zh: 用一个词分别形容每一位家人。

questions.en: Do you support foreign aid in the form of military assistance?
questions.zh: 你支持以军事援助形式提供对外援助吗？

questions.en: Do you support your country building a defense system against nuclear missiles?
questions.zh: 你支持你的国家建设反导系统来防御核导弹吗？

questions.en: How would you explain why a lot of bad people live long, happy lives and innocent good people die?
questions.zh: 你会怎样解释：为什么有些坏人长寿幸福，而一些无辜善良的人却很早去世？

questions.en: Are you the same person with your family as with your friends; if not, what are the differences and why?
questions.zh: 你在家人面前和在朋友面前是同一个样子吗？如果不是，有什么不同？为什么？

questions.en: What would you do if your sibling told you that they killed someone in a hit-and-run accident? Would you turn them in?
questions.zh: 如果兄弟姐妹告诉你，他/她肇事逃逸并导致别人死亡，你会怎么做？会举报吗？

questions.en: Do you support or oppose legislation on background checks before a gun purchase?
questions.zh: 你支持还是反对购买枪支前必须进行背景审查的法律？

questions.en: What would you do if someone you love deeply is murdered and you know the identity of the murderer, who is acquitted of the crime? Would you seek revenge?
questions.zh: 如果你深爱的人被谋杀，你知道凶手是谁，但对方最终被判无罪，你会想报复吗？

questions.en: What pastor/priest/etc. did you feel closest to and why?
questions.zh: 你过去最亲近哪位牧师、神父或其他宗教领袖？为什么？

questions.en: Should an embryo be transferable to anyone other than the biological parents?
questions.zh: 你觉得胚胎可以转移给亲生父母之外的人吗？

questions.en: Which things do you fear: failure, water, spiders, crowds, hair loss, injections, blood, sirens?
questions.zh: 以下哪些事情会让你害怕：失败、水、蜘蛛、人群、掉发、打针、血或警报声？

questions.en: What about beauty draws us to it and why does it make us feel good?
questions.zh: 美为什么会吸引我们？为什么它会让人感觉愉悦？

questions.en: How often do you feel others are better, smarter, richer, happier, or more successful than you?
questions.zh: 你多久会觉得别人比自己更优秀、更聪明、更有钱、更幸福或更成功？

questions.en: Is it possible that certain difficulties require bending, giving in, and even allowing yourself to feel overwhelmed?
questions.zh: 有些困难是不是需要我们学会弯下身、退一步，甚至允许自己暂时被压倒？

questions.en: What parts of your life do you feel you control and how much of your life is beyond your control?
questions.zh: 你觉得人生中哪些部分由自己掌控？又有多少其实不受你控制？

questions.en: What things do you do in the same order each day and how do you feel if you skip a step or miss a day?
questions.zh: 你每天有哪些事情会按固定顺序做？如果少一步或漏一天，你会有什么感觉？

questions.en: What's your favorite romantic film?
questions.zh: 你最喜欢哪部爱情电影？

questions.en: Do you sometimes drink more than you should? When?
questions.zh: 你有时会喝得超过自己应该喝的量吗？通常什么时候？

questions.en: Describe something you and your father or mother did together.
questions.zh: 描述一件你和父亲或母亲一起做过的事情。

questions.en: Describe your last family reunion and how many relatives attended?
questions.zh: 描述一下你最近一次家庭团聚，大概有多少亲戚参加？

questions.en: Describe your family's economic conditions and how that affected your lifestyle.
questions.zh: 描述一下你成长家庭的经济状况，以及它怎样影响了你的生活方式。

questions.en: Describe something of significance that someone in your family has taught you.
questions.zh: 说一件某位家人教给你的、对你很重要的事情。

questions.en: Do you have a favorite saying? Why is it meaningful to you?
questions.zh: 你有最喜欢的一句话或格言吗？它为什么对你有意义？

questions.en: Do you agree or disagree that it is important to have a good hard failure when you are young?
questions.zh: 你赞同“年轻时经历一次真正惨重的失败很重要”这种说法吗？

questions.en: Talk about responsibility.
questions.zh: 聊聊你怎么看“责任”。

questions.en: Do you believe in angels?
questions.zh: 你相信天使吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in karma?
questions.zh: 你相信因果报应吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in voodoo?
questions.zh: 你相信巫毒术吗？

questions.en: When should people stop driving?
questions.zh: 你觉得人到了什么时候应该停止开车？

questions.en: Define our responsibilities in a democracy.
questions.zh: 你会怎样定义公民在民主社会中的责任？

questions.en: Do you believe humans have souls?
questions.zh: 你相信人有灵魂吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in déjà vu?
questions.zh: 你相信似曾相识这种体验有特殊意义吗？

questions.en: Do you believe there are witches?
questions.zh: 你相信女巫或巫婆真的存在吗？

questions.en: How long should unemployment benefits last?
questions.zh: 你觉得失业救济应该最多发多久？

questions.en: How should military expenditures be regulated?
questions.zh: 你觉得军费支出应该怎样受到管理和限制？

questions.en: How should racial epithets be treated?
questions.zh: 你觉得带有种族侮辱意味的称呼应该怎样处理？

questions.en: Is society biased against single women?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对单身女性存在偏见吗？

questions.en: What are our nation's moral values?
questions.zh: 你觉得我们国家最核心的道德价值是什么？

questions.en: What existing law would you eliminate?
questions.zh: 如果可以废除一条现有法律，你会选哪条？

questions.en: What relationships should you end altogether?
questions.zh: 有哪些关系是你觉得应该彻底结束的？

questions.en: What's society's greatest barrier to peace?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会实现和平最大的障碍是什么？

questions.en: What's something important on your desk?
questions.zh: 你的办公桌上有什么东西对你特别重要？

questions.en: Who should be sponsoring the arts?
questions.zh: 你觉得艺术活动应该由谁来赞助？

questions.en: BY LAW, SHOULD toy guns be banned?
questions.zh: 你觉得法律应该禁止玩具枪吗？

questions.en: Did you believe in the Tooth Fairy?
questions.zh: 小时候你相信牙仙子吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in destiny or choice?
questions.zh: 你更相信命运，还是个人选择？

questions.en: Do you believe in good luck charms?
questions.zh: 你相信幸运符吗？

questions.en: People should not marry before what age?
questions.zh: 你觉得人最早应该到几岁才适合结婚？

questions.en: What heavy luxury tax should be imposed?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪些奢侈品应该被征收很高的奢侈税？

questions.en: What relationships are most important to you?
questions.zh: 你人生中哪些关系对你最重要？

questions.en: What should be done about nuclear arms?
questions.zh: 你觉得核武器问题应该怎样处理？

questions.en: What should children always be punished for?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子做哪些事情一定应该受到惩罚？

questions.en: What should companies provide for childcare benefits?
questions.zh: 你觉得公司应该提供哪些育儿或托儿福利？

questions.en: What's one thing every kid should have?
questions.zh: 你觉得每个孩子都应该至少拥有一样什么东西？

questions.en: Can you explain logical positivism or moral relativism?
questions.zh: 你能解释逻辑实证主义或道德相对主义吗？

questions.en: Do people generally have respect for the law?
questions.zh: 你觉得人们总体上尊重法律吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in love at first sight?
questions.zh: 你相信一见钟情吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in the afterlife and reincarnation?
questions.zh: 你相信来世和轮回吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in the Devil or demons?
questions.zh: 你相信魔鬼或恶魔存在吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in the power of self-transformation?
questions.zh: 你相信人有彻底改变自己的能力吗？

questions.en: Do you believe your country is respected internationally?
questions.zh: 你觉得你的国家在国际上受到尊重吗？

questions.en: How long do you think you will live?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己大概会活到多少岁？

questions.en: People should not have children before what age?
questions.zh: 你觉得人最早应该到几岁才适合生孩子？

questions.en: Were you ever in trouble with the law?
questions.zh: 你以前有没有因为违法而惹过麻烦？

questions.en: What important decisions have you based on intuition?
questions.zh: 你曾根据直觉做过哪些重要决定？

questions.en: What new law would you like to make?
questions.zh: 如果可以制定一条新法律，你会制定什么？

questions.en: What should all companies provide for all employees?
questions.zh: 你觉得所有公司都应该为员工提供哪些基本保障或福利？

questions.en: What should be the pollution and emission controls?
questions.zh: 你觉得污染和排放应该受到怎样的控制？

questions.en: What should be the punishment for Nazi-era deeds?
questions.zh: 你觉得纳粹时代犯下的罪行应该受到怎样的惩罚？

questions.en: What should the punishment be for apartheid-era crimes?
questions.zh: 你觉得种族隔离制度时期的罪行应该受到怎样的惩罚？

questions.en: Which aunt(s) and uncle(s) were important to you?
questions.zh: 哪些叔叔或阿姨对你的成长特别重要？

questions.en: Which fertility practice do you think needs regulation?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪一种生育或辅助生殖做法最需要监管？

questions.en: Who's the most important person in your life?
questions.zh: 你人生中最重要的人是谁？

questions.en: Do you believe in the principles of feng shui?
questions.zh: 你相信风水的原则吗？

questions.en: How important is it for you to be popular?
questions.zh: 对你来说，受欢迎有多重要？

questions.en: How should we be dealing with the terrorism issue?
questions.zh: 你觉得我们应该怎样应对恐怖主义问题？

questions.en: What obligations should you eliminate or say "no" to?
questions.zh: 你现在最应该减少、取消或学会说“不”的义务有哪些？

questions.en: What role should your country play in world affairs?
questions.zh: 你觉得你的国家在世界事务中应该扮演什么角色？

questions.en: What should be the earliest age for piercing ears?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子最早几岁可以打耳洞？

questions.en: What things do you think you cannot live without?
questions.zh: 有哪些东西是你觉得自己完全离不开的？

questions.en: What things were important to you as a teenager?
questions.zh: 你十几岁时最看重哪些事情？

questions.en: At what age do you think children are most difficult?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子在哪个年龄阶段最难带？

questions.en: Do you believe we are descendants of Adam and Eve?
questions.zh: 你相信人类是亚当和夏娃的后代吗？

questions.en: How far should doctors go to prolong a person's life?
questions.zh: 为了延长生命，你觉得医生最多应该做到什么程度？

questions.en: How much influence do you think you have on people?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己对别人有多大影响力？

questions.en: What direction do you think the country is going in?
questions.zh: 你觉得国家目前正在往好的方向还是坏的方向走？

questions.en: What should be the fate of draft resisters or dodgers?
questions.zh: 你觉得拒服兵役或逃避征兵的人应该面临什么后果？

questions.en: What should the fine be for running a red light?
questions.zh: 闯红灯应该罚多少钱才合理？

questions.en: When should a child be told that they is adopted?
questions.zh: 你觉得被收养的孩子应该在什么时候知道自己的身世？

questions.en: Who was the most important role model in your life?
questions.zh: 你人生中最重要的榜样是谁？

questions.en: Has anyone ever made fun of you for what you believe?
questions.zh: 有没有人因为你的信念或观点嘲笑过你？

questions.en: If you found out you were adopted; how would you feel?
questions.zh: 如果突然发现自己其实是被收养的，你会有什么感觉？

questions.en: Are you in favor of public schools teaching morals and moral behavior?
questions.zh: 你赞成公立学校教授道德和道德行为吗？

questions.en: In what ways do you think boys or girls have it easier?
questions.zh: 你觉得男孩和女孩分别在哪些方面过得更容易？

questions.en: If a national monument could honor one more person, who would you add?
questions.zh: 如果国家纪念碑可以再增加一个人，你会选谁？

questions.en: Should people have the right to defend themselves, their family, and property by all available means?
questions.zh: 你觉得人们是否有权用一切可用手段保护自己、家人和财产？

questions.en: What should be the punishment for incest?
questions.zh: 你觉得乱伦应该受到怎样的惩罚？

questions.en: What are your overall impressions of Mexico and Canada?
questions.zh: 总体来说，你对墨西哥和加拿大有什么印象？

questions.en: Have you ever boycotted produce because of growers' unfair labor practices?
questions.zh: 你有没有因为种植者的不公平劳动做法而抵制过某些农产品？

questions.en: How do you think the problems in the Middle East could be resolved?
questions.zh: 你觉得中东问题可能怎样得到解决？

questions.en: How do you think the world will look in 25, 50, 75, 100 years?
questions.zh: 你觉得25年、50年、75年、100年后的世界分别会是什么样？

questions.en: Have you ever taken part in the Gallup or Roper Poll or other public opinion surveys?
questions.zh: 你参加过盖洛普、罗珀或其他民意调查吗？

questions.en: How do you think the world would be different if all the world's leaders were women?
questions.zh: 如果世界各国领导人全部是女性，你觉得世界会有什么不同？

questions.en: Do you make a point of buying products made in your own country? Does that matter to you?
questions.zh: 你会特意购买本国制造的产品吗？这一点对你重要吗？

questions.en: What measures should be taken to save endangered species?
questions.zh: 你觉得应该采取哪些措施保护濒危物种？

questions.en: What should be done about criminals acquitted on technicalities?
questions.zh: 你觉得因为程序或技术性问题被判无罪的犯罪嫌疑人应该怎样处理？

questions.en: What should the penalties be for breaking environmental laws?
questions.zh: 违反环保法律应该受到怎样的惩罚？

questions.en: What three questions should every citizen have to answer?
questions.zh: 如果每个公民都必须回答三个问题，你会设计哪三个？

questions.en: Do you believe in ESP, telepathy, telekinesis, clairvoyance, or channeling?
questions.zh: 你相信超感知觉、心灵感应、意念移物、千里眼或通灵吗？

questions.en: Do you believe in superstitions and how superstitious are you?
questions.zh: 你相信迷信吗？你觉得自己有多迷信？

questions.en: Do you believe that certain numbers are lucky or unlucky?
questions.zh: 你相信某些数字会带来好运或厄运吗？

questions.en: Do you believe that playing is more important than winning?
questions.zh: 你相信参与和玩得开心比赢得比赛更重要吗？

questions.en: How important are unions in protecting the rights of workers?
questions.zh: 你觉得工会在保护劳动者权益方面有多重要？

questions.en: How much responsibility do you take for your own problems?
questions.zh: 你会为自己的问题承担多大责任？

questions.en: The human organ shortage: should we pay for donated organs?
questions.zh: 面对器官短缺，你觉得是否应该给器官捐献者支付报酬？

questions.en: What precautions for shipments of hazardous materials should be taken?
questions.zh: 运输危险物质时，你觉得应该采取哪些安全措施？

questions.en: What should be businesses' commitment to their workers and communities?
questions.zh: 你觉得企业应该对员工和所在社区承担什么责任？

questions.en: What should be done to enforce payment of child support?
questions.zh: 你觉得应该怎样强制落实子女抚养费的支付？

questions.en: When do you think cellular phones are bothersome or obnoxious?
questions.zh: 你觉得手机在什么情况下最让人烦、最没礼貌？

questions.en: At what age do you think children are cutest to observe?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子在哪个年龄最可爱、最值得观察？

questions.en: Do you believe soul mates meet by accident or by destiny?
questions.zh: 你相信灵魂伴侣的相遇是偶然还是命中注定？

questions.en: How should the identification and deportation of illegal aliens be handled?
questions.zh: 你觉得非法移民的识别和遣返问题应该怎样处理？

questions.en: Is it important to stop other countries from developing nuclear weapons?
questions.zh: 你觉得阻止其他国家发展核武器重要吗？

questions.en: Is there a particular law you have pretty much always disregarded?
questions.zh: 有没有一条法律是你长期基本上一直没怎么遵守的？

questions.en: What other Presidents besides Richard Nixon do you think were corrupt?
questions.zh: 除了理查德·尼克松之外，你觉得还有哪些美国总统曾经腐败？

questions.en: What role should major powers play in shaping the global order?
questions.zh: 你觉得大国在塑造全球秩序中应该扮演什么角色？

questions.en: What should be done about the intrusive coverage by modern journalism?
questions.zh: 你觉得现代新闻报道过度侵入私人生活的问题应该怎样处理？

questions.en: What would you change about the electoral system where you live?
questions.zh: 你觉得你所在国家的选举制度最需要改变什么？

questions.en: Which one of the Ten Commandments is most important to you?
questions.zh: 《十诫》中哪一条对你最重要？

questions.en: At what age should children be allowed to get their driver's license?
questions.zh: 你觉得孩子到几岁才应该允许考驾照？

questions.en: Do you believe people can be possessed by the Devil or demons?
questions.zh: 你相信人可能被魔鬼或恶魔附身吗？

questions.en: How much responsibility do you have in your life, positive and negative?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己对人生中的好事和坏事分别承担多少责任？

questions.en: What part of parenting do you think you could be better at?
questions.zh: 作为父母，你觉得自己在哪方面最需要做得更好？

questions.en: What should be the priority: exploring space, the ocean, or our planet?
questions.zh: 探索太空、海洋和地球本身，你觉得哪个应该优先？

questions.en: What should prisoners contribute to society while locked up, besides license plates?
questions.zh: 除了制作车牌之外，你觉得服刑人员在狱中还应该怎样为社会作贡献？

questions.en: What should the minimum punishment be for those who commit white-collar crimes?
questions.zh: 对白领犯罪者，你觉得最低应该给予什么惩罚？

questions.en: What's a saying about women or men that you believe is true?
questions.zh: 有没有一句关于男性或女性的说法，是你觉得确实有道理的？

questions.en: What's the most important thing you would want to teach your kids?
questions.zh: 如果只能教孩子一件最重要的事，你会教什么？

questions.en: What's the single-most important piece of advice you would give a child?
questions.zh: 如果只能给孩子一条最重要的建议，你会说什么？

questions.en: When should you tell a child that there is no Santa Claus?
questions.zh: 你觉得应该在什么时候告诉孩子圣诞老人并不存在？

questions.en: How would you rate your public speaking ability: poor, fair, good, or exceptional?
questions.zh: 你会怎样评价自己的公开演讲能力：较差、一般、不错还是非常出色？

questions.en: Is the convenience of human beings more important than the protection of nature?
questions.zh: 人的便利是否比保护自然更重要？

questions.en: What famous person's life story do you think every adult should know about?
questions.zh: 哪位名人的人生故事是你觉得每个成年人都应该了解的？

questions.en: What should be the penalty for illegally dumping or disposing of nuclear waste?
questions.zh: 非法倾倒或处理核废料应该受到怎样的惩罚？

questions.en: What traits do you think are most important to instill in a child?
questions.zh: 你觉得最应该培养孩子的哪些性格特质？

questions.en: What's one thing that should be different in schools ten years from now?
questions.zh: 十年后的学校最应该有什么不同？

questions.en: What's something you believed for a long time that you don't believe anymore?
questions.zh: 有没有一个你相信了很久、现在已经不再相信的观念？

questions.en: What's the single most important piece of advice you would offer to newlyweds?
questions.zh: 如果只能给新婚夫妇一条最重要的建议，你会说什么？

questions.en: BY LAW, SHOULD research that may lead to human cloning come to a halt?
questions.zh: 你觉得法律是否应该叫停可能最终导致人类克隆的研究？

questions.en: Do you know when to accept your measure of responsibility for a bad break?
questions.zh: 遇到坏运气或挫折时，你知道什么时候该承认自己应承担的那部分责任吗？

questions.en: How and when do you think that the world will come to an end?
questions.zh: 你觉得世界会怎样、在什么时候结束？

questions.en: What should be done with hazardous waste and what are alternatives for its removal?
questions.zh: 危险废物应该怎样处理？还有哪些替代方案？

questions.en: What's one topic you believe you should avoid discussing with those closest to you?
questions.zh: 有没有一个话题，是你觉得最好不要和最亲近的人讨论的？

questions.en: How can you teach your children about the role of money in life and responsibility?
questions.zh: 你会怎样教孩子理解金钱在人生中的作用，以及与金钱相关的责任？

questions.en: What was the most important idea of this century, last century, and of all time?
questions.zh: 你觉得本世纪、上个世纪以及整个人类历史中最重要的思想分别是什么？

questions.en: What's the most important piece of information you have picked up in life so far?
questions.zh: 到目前为止，你在人生中获得过最重要的一条信息是什么？

questions.en: Do you believe that fracking is an environmentally safe or unsafe way to get natural gas?
questions.zh: 你觉得水力压裂开采天然气对环境安全还是不安全？

questions.en: Do you believe it is possible to be with one person for the rest of your life?
questions.zh: 你相信一个人有可能和同一个伴侣度过余生吗？

questions.en: Is racism built into the society you live in, or are incidents mostly isolated?
questions.zh: 你觉得种族歧视是你所在社会的固有问题，还是大多数事件只是个别现象？

questions.en: Do you like to flirt and think that flirting is okay and romantic?
questions.zh: 你喜欢调情吗？你觉得调情是正常、浪漫的行为吗？

questions.en: In your relationship, who generally pays when you go out to a restaurant or movie?
questions.zh: 你和伴侣外出吃饭或看电影时，通常是谁买单？

questions.en: When you are attracted to someone, do you like to be the cat or the mouse?
questions.zh: 对一个人产生吸引力时，你喜欢主动追，还是更喜欢让对方来追你？

questions.en: What do you think about fighting?
questions.zh: 你怎么看打架或武力冲突？

questions.en: What do you think is funny?
questions.zh: 你觉得什么最好笑？

questions.en: What do you think about arranged marriages?
questions.zh: 你怎么看包办婚姻？

questions.en: What do you think about anti-land mine campaigns?
questions.zh: 你怎么看反地雷运动？

questions.en: What do you think about deactivating air bags?
questions.zh: 你怎么看关闭或停用汽车安全气囊？

questions.en: What do you think about the virtual workplace?
questions.zh: 你怎么看虚拟办公或远程职场？

questions.en: What do you think about when you daydream?
questions.zh: 你发呆做白日梦时通常会想什么？

questions.en: What do you think of atheists and agnostics?
questions.zh: 你怎么看无神论者和不可知论者？

questions.en: What do you think of Catholic clergy celibacy?
questions.zh: 你怎么看天主教神职人员独身制度？

questions.en: Why do you think some people are cruel?
questions.zh: 你觉得为什么有些人会很残忍？

questions.en: Why do you think televangelists are so popular?
questions.zh: 你觉得电视布道者为什么这么受欢迎？

questions.en: Do you think this is right or wrong: Prostitution?
questions.zh: 你觉得卖淫这件事是对还是错？

questions.en: What do you think about equality in the military?
questions.zh: 你怎么看军队中的性别平等？

questions.en: What do you think about the global village concept?
questions.zh: 你怎么看“地球村”这个概念？

questions.en: What do you think is good about the world?
questions.zh: 你觉得这个世界有哪些好的地方？

questions.en: What do you think of the "three strikes" laws?
questions.zh: 你怎么看“三振出局”之类的重刑法律？

questions.en: Do you think this is right or wrong: Charter schools?
questions.zh: 你觉得特许学校制度是对还是错？

questions.en: Do you think this is right or wrong: Gay marriages?
questions.zh: 你觉得同性婚姻是对还是错？

questions.en: What do you think about nursing a baby in public?
questions.zh: 你怎么看在公共场合给婴儿哺乳？

questions.en: Why do you think bad things happen to good people?
questions.zh: 你觉得为什么坏事会发生在好人身上？

questions.en: Do you believe people are basically lazy or hardworking and why?
questions.zh: 你觉得人本质上更偏懒惰还是勤奋？为什么？

questions.en: Do you think this is right or wrong: Drafting of women?
questions.zh: 你觉得征召女性服兵役是对还是错？

questions.en: What percentage of the things that you worry about actually happen?
questions.zh: 你担心的事情里，实际上最后真的发生的大概占多少？

questions.en: Do you think regional dialects should be taught and preserved in schools?
questions.zh: 你觉得学校应该教授和保护地方方言吗？

questions.en: What do you think about gay and lesbian people in the military?
questions.zh: 你怎么看同性恋者在军队服役？

questions.en: What's something you think you should tell your children that you are reluctant to tell them?
questions.zh: 有没有什么事情是你觉得应该告诉孩子，却一直很不愿意开口的？

questions.en: What historical document, or part of one, do you think everyone in your country should know by heart?
questions.zh: 你觉得你的国家里每个人都应该熟记哪份历史文件，或者其中哪一部分？

questions.en: What ideas do you think would help your company improve quality, save money, and increase sales and productivity?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪些想法能帮助公司提升质量、节省成本，同时增加销量和生产效率？

questions.en: What are the "teachers" and "classrooms" in life and what should we do to earn an "A" in life?
questions.zh: 人生中的“老师”和“教室”分别是什么？我们要怎样才能在人生这门课里拿到“A”？

questions.en: What are the three most important things you could do to improve your life if you exerted greater self-discipline?
questions.zh: 如果自律更强，你最应该做哪三件事来改善自己的人生？

questions.en: When you got caught for doing something wrong as a child, did you blame someone else, deny you did it, run and hide, or take responsibility?
questions.zh: 小时候做错事被抓到时，你通常会怪别人、否认、逃跑躲起来，还是承认责任？

questions.en: When you look at someone who is hugely successful, do you think of them as a lucky person who was in the right place at the right time?
questions.zh: 看到一个极其成功的人时，你会不会首先觉得对方只是运气好、碰巧在对的时间出现在对的地方？

questions.en: Should a country send its military across borders to capture people accused of breaking its laws?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个国家可以派军队跨境抓捕涉嫌违反本国法律的人吗？

questions.en: Do you think professional wrestling is real?
questions.zh: 你觉得职业摔角是真的竞技，还是主要是表演？

questions.en: Do you think all people are created equal?
questions.zh: 你觉得所有人生来平等吗？

questions.en: Do you think black holes exist in space?
questions.zh: 你相信太空中真的存在黑洞吗？

questions.en: Do you think intelligence is related to genetics?
questions.zh: 你觉得智力和遗传有关系吗？

questions.en: Do you think people look silly in tattoos?
questions.zh: 你觉得纹身会让人看起来很傻吗？

questions.en: Do you think that life is ultimately fair?
questions.zh: 你觉得人生最终是公平的吗？

questions.en: Do you think the Head Start program works?
questions.zh: 你觉得美国“启蒙计划（HeadStart）”有效吗？

questions.en: Do you think you are hard on yourself?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己对自己要求太苛刻吗？

questions.en: Do you think capital punishment acts as a deterrent?
questions.zh: 你觉得死刑真的能起到威慑犯罪的作用吗？

questions.en: Do you think energy drinks are healthy or dangerous?
questions.zh: 你觉得能量饮料健康还是危险？

questions.en: Do you think honesty is always the best policy?
questions.zh: 你觉得诚实永远都是最好的原则吗？

questions.en: Do you think before you speak or blurt things out?
questions.zh: 你说话前通常会先想一想，还是经常脱口而出？

questions.en: Do you think the authorities have a file on you?
questions.zh: 你觉得有关部门可能存有你的档案吗？

questions.en: Do you think there is life elsewhere in the universe?
questions.zh: 你相信宇宙其他地方存在生命吗？

questions.en: Do you think you are a good judge of character?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己看人准吗？

questions.en: Do you think an asteroid will wipe out Earth some day?
questions.zh: 你觉得有一天小行星会毁灭地球吗？

questions.en: Do you think it is possible to live with no regrets?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个人可以活得完全没有遗憾吗？

questions.en: Do you think most people are either born good or bad?
questions.zh: 你觉得大多数人天生就是善良或邪恶的吗？

questions.en: Do you think we will be attacked by a nuclear missile?
questions.zh: 你觉得我们有可能遭到核导弹袭击吗？

questions.en: Have you ever seen a ghost? Do you believe ghosts exist?
questions.zh: 你见过鬼吗？你相信鬼存在吗？

questions.en: How do you view failure? What were important failures for you?

questions.zh: 你怎么看申请资助或拨款过程太困难这件事？

questions.zh: 你觉得未来十年自己的人生会是什么样？

questions.zh: 你觉得原世界贸易中心遗址应该建设什么？

questions.zh: 你怎么看把原住民祖先的遗骸归还其族群安葬？

questions.zh: 你觉得现在还应该举办选美比赛吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得伴侣结婚前应该签婚前协议吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得英语应该成为美国官方语言吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得男性也应该被要求承担怀孕生育吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得报纸应该引用匿名消息来源的话吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得法律应该惩罚在恋爱中撒谎的人吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得你所在国家的税法应该大幅简化吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得结婚应该为了爱还是为了钱？

questions.zh: 你觉得无人机应该被用于监控或武器用途吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得同性伴侣应该拥有结婚权吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得万圣节上门讨糖应该设置年龄上限吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得华尔街奖金应该设置上限吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得总统任期限制应该取消吗？

questions.zh: 如果只能救一个人，你觉得应该优先救儿童而不是成人吗？

questions.en: Should a woman's life be spared before a man's?
questions.zh: 如果只能救一个人，你觉得应该优先救女性而不是男性吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得25岁以下驾驶者应该被允许租车吗？

questions.en: Should we continue to send astronauts to the Moon?
questions.zh: 你觉得我们还应该继续派宇航员登月吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得富裕国家应该援助其他国家的贫困人口吗？

questions.en: Do you think people would be surprised about your thoughts?
questions.zh: 你觉得别人如果知道你真正的想法，会感到惊讶吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得16岁应该成为合法取得驾照的年龄吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得无麸质饮食只是潮流，还是确实对一些人有帮助？

questions.en: Do you think state governments should be authorized to handle welfare?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会福利应该主要由州政府负责吗？

questions.en: Do you think that one determined person can change the world?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个意志坚定的人真的能改变世界吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得只有运气不好或“不够好”的人才会失败吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得社会对恋童行为者应该更宽容还是更严厉？

questions.en: Do you think that the radiation emitted from cell phones is dangerous?
questions.zh: 你觉得手机发出的辐射危险吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得受暴女性庇护所的地址应该保密吗？

questions.en: Are there countries your government should try to re-establish diplomatic relations with?
questions.zh: 你觉得你们国家应该尝试和哪些国家恢复外交关系吗？

questions.en: Do you think inactivity can change the structure and functioning of the brain?
questions.zh: 你觉得长期缺乏活动会改变大脑结构和功能吗？

questions.en: Do you think it is a good idea to always trust your gut?
questions.zh: 你觉得始终相信自己的直觉是个好主意吗？
