questions.zh: 你觉得一个人真的可能完全没有性欲吗？

questions.en: Do you think race relations have improved or gotten worse in your lifetime?
questions.zh: 你觉得在你有生之年，种族关系变好了还是变差了？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward graffiti artists?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对涂鸦者应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward underage drinkers?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对未成年饮酒者应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think that life like that on Earth exists in another galaxy?
questions.zh: 你觉得其他星系里也存在类似地球上的生命吗？

questions.en: Do you think people will live under the ocean's surface 500 years from now?
questions.zh: 你觉得500年后人类会生活在海面以下吗？

questions.en: Do you think that kids raised in households without fathers are at a disadvantage?
questions.zh: 你觉得没有父亲参与的家庭里长大的孩子会处于劣势吗？

questions.en: Do you think the UFO information surrounding Roswell, New Mexico, is real or hype?
questions.zh: 你觉得新墨西哥州罗斯威尔附近的UFO传闻是真的，还是炒作？

questions.zh: 你觉得管理层和普通员工多交流、多相处，是好事还是坏事？

questions.en: Do you think the good things in life are either immoral, illegal, fattening, or unhealthy?

questions.en: Do you think that climate change is affecting the type and severity of storms we have?
questions.zh: 你觉得气候变化正在影响风暴的类型和严重程度吗？

questions.en: Do you think women have the same opportunities as men to get jobs or be promoted?
questions.zh: 你觉得女性在就业和晋升方面与男性拥有同等机会吗？

questions.en: Do you like or dislike exercising?
questions.zh: 你喜欢运动，还是不太喜欢？

questions.en: What's your most attractive physical feature?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己外貌上最有吸引力的地方是什么？

questions.en: Do you have a memorable blind-date story?
questions.zh: 你有没有一次特别难忘的相亲经历？

questions.en: What anniversary do you celebrate most meaningfully?
questions.zh: 哪个纪念日对你来说最值得认真庆祝？

questions.en: What does your ideal date look like?
questions.zh: 你理想中的约会是什么样？

questions.en: What's your biggest complaint about your partner?
questions.zh: 你对伴侣最大的抱怨是什么？

questions.en: What's a memorable first-date story from your life?
questions.zh: 你人生中最难忘的一次初次约会是什么？

questions.en: In your relationship, who is in charge of vacation planning?
questions.zh: 在你们的关系里，通常是谁负责规划假期？

questions.en: Do you and your partner agree on ways to spend leisure time?
questions.zh: 你和伴侣在怎样安排休闲时间这件事上意见一致吗？

questions.zh: 即使在恋爱关系中，你也会和别人调情吗？

questions.en: What was the first movie you remember watching on a date and with whom?
questions.zh: 你还记得第一次约会时看的电影吗？当时和谁一起？

questions.zh: 你觉得伴侣会认为你的性生活表现好吗？

questions.zh: 你怎么看未来五年暂停所有合法移民的做法？

questions.en: Do you believe a person is defined by what they does for a living? Why?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个人会被自己的职业定义吗？为什么？

questions.en: What do you think about efforts to feed the poor and malnourished, at home and abroad?
questions.zh: 你怎么看在国内和国外帮助贫困、营养不良人群的行动？

questions.en: What do you think NATO's and the UN's involvement in the internal affairs of countries should be?
questions.zh: 你觉得北约和联合国应该在多大程度上介入一个国家的内部事务？

questions.en: What do you think the length of a presidential term and the number of consecutive terms should be?
questions.zh: 你觉得总统一届任期应该多长？最多可以连续担任几届？

questions.en: What would be a good alternative to prisons? What do you think about the problem of prison overcrowding?
questions.zh: 你觉得监狱制度可以有哪些替代方案？监狱过度拥挤的问题又该怎样处理？

questions.en: What do you think the punishment should be for senior management officials when they commit stock fraud and similar crimes?
questions.zh: 你觉得高级管理人员实施股票欺诈或类似犯罪时，应该受到什么处罚？

questions.zh: 你当时在哪里订婚？求婚是怎样进行的？

questions.en: Do you work out or exercise in silence or with sound (music or TV)?
questions.zh: 你运动时喜欢安静，还是会听音乐或看电视？

questions.en: Should victims of terrorism and mass shootings be compensated?
questions.zh: 你觉得恐怖袭击和大规模枪击事件的受害者应该获得赔偿吗？

questions.en: Should all parolees or probationers pay for their own supervision?
questions.zh: 你觉得假释或缓刑人员应该自己承担监督管理费用吗？

questions.en: Should magazine covers use Photoshop techniques to make models perfect?
questions.zh: 你觉得杂志封面应该使用修图技术把模特修得“完美”吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得刑事审判中陪审员的身份应该受到保护吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得体育比赛和其他娱乐活动开始前应该播放国歌吗？

questions.en: Should it be illegal to manufacture, sell, or possess semiautomatic guns (assault rifles)?
questions.zh: 你觉得制造、销售或持有半自动攻击型枪支应该违法吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得大型企业是否应该被限制，避免形成过度垄断？

questions.en: Should there be a cap on the number of legal immigrants a country admits?
questions.zh: 你觉得一个国家应该给合法移民的数量设上限吗？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward juveniles who commit crimes?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对未成年犯罪者应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think helmets should be mandatory for motorcycles and bicycles - for kids or adults?
questions.zh: 你觉得摩托车和自行车骑行都应该强制戴头盔吗？儿童和成人都一样吗？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward people who commit racial injustices?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对实施种族不公行为的人应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think the judicial system is fair, too lenient, or too tough in sentencing criminals?
questions.zh: 你觉得司法系统量刑总体公平、太宽松，还是太严厉？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward people who jump turnstiles in subways?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对逃票、翻越地铁闸机的人应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward people who don't buckle their seat belts?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对不系安全带的人应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think selling off public lands to private companies for development is ever the right thing to do?
questions.zh: 你觉得把公共土地出售给私人公司开发，在某些情况下是合理的吗？

questions.en: Do you think that oil and natural gas should be transported through a pipeline or on rail and trucks?
questions.zh: 你觉得石油和天然气用管道运输更好，还是铁路和卡车运输更好？

questions.zh: 你和伴侣通常怎样解决分歧？

questions.en: Should employees have a say in the salaries of their superiors?
questions.zh: 你觉得员工应该对上级的薪酬有发言权吗？

questions.en: What side of the bed do you like to sleep on and why?
questions.zh: 你睡觉时喜欢睡床的哪一边？为什么？

questions.en: Would you rather know that your spouse had a one-night stand or never find out?
questions.zh: 你宁愿知道配偶曾有过一次一夜情，还是永远不知道？

questions.en: Is marriage an outdated institution?
questions.zh: 你觉得婚姻已经是一种过时的制度了吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得婚姻存在的意义是什么？

questions.zh: 你有没有喜欢过却没有得到回应的人？

questions.en: Who's the most romantic singer?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪位歌手最浪漫？

questions.en: Whose marriage do you admire?
questions.zh: 你最欣赏谁的婚姻？

questions.en: Did you date much or little?
questions.zh: 你以前约会得多还是少？

questions.en: HAVE YOU ever tried online dating?
questions.zh: 你尝试过网络约会吗？

questions.en: HAVE YOU ever tried speed dating?
questions.zh: 你尝试过快速约会吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得哪些城市最浪漫？

questions.en: What was your last relationship like?

questions.en: What was your parents' relationship like?
questions.zh: 你父母之间的关系是什么样？

questions.en: What's the biggest misconception about marriage?
questions.zh: 你觉得人们对婚姻最大的误解是什么？

questions.en: What's the hardest adjustment in marriage?
questions.zh: 你觉得婚姻中最难适应的是什么？

questions.zh: 你第一次相亲是在什么时候？

questions.zh: 你会或曾经会在婚前和伴侣同居吗？

questions.zh: 你对医疗体系有信心吗？

questions.zh: 你觉得一段好的婚姻应该具备哪些特征？

questions.zh: 你觉得哪首歌最浪漫？

questions.en: What was your best date in secondary school?
questions.zh: 你高中时最好的一次约会是什么？

questions.zh: 你结婚第一年是什么样？

questions.zh: 一段幸福婚姻或关系中，什么是不可缺少的？

questions.zh: 有什么话是你总会反复对伴侣说的？

questions.en: What's the typical reason you end a relationship?

questions.zh: 你愿意尝试参加伴侣交换派对吗？

questions.zh: 你还记得自己的第一位男朋友或女朋友叫什么吗？

questions.zh: 你相信第一次约会就接吻吗？

questions.zh: 你有患严重健康问题的朋友吗？

questions.en: How much does your partner's appearance matter to you?
questions.zh: 伴侣的外貌对你有多重要？

questions.en: In a relationship, how much independence do you need?

questions.zh: 你年轻时参加过宗教青年组织吗？为什么参加或没有参加？

questions.en: Do you consider yourself to be rich, upper income, middle income, lower income, or poor?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己属于富裕、高收入、中等收入、低收入，还是贫困群体？

questions.en: Do you believe there is a hell? If so, how can you keep from going there?
questions.zh: 你相信地狱存在吗？如果相信，你觉得怎样才能避免去那里？

questions.en: Are you familiar with the beliefs of other spiritual traditions? Is there one that particularly interests you?
questions.zh: 你了解其他宗教或灵性传统的信仰吗？有没有一种特别吸引你？

questions.en: Do you usually believe people who tell you that they have seen an angel or had a similar religious experience or do you think that they are basically crazy?
questions.zh: 有人说自己看见天使或经历类似宗教体验时，你通常相信，还是觉得对方可能只是产生了幻觉？

questions.en: In what ways are men discriminated against: paternity leave, retirement age, legal voice over abortions, more rights in divorce settlements, and child custody?
questions.zh: 你觉得男性在哪些方面也可能受到歧视，比如陪产假、退休年龄、堕胎决定权、离婚财产和子女监护权？

questions.en: Should prayer in school be prohibited?
questions.zh: 你觉得学校里的祈祷应该被禁止吗？

questions.en: Are you satisfied with your current salary?
questions.zh: 你对目前的薪水满意吗？

questions.en: What do you look for in a church?
questions.zh: 你选择教堂或宗教团体时最看重什么？

questions.en: Does legalized gambling open the door for organized crime?
questions.zh: 你觉得合法赌博会不会为有组织犯罪打开大门？

questions.en: Do you ever try to convert others to your religion?
questions.zh: 你会尝试让别人皈依自己的宗教吗？

questions.en: Do you believe there is a God who cares about people?
questions.zh: 你相信有一个关心人类的上帝存在吗？

questions.en: Do you think that most wars were started because of religious conflict?
questions.zh: 你觉得历史上的大多数战争是由宗教冲突引发的吗？

questions.en: Do you think the world is becoming more spiritual or less spiritual?
questions.zh: 你觉得世界正在变得更有灵性，还是更世俗？

questions.en: Does legalized gambling encourage people who can least afford to squander their money?
questions.zh: 你觉得合法赌博是否会诱使最没有经济能力的人浪费钱？

questions.en: Why do you think it is that you cannot vote until you are eighteen, but you can drive a car at sixteen?
questions.zh: 为什么法律规定18岁才能投票，却16岁就可以开车？你怎么看这种差异？

questions.en: Are you a gambler? Why or why not?
questions.zh: 你是一个会赌博的人吗？为什么？

questions.en: BY LAW, SHOULD smoking be banned in all public places?
questions.zh: 你觉得法律应该禁止所有公共场所吸烟吗？

questions.en: Does state-sponsored gambling really create jobs and stimulate local economy?
questions.zh: 你觉得州政府主办的赌博真的能创造就业、刺激当地经济吗？

questions.en: Would you respect a boss less if they smoked cigarettes?
questions.zh: 如果老板抽烟，你会因此少尊重他/她吗？

questions.en: What would you do if you were a smoker in a nonsmoking place?
questions.zh: 如果你是吸烟者，却身处禁烟场所，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Do you engage in political protest?
questions.zh: 你会参加政治抗议活动吗？

questions.en: Do you follow local government doings?
questions.zh: 你会关注地方政府的动态吗？

questions.en: Do you try to be politically correct?
questions.zh: 你会刻意让自己的言行保持“政治正确”吗？

questions.en: Do you have confidence in the church or organized religion?
questions.zh: 你对教会或有组织宗教有信心吗？

questions.en: Do you and your partner come from similar backgrounds (e.g., education, social status, family income, etc.)?
questions.zh: 你和伴侣的背景相似吗，比如教育、社会阶层和家庭收入？

questions.en: When the government and the legislature are held by opposing parties, do you think they cooperate?
questions.zh: 当政府和立法机构分属不同政党时，你觉得他们能合作吗？

questions.en: Is income a consideration in choosing a mate?
questions.zh: 选择伴侣时，你会把收入作为考虑因素吗？

questions.en: What will be the sources of your retirement income?
questions.zh: 你退休后的收入预计会来自哪些来源？

questions.en: How involved is religion or spirituality in your adult life?
questions.zh: 宗教或灵性在你的成年生活中占多大比重？

questions.en: Do you have a church, temple, or other place of worship that you consider yours?
questions.zh: 你有自己固定参加的教堂、寺庙或其他礼拜场所吗？

questions.en: What's your preferred form of birth control?
questions.zh: 你更偏好哪一种避孕方式？

questions.en: Do you watch or look at pornographic videos or material?
questions.zh: 你会观看或浏览色情视频或其他色情内容吗？

questions.en: Are you a member of a church or synagogue?
questions.zh: 你是教堂、犹太会堂或其他宗教组织的成员吗？

questions.en: Would you rather be a farmer or a politician?
questions.zh: 你宁愿当农民还是政治人物？

questions.en: Do you define yourself politically as liberal, moderate, or conservative?
questions.zh: 从政治立场看，你会把自己定义为自由派、温和派还是保守派？

questions.en: Where's the presence of God in a sometimes hostile world?
questions.zh: 在一个有时充满敌意的世界里，你会在哪里感受到上帝的存在？

questions.en: Do you favor reduction in size and budget of all government agencies?
questions.zh: 你赞成缩小所有政府机构的规模和预算吗？

questions.en: Should banks be bailed out in future financial crises? Should a bank or company be too big to fail?
questions.zh: 你觉得未来金融危机中还应该救助银行吗？银行或公司是否应该“大到不能倒”？

questions.en: Do you worry about dying?
questions.zh: 你会担心死亡吗？

questions.en: How old do you want to be when you die?
questions.zh: 你希望自己活到多少岁？

questions.en: Have you ever changed your religion?
questions.zh: 你有没有改信过其他宗教？

questions.en: Have you ever doubted there was a God?
questions.zh: 你有没有怀疑过上帝是否存在？

questions.en: How do you feel right now about religion?
questions.zh: 你现在对宗教是什么感觉？

questions.en: What occupation will have the highest salary in fifty years?
questions.zh: 你觉得五十年后哪一种职业的薪水会最高？

questions.en: Would you vote for or against a constitutional amendment to require a balanced federal budget?
questions.zh: 你会支持还是反对通过宪法修正案，要求联邦政府实现预算平衡？

questions.en: Do you believe in God?
questions.zh: 你相信上帝存在吗？

questions.en: What does God look like?
questions.zh: 你想象中的上帝是什么样？

questions.en: Will God answer your prayers?
questions.zh: 你相信上帝会回应你的祈祷吗？

questions.en: Could you accept a new religion?
questions.zh: 你能接受改信一种新的宗教吗？

questions.en: Have you ever switched political parties?
questions.zh: 你有没有换过自己的政治党派立场？

questions.en: How does God speak to you?
questions.zh: 你觉得上帝会怎样向你“说话”？

questions.en: Was religion important during your teen years?
questions.zh: 宗教在你青少年时期重要吗？

questions.en: What are your church memories from childhood?
questions.zh: 你对童年教会生活有哪些记忆？

questions.en: What religions have you explored and rejected?
questions.zh: 你探索过、后来又放弃过哪些宗教？

questions.en: What teachings of your church confused you?
questions.zh: 你所在宗教团体的哪些教义曾让你感到困惑？

questions.en: Does God love some people more than others?
questions.zh: 你觉得上帝会更爱某些人、少爱另一些人吗？

questions.en: Have you ever worked on a political campaign?
questions.zh: 你有没有为政治竞选活动工作过？

questions.en: Have you had any personal experiences with God?
questions.zh: 你有过自己认为是与上帝有关的个人体验吗？

questions.en: What cults and religions give you the creeps?
questions.zh: 哪些教派或宗教会让你本能地感到不舒服甚至害怕？

questions.en: What have you given up for your religion?
questions.zh: 你曾为自己的宗教信仰放弃过什么？

questions.en: Who made the world and who made God?
questions.zh: 你觉得世界是谁创造的？那上帝又是谁创造的？

questions.en: Do you believe all religions are basically the same?
questions.zh: 你相信所有宗教本质上都差不多吗？

questions.en: Do you support or oppose government-backed affordable health care?
questions.zh: 你支持还是反对由政府推动、保障可负担的医疗服务？

questions.en: Is it important for a Christian to attend church?
questions.zh: 你觉得基督徒参加教会聚会重要吗？

questions.en: What three questions would you like to ask God?
questions.zh: 如果能问上帝三个问题，你会问什么？

questions.en: Did you resent or enjoy church and/ or Sunday school?
questions.zh: 你小时候是排斥教会和主日学，还是享受它们？

questions.en: How important would you say religion is in your life?
questions.zh: 你觉得宗教在自己生活中有多重要？

questions.en: Was there a time when God didn't seem to exist?
questions.zh: 有没有一个时期，你觉得上帝好像根本不存在？

questions.en: Has God ever spoken to you and what did they say?
questions.zh: 你有没有感觉上帝曾对你说过话？你觉得说了什么？

questions.en: How do you feel about governments increasing surveillance of their own citizens?
questions.zh: 你怎么看政府加强对本国公民的监控？

questions.en: If you could ask God one question, what would it be?
questions.zh: 如果只能问上帝一个问题，你会问什么？

questions.en: What are your feelings about pornography?
questions.zh: 你怎么看色情内容？

questions.en: What are turn-ons and turn-offs to you?
questions.zh: 什么最能让你产生好感？什么最让你失去兴趣？

questions.en: Do you think society should be more lenient or stricter toward gamblers?
questions.zh: 你觉得社会对赌博者应该更宽容，还是更严格？

questions.en: Do you think the warning on cigarette packages means anything to smokers?
questions.zh: 你觉得香烟包装上的健康警告对吸烟者真的有作用吗？

questions.en: Do you favor or oppose a law forbidding the sale of all alcohol?
questions.zh: 你赞成还是反对立法禁止销售所有酒精饮料？

questions.en: Whose politics have you admired?
questions.zh: 你最欣赏谁的政治立场或政治理念？

questions.en: Are all politicians a little crooked?
questions.zh: 你觉得所有政治人物都有一点不诚实或不干净吗？

questions.en: What prominent politicians have you met?
questions.zh: 你见过哪些知名政治人物？

questions.en: Do you know your local politicians personally?
questions.zh: 你本人认识当地的政治人物吗？

questions.en: Which interests you more: art or politics?
questions.zh: 艺术和政治相比，哪一个更让你感兴趣？

questions.en: Would you advocate government force when necessary?
questions.zh: 在必要情况下，你支持政府使用强制力量吗？

questions.en: Would you be a good political campaigner?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己会是一个好的政治竞选活动者吗？

questions.en: Do we need more than two political parties?
questions.zh: 你觉得我们需要两个以上的主要政党吗？

questions.en: How do TV political ads influence your decisions?
questions.zh: 电视政治广告会怎样影响你的选择？

questions.en: What are government policies' effect on moral values?
questions.zh: 政府政策会怎样影响社会的道德价值观？

questions.en: What's a government policy you strongly disagree with?
questions.zh: 有没有一项政府政策是你强烈反对的？

questions.en: Which political party is more interested in education?
questions.zh: 你觉得哪个政党更重视教育？

questions.en: Who was the most attractive politician in history?
questions.zh: 你觉得历史上最有魅力的政治人物是谁？

questions.en: What was the worst political crime you know of?
questions.zh: 你知道最严重的一起政治犯罪是什么？

questions.en: Do people really have a say in what government does?
questions.zh: 普通人真的能影响政府的决策吗？

questions.en: Should the Bible be a sourcebook for instruction? Other sacred books?
questions.zh: 你觉得《圣经》应该作为教育教材或参考来源吗？其他宗教经典呢？

questions.en: Would you rather read 100 pages of the Bible or about medieval politics?
questions.zh: 你宁愿读100页《圣经》，还是读100页中世纪政治史？

questions.en: Would you take out a loan to study? How much student debt is a reasonable amount to carry?
questions.zh: 为了上大学，你愿意申请贷款吗？你觉得一个人背多少学生贷款算合理？

questions.en: What do you like to do after making love?
questions.zh: 做爱之后你喜欢做什么？

questions.en: Have you ever bought or sought out any type of pornography?
questions.zh: 你有没有购买或主动寻找过任何形式的色情内容？

questions.en: Did religion play a part in your childhood social activities?
questions.zh: 宗教在你的童年社交活动中扮演过角色吗？

questions.en: Have you ever gone against popular political opinions or beliefs?
questions.zh: 你有没有公开反对过当时流行的政治观点或立场？

questions.en: Have you ever thought of running for a political office?
questions.zh: 你有没有想过竞选公职？

questions.en: How do you feel about people with extreme political views?
questions.zh: 你怎么看政治观点非常极端的人？

questions.en: Is there any religion you are not interested in exploring?
questions.zh: 有没有一种宗教是你完全没有兴趣了解的？

questions.en: What crisis pushed you closer to God or into spirituality?
questions.zh: 有没有一次危机让你更接近上帝，或更重视灵性？

questions.en: Which holds greater hope for the world: religion or science?
questions.zh: 宗教和科学相比，你觉得哪一个更能给世界带来希望？

questions.en: Do you believe your society is truly tolerant of all religions?
questions.zh: 你觉得你所在的社会真的能包容所有宗教吗？

questions.en: How important was religion to your family when you were young?
questions.zh: 你小时候，宗教对你的家庭有多重要？

questions.en: Is organized religion for you, or are your beliefs more alternative?
questions.zh: 有组织的宗教适合你吗？还是你的信仰更个人化、非传统？

questions.en: What's the first thing that comes to mind when you think about God?
questions.zh: 想到上帝时，你脑子里最先出现什么？

questions.en: Do you watch political debates on TV? The President's State of the Union address?
questions.zh: 你会看电视政治辩论或总统国情咨文吗？

questions.en: Was yours a religious family or one that went to church in an obligated way?
questions.zh: 你的家庭是真正虔诚，还是更多出于义务去教堂或参加宗教活动？

questions.en: What should the regulations be for pornography on the internet?
questions.zh: 你觉得互联网色情内容应该受到怎样的监管？

questions.en: At what age should birth control be allowed, especially the Pill?
questions.zh: 你觉得避孕措施，尤其是口服避孕药，最早应该从几岁开始允许使用？

questions.en: Should e-cigarettes have the same laws and bans as regular cigarettes?
questions.zh: 你觉得电子烟应该受到和普通香烟一样的法律限制和禁令吗？

questions.en: What would you do if you found out your partner was faking orgasms?
questions.zh: 如果发现伴侣一直在假装高潮，你会怎么做？

questions.en: Will you purchase your gravesite while you are still alive or have it purchased for you when you die?
questions.zh: 你会生前自己购买墓地，还是等去世后由家人安排？

questions.en: Is the government adequately regulating business mergers?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府对企业并购的监管充分吗？

questions.en: How has your view of politics changed since you started voting?
questions.zh: 从第一次开始投票到现在，你对政治的看法发生了哪些变化？

questions.en: What are the ways you believe the government lies to us?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府会在哪些方面对公众说谎？

questions.en: What government position do you think you would be great at?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己最适合担任哪一个政府职位？

questions.en: What one politician would you like to see out of office?
questions.zh: 你最希望哪位政治人物离开公职？

questions.en: Are politicians more or less capable nowadays than they used to be?
questions.zh: 你觉得现在的政治人物比过去更有能力，还是更没有能力？

questions.en: What would you do if your significant other became extremely politically active?
questions.zh: 如果伴侣突然变得非常积极参与政治活动，你会怎么做？

questions.en: If there was no need for armies, how should government use the money?
questions.zh: 如果世界不再需要军队，你觉得政府应该怎样使用省下来的钱？

questions.en: If you are presently attending church, how did you come to join it?
questions.zh: 如果你现在固定参加某个教会，你当初是怎样加入的？

questions.en: Does one particular issue drive your choice of candidates in federal and state elections?
questions.zh: 在联邦和州选举中，有没有某一个议题会决定你支持哪个候选人？

questions.en: How important is it to you to vote in local, state, and national elections?
questions.zh: 对你来说，参加地方、州和全国选举投票有多重要？

questions.en: If you are presently attending church, what would you like to change about it?
questions.zh: 如果你现在固定参加某个教会，你最希望它改变什么？

questions.en: What do you think about rich people who pay little or no income tax?
questions.zh: 你怎么看那些缴很少甚至几乎不缴所得税的富人？

questions.en: What political, social, or moral cause would you like to be more involved in?
questions.zh: 你最想更多参与哪一种政治、社会或道德议题？

questions.en: Would you still vote for your last presidential choice if the election was held now?
questions.zh: 如果今天重新举行上一次总统选举，你还会投给同一个人吗？

questions.en: Is government run by a few big interests or mostly for the benefit of all people?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府主要受少数大利益集团控制，还是大体上为所有人服务？

questions.en: What should be done to drunk drivers who kill?
questions.zh: 酒后驾车导致他人死亡的人应该受到怎样的处罚？

questions.en: When was the last time you were really drunk?
questions.zh: 你最近一次真正喝醉是什么时候？

questions.en: What should churches' involvement in political matters be?
questions.zh: 你觉得教会应该在政治事务中扮演什么角色？

questions.en: What do you think God's gender or race is?
questions.zh: 你觉得上帝有性别或种族吗？如果有，会是什么？

questions.en: Do you think that smoking should be banned from bars everywhere? In public everywhere?
questions.zh: 你觉得酒吧应该全面禁烟吗？所有公共场所呢？

questions.en: Should cigarette companies be held legally responsible by families of smokers who died of smoking-related causes?
questions.zh: 如果吸烟者因吸烟相关疾病去世，你觉得烟草公司应该对其家属承担法律责任吗？

questions.en: Do you think that God sees everything?
questions.zh: 你相信上帝能看见一切吗？

questions.en: Why do you vote for "your" political party?
questions.zh: 你为什么会支持自己所属或偏好的政党？

questions.en: What do you think a world government might be like?
questions.zh: 你想象中的世界政府会是什么样？

questions.en: What should be done to control government spending and cut waste?
questions.zh: 你觉得应该怎样控制政府开支并减少浪费？

questions.en: Does money from lobbyists and political action committees have too much influence on elections and government policy?
questions.zh: 游说集团和政治行动委员会的资金，对选举和政府政策的影响是否过大？

questions.en: When do you make up your mind for voting: in the voting booth, days before, the week before, or long before the election?
questions.zh: 你通常什么时候才最终决定投给谁——进入投票站时、几天前、一周前，还是很早就决定？

questions.en: Do you think government should regulate any industries?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府应该监管某些行业吗？哪些？

questions.en: Do you think you would make a good politician?
questions.zh: 你觉得自己会成为一个好的政治人物吗？

questions.en: What do you think of the possibility of new religions?
questions.zh: 你怎么看未来出现新的宗教？

questions.en: What do you think about going to church versus praying on your own?
questions.zh: 去教堂和自己独自祈祷相比，你怎么看两者的价值？

questions.en: What do you think about claims to having a vision of God or Jesus?
questions.zh: 你怎么看有人声称自己看见了上帝或耶稣的异象？

questions.en: What do you think about marrying someone of a different race, nationality, or religion?
questions.zh: 你怎么看和不同种族、国籍或宗教的人结婚？

questions.en: What should be the minimum number of paid vacation days dictated by the government?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府最低应该规定多少天带薪年假？

questions.en: Do you think religion is increasing its influence or losing it?
questions.zh: 你觉得宗教的社会影响力正在增强，还是减弱？

questions.en: What do you think should be done about election campaign financing limits?
questions.zh: 你觉得竞选资金捐款上限应该怎样规定？

questions.en: Would you ever run for political office? What would make you do so?
questions.zh: 你会竞选公职吗？什么情况会促使你去参选？

questions.en: What do you think the campaign issues will be in the next presidential election?
questions.zh: 你觉得下一届总统选举最可能围绕哪些议题展开？

questions.en: How would you describe God?
questions.zh: 你会怎样描述上帝？

questions.en: DESCRIBE an alternative to a god.
questions.zh: 如果不用“神”来解释世界，你会怎样描述一种替代概念？

questions.en: Should there be secret/classified government documents?
questions.zh: 你觉得政府是否应该保留秘密或机密文件？

questions.zh: 你觉得总统竞选活动应该规定只能在选举前某个时间点开始吗？

questions.en: Do you think lower-income people pay their fair share, too much, or too little income tax? How about middle-income, upper-income, and you?
questions.zh: 你觉得低收入、中等收入和高收入人群分别缴纳的所得税是太多、太少，还是公平？你自己呢？

questions.zh: 如果发现伴侣曾经做过堕胎，这会影响你对他/她的感情吗？

questions.en: How do you feel about sex and nudity in a movie with a relatively new date or friend? With your spouse?
questions.zh: 和刚认识不久的约会对象或朋友一起看电影时，遇到性和裸体镜头你会觉得怎样？和配偶一起时呢？

questions.en: How do you view the current drug addiction debate, that we should focus more on treatment and support or punishment and incarceration?
questions.zh: 关于毒品成瘾，你觉得社会应该更侧重治疗和支持，还是惩罚和监禁？

questions.en: Should it be illegal to perform abortion in the last six months of pregnancy except to save the life of the mother?
questions.zh: 除非为了挽救孕妇生命，你觉得怀孕后六个月进行堕胎应该违法吗？

questions.en: Which would be easiest for you to become addicted to: money, success, power, sex, alcohol, drugs, work, shopping, the internet, or TV?
questions.zh: 金钱、成功、权力、性、酒精、毒品、工作、购物、互联网和电视中，你觉得自己最容易对哪一种上瘾？

questions.en: List ways in which these things have had a negative impact on your life: alcohol, drugs, sex, work, money, food, family, and friends.
questions.zh: 酒精、毒品、性、工作、金钱、食物、家庭和朋友分别曾以哪些负面方式影响过你的生活？

questions.en: If you believe in life after death, where do you think you are going or what do you think you are coming back as?
questions.zh: 如果你相信死后还有生命，你觉得自己会去哪里，或转世成什么？

questions.en: Should doctors be allowed to end the life of a patient who is about to die and is or will experience great suffering (i.e., doctor-assisted suicide in life-threatening situations)?
questions.zh: 对于即将死亡且遭受或将遭受巨大痛苦的患者，你觉得医生应该被允许协助结束其生命吗？

questions.en: If you knew that your child would be born with a genetic defect and is likely to die by the age of five, would you decide to have an abortion?
questions.zh: 如果你知道孩子将带有严重遗传缺陷，而且很可能在五岁前去世，你会选择堕胎吗？
